--- pag 1 ---
supOS Executive Highlights 
Overview 
supOS is a platform for industrial digital transformation. 
supOS can connect your infrastructure, manage and analyze your data flow, and 
build unlimited applications. 
supOS solution includes industrial IoT, big data and AI, low-code App development, 
covering use cases in digital factory, unified operation center (UOC), safety 
production, EAM, utility efficiency and more. 
 
Core Features 
1. 
Flexible Heterogeneous Data Collection 
supOS provides a unified collection point to realize the access and pre-processing of 
multiple heterogeneous data sources. Data sources supported include: 
- 
A variety of industrial common protocols (300+ protocols): OPC DA/UA, Modbus 
TCP/RTU, BACnet, IEC104, SNMP, RTSP, EPA, HART, PROFINET, etc., by the 
product X-Collector module of supOS to ingest real-time data with DCS/PLC/CNC 
and other systems from mainstream manufacturers (Schneider, ABB, Honeywell, 
etc.), alarm events and video streaming data. 
- 
MQTT/gRPC Gateway 
- 
ODBC/JDBC: Relational Database Access 
- 
Restful API/Web Service
--- pag 2 ---
- 
Kafka, MQ 
- 
Local Resources: Local File Directories. 
- 
Big Data Storage Access: Hive/HBase 
- 
3rd Party System Connector: such as SAP, PI, MES, ERP, OA, SCM, CRM, etc. 
 
The supOS's distributed DataLake offers a unified, single-point-of-source for 
heterogeneous data synchronization, compression, storage and query. 
The X-ETL, supOS's data pipelining tool, can provide functions of data extraction, 
loading, cleaning, filtering, aggregation, conversion and supports flow-based drag-n-
drop task scheduling. 
 
2. 
Object-Oriented Digital Factory Modeling 
- 
supOS adopts object modeling methodology and templates to create a 
comprehensive digital model of factory facilities, such as workshops, equipment, 
process, personnel, products, raw materials, vehicles, and warehouses. 
- 
Object instances can extend object properties, services, events, and subscription 
properties by inheriting templates when they are created. 
 
 
3. 
One-stop Powerful AI/ML Service
--- pag 3 ---
Deploying AI capabilities to realize real-time analysis and event detection based on-
site video (X-Edge computing and algorithm service), multi-variable self-adaptive 
process control, optimization and forecasting with supOS. 
The supOS AI platform supports the following algorithms and features: 
- 
ML/DL: classification, clustering, regression, prediction, optimization, and 
RNN/CNN/BP/LSTM and more deep learning algorithms. 
- 
A drag-and-drop configuration pipeline: modeling, experimenting, evaluating and 
publishing big data algorithms. 
- 
Support importing 3rd-party custom algorithms. 
- 
Supports offline training of AI algorithms and scenarios. 
 
 
4. 
Drag-and-drop, Workflow-based Low-code App Development 
- 
By module of supOS IDE, supOS provides easy-to-use DIY configuration tools 
for visualization and dashboard design. The tools include rich graphical libraries and 
components. 
- 
supOS platform provides a configurable APP development IDE, which effectively 
reduces the IT threshold for business-oriented APP (including Web & Mobile) 
development and design through a graphical, component-based, wizard-style 
environment. 
- 
The platform provides a workflow configuration development environment based 
on BPMN process specification.
--- pag 4 ---
5. 
General Functions 
- 
Unified Access: AD Sync, SSO, OIDC/OAuth2, etc. 
- 
Personalized Workbench: Configure as your need 
- 
Authority and Permission Management 
- 
User and Role Management 
- 
Message and Notification Center 
- 
Open API Integration

Reference Cases 
- 
SINOPEC Zhenghai Refinery & Chemical Co. LTD Project 
Our client is a giant Chinese integrated refining and chemical enterprise. We 
integrated 13 heterogeneous systems, including real-time databases, EM systems, 
and measurement systems, with over 60,000 data points. 
We formed a big data platform based on supOS, which consolidates data from all 
instrument and control equipment, including DCS, SIS, CCS, PLC, intelligent 
instruments, equipment inventory, work permits, wagon balance, video, and other 
sources. 
Moreover, we developed machine learning algorithms for predictive maintenance of 
instruments, which include high-frequency fault instrument life prediction, regulating 
valve flow anomaly monitoring, and program-controlled valve internal leakage 
monitoring.
--- pag 6 ---
- 
Chambroad Co. LTD Next-Generation Intelligent Factory Project 
Chambroad, a top Chinese petrochemical company with an annual processing 
capacity of 18 million tons, partnered with us to integrate over 100 IT & OT systems 
using supOS, and built up a centralized data lake that can be accessed by 
applications via Open API and standard services. 
This project led to impressive improvements, including a 20% increase in productivity, 
a 30% improvement in project completion rates, and an overall cost savings of $3 
million per year. 
 
- 
Aramco Community Service Project 
supOS cooperated with Aramco Community Service and developed a smart 
community app, myCommunity, which aims to enhance the health and well-being of 
people in Aramco Communities. The goal is to make communities more inclusive, 
interoperable, and resilient through digital and technology services, giving people a 
high sense of social engagement.

próximamente en la transformación digital de sus operaciones. 
Atentamente, 
[Firma] 
Daniel & Luke Regional Directors – SUPCON South America SUPCON Global (AI-Driven 
Industrial Automation)

1. InPlant APC Product Overview 
1.1. Application Background 
1.1.1 Industry Market Situation 
In the industrial production process, a good control system should 
not only ensure the system stability and the safety of the entire 
production and meet certain constraints, but also bring certain 
economic and social benefits. The development pattern of the 
modern industrial economy has changed from pursuing scale and 
speed to improving quality and efficiency. Industrial enterprises 
have accelerated the optimization and upgrading of their industries, 
continuously adopted more advanced production processes and 
equipment to eliminate backward production capacity, and 
achieved lower cost and higher efficiency. 
Conventional control strategies, including the distributed control 
system (DCS) and conventional PID control, can no longer meet 
the requirements of multi-objective optimization, multi-level 
coordination, and multi-variable control in the modern industrial 
production process. The complexity and strong coupling of the 
system put forward higher requirements for control technology. 
With model predictive control, intelligent control, and soft sensor as 
the core technology, Advanced Process Control (APC) has been
--- pag 5 ---
InPlant APC Sales Technical Manual 
 
2 
successfully applied in the process industry, greatly reducing the 
labor intensity of operators and the impact of human factors in 
production and operation. Therefore, advanced process control has 
been regarded as a new and high technology with low investment 
and high benefits. It is an important means for process industry 
enterprises to improve their comprehensive automation level and 
productivity, achieve energy saving, consumption reduction, and 
emission reduction, continuously exploit potentials and increase 
efficiency, and improve market competitiveness. 
1.1.2 Customer Demand Analysis 
Under the background of the global carbon emission reduction 
strategy, the industrial structure of the oil refining, petrochemical, 
and chemical industries will continue to be optimized and upgraded, 
and the industrial technology level will be improved through the 
development with constraints. Saving energy, reducing raw 
material consumption, and promoting green environmental 
protection have become hot topics of long-term concern for 
enterprises and also put forward higher requirements for 
automation technology. Advanced control technology plays a very 
important role in energy saving, emission reduction, and efficient 
operation of enterprises. It has many significant advantages, so it 
has been widely concerned and promoted by customers.
--- pag 6 ---
InPlant APC Sales Technical Manual 
 
3 
As far as the automation level of enterprises is concerned, it mainly 
includes the automation system & instrument products and control 
technology. The former is only the basic condition for realizing 
automation, while the latter determines the quality of target control. 
There are two ways to reduce energy consumption, one is to 
transfer energy-intensive industries reasonably and improve the 
industrial structure, and the other is to reduce energy consumption 
per unit value added and improve energy efficiency. Advanced 
control is one of the means to save energy and reduce 
consumption, and can bring considerable economic benefits to 
enterprises. 
1.2. Solution Overview 
1.2.1. InPlant APC Product Overview 
SUPCON has been committed to the research, development, and 
implementation of advanced process control (APC) since 1996, 
and has successfully launched the advanced process control 
software package InPlant APC with independent intellectual 
property rights. This software integrates the advanced process 
control platform APC-iSYS and multi-variable predictive control 
software APC-Adcon to achieve multi-variable coordinated optimal 
control, while enhancing the anti-interference ability and robustness
--- pag 7 ---
InPlant APC Sales Technical Manual 
 
4 
of the system, to achieve precise control and hierarchical and 
multi-objective coordination and optimization of complex industrial 
processes, and achieve the objectives of improving quality, 
reducing costs, increasing production, and increasing efficiency of 
enterprises. 
Through the best practices of a series of projects, SUPCON has 
accumulated 
advanced 
control 
solutions 
for 
oil 
refining, 
petrochemical, chemical, building materials, metallurgy, thermal 
power, and other industries. In addition, SUPCON also participates 
in formulating standards related to advanced control and 
optimization, such as the national standards GB/T 32854.1-2016 
and GB/T 32854.2-2017, and won a series of national science and 
technology awards. 
1.2.2. Target Industries and Major Competitors 
At present, more than 1000 sets of applications of InPlant APC 
have been applied in the main units of oil refining, petrochemical, 
and chemical industry of Sinopec, PetroChina, CNOOC, and other 
super large enterprise groups, as well as in many units of large and 
medium-sized fertilizer, chemical, air separation, power, building 
materials, and other industries. InPlant APC has become a 
domestically leading supplier of advanced process control 
technologies, 
software, 
and 
services, 
and 
provides
--- pag 8 ---
InPlant APC Sales Technical Manual 
 
5 
industry-specific solutions for cement, coking, furnace, and other 
industries. SUPCON InPlant APC has held the first place in the 
domestic market for five consecutive years. 
More than 10 foreign companies have advanced control software in 
the market, such as AspenTech, Honeywell, YOKOGAWA, 
Rockwell, Invensys, and other well-known automation equipment 
companies that all have their own independent version of advanced 
control software. The advanced control function modules of ABB, 
Emerson, and other automation equipment companies are 
integrated in the DCS system and can be released through 
software authorization. The independent version of advanced 
control software developed by foreign companies has been widely 
used in various plants of typical process industries. However, in 
China, they only offer software without engineering services, and 
their software is mainly purchased by domestic companies to offer 
engineering services. 
In China, except for SUPCON commercial advanced control 
software products that are comparable to foreign ones, other 
automation companies, such as Petro-CyberWorks Information 
Technology Co., Ltd. and Beijing Tsingda Huayi Technology Co., 
Ltd., mainly use foreign software to offer engineering services for oil 
refining and petrochemical advanced control projects. They started
--- pag 9 ---
InPlant APC Sales Technical Manual 
 
6 
late in independent product research and development, and their 
developed advanced control software products have not been 
widely verified in engineering. The customized complex control 
strategy implemented by Cenlonbo is the control at the ARC level, 
lacking universal products, which is lower than the APC level. The 
INFIT optimal control system developed by Innavit relying on the 
reputation of Southeast University in the thermal power industry is 
mainly applied in large thermal power units. Some universities such 
as University of Science and Technology of China and Shanghai 
Jiao Tong University have also developed advanced control 
software but it has not been widely commercialized. 
From the perspective of cost-effectiveness and engineering 
application of software products, foreign advanced control software 
products are expensive, and the implementation of solutions is only 
applicable to industrial plants with standardized designs. For 
domestic industrial plants that have undergone production capacity 
expansion, transformation, or personalized designs, the flexibility of 
engineering application is insufficient. The advanced control 
software products of SUPCON can provide targeted solutions 
based on the actual control needs of industrial plants, which can 
better meet the personalized needs of industrial plants. The system 
is highly applicable, effective, and cost-effective.
--- pag 10 ---
InPlant APC Sales Technical Manual 
 
7 
1.2.3. Value and Benefits of APC 
The goal of InPlant APC advanced process control products is to 
improve the safety and stability of the plant, ensure the overall 
performance of the process control system and long-term operation 
of the plant, make it approach the maximum production capacity, 
and guarantee consistent product quality and improve production 
efficiency through push-to-the-limit optimization. Through over 20 
years of implementation and verification, the benefits that InPlant 
APC products can bring include: 
 Reduce the standard deviation of key process variable 
fluctuations, usually more than 30%. 
 Increase processing capacity by 1% - 5%. 
 Increase the yield of target products by 1% - 5%. 
 Reduce the energy consumption of the plant by 2% - 5%. 
 Save the material consumption of the plant by 1% - 5%. 
 Reduce the probability of unqualified products and avoid quality 
risks. 
 Reduce pollutant discharge and realize environment-friendly 
production. 
2. InPlant APC Function Introduction 
2.1. InPlant APC Product Architecture 
Process industry informatization system mainly includes production 
process layer, production process control layer, production process
--- pag 11 ---
InPlant APC Sales Technical Manual 
 
8 
optimization layer, production management execution layer, 
enterprise management and business decision-making layer, which 
integrates the enterprise's production process control, operation 
management and business decision-making comprehensive 
management and control. Among them, the production process 
layer consists of process equipment, pipelines, measurement and 
control instruments; the production process control layer solves the 
process control and optimization problems of the production device 
based on the information of the production process control layer 
and the information of the production process optimization layer, 
including the conventional control technology mainly based on 
simple and complex control and the advanced control technology 
mainly based on the model predictive control, intelligent control, 
sensor, and completes the monitoring and displaying of the 
production process. It also accomplishes the monitoring and 
displaying of the production process. The production process 
optimization layer further releases the value of advanced process 
control through real-time or off-line optimization of process 
parameters based on production process information and market 
price information. The production management and execution layer 
accomplish 
production 
operation 
monitoring, 
equipment 
management, performance assessment, production scheduling,
--- pag 12 ---

and 
so 
on. 
The 
enterprise 
management 
and 
operation 
decision-making layer accomplishes operation management, trend 
prediction, intelligent decision-making, and execution evaluation 
based on production management execution information and 
market information.

APC-Watch, APC performance optimization software APC-PerfOpt. 
2.2. Specific functions 
2.2.1 APC-Adcon (Multivariate Predictive Control Software) 
APC-Adcon is the key product of InPlant APC, which is designed 
for the stable control and dynamic optimization of multi-variable, 
strongly coupling, large time-delayed, and constrained complex 
manufacturing processes. It has all the main functions of 
mainstream multi-variable predictive control software, which 
contains components like modeling, designing of the controller, 
simulation, configuration, online deployment, etc., and mainly 
adopts the following core technologies: 
 Predictive modeling: using a multi-input, multi-output system 
model to predict future control behavior and correcting it with 
online feedback to ensure that the controller can cope with 
model mismatches and improve the robustness of the controller. 
 Rolling Optimization: According to the constraints and 
objectives set by the user, the optimal control inputs of the 
system are calculated in real time on a rolling basis, and the 
card-edge control is realized step by step. 
 Economic optimization: provide a combination of economic and 
tracking objectives at the steady-state optimization layer to 
achieve maximum economic efficiency while ensuring controlled 
tracking behavior. 
 Multi-level coordinated optimization: In order to ensure the
--- pag 14 ---
InPlant APC Sales Technical Manual 
 
11 
feasible solution of the optimization, levels are introduced to 
solve the conflicts among the coordinated constraints, and the 
soft constraints can be relaxed according to the levels when the 
constraints cannot be satisfied in full. 
 Interval control: In order to meet the control needs of different 
variables, we provide two methods, set value control and 
interval control, which can achieve good control results even in 
the face of "thin systems" with missing degrees of freedom. 
 Measurable Disturbance Suppression: Supports simultaneous 
modeling of measurable disturbances (e.g., feed volume, steam 
pressure, cooling water temperature, etc.), predicts the impact 
of disturbing variables (DVs) on the process, and realizes 
automatic and effective compensation to improve the 
smoothness of device operation and reduce labor intensity. 
1.Adcon-Ident 
The identification software can be used to analyze and preprocess 
the process data, and further obtain the model set between each 
variable through the identification algorithm, and then use the 
obtained model for predictive controller configuration design. The 
model identification process consists of five steps: data import, data 
processing, model identification, model simulation, and model

3.1. Application of Catalytic Reforming (Oil Refining) 
3.1.1 Introduction to Process Flow 
Catalytic reforming is an important secondary processing method in 
the refinery, which is the process of rearranging the molecular 
structure of hydrocarbon molecules under the action of a catalyst. It 
is mainly aimed at producing high-octane gasoline components or 
important chemical raw materials such as benzene, toluene, xylene,
--- pag 27 ---
InPlant APC Sales Technical Manual 
 
24 
etc. Its by-product hydrogen can be used in units such as 
hydrofining after purification. 
Catalytic reforming is the core of the aromatics complex in the 
refinery. 
This 
process 
uses 
naphtha 
containing 
C6-C11 
hydrocarbons as raw materials, under certain operating conditions 
and 
catalysts, 
the 
molecular 
structure 
of 
raw 
materials 
(hydrocarbons) is rearranged, so that cycloalkanes and alkanes are 
converted into aromatic hydrocarbons or is paraffins, producing 
light aromatics and/or high-octane gasoline, while by-producing 
hydrogen. The main operating factors affecting the reforming 
reaction are: catalyst performance, reaction temperature, reaction 
pressure, hydrogen-hydrocarbon ratio, space velocity, etc. 
The catalytic reforming unit usually includes three units: raw 
material pre-hydrogenation, reforming reaction system, and 
reforming fractionation system. Among them, the reforming 
reaction system mainly includes two categories: semi regenerative 
process of fixed bed reactor and the continuous regenerative 
process of moving bed reactor. Figure 3-1 is the process flow 
diagram of a continuous catalytic reforming unit.
--- pag 28 ---
InPlant APC Sales Technical Manual 
 
25 
Figure 3-1 Process Flow Diagram of a Continuous Reforming Unit 
The raw materials are mixed with circulating hydrogen through the 
pre-hydrogenation raw material vessel and heated to about 
315~340 ℃ (depending on the composition of the raw materials) by 
the furnace. Through the reaction, the impurities harmful to the 
catalyst of the reforming unit are removed. The materials after the 
reaction are separated in the separator, the separated hydrogen is 
recycled. The hydrocarbon enters the stripper and the depentanizer 
to extract light components and water, and will be used as the raw 
materials of the reforming unit. Raw materials that meet the 
requirements after analyzing can enter the reforming unit. The heat 
exchanger is a mixed heat exchanger where the feed and 
circulating hydrogen are mixed and exchanged with the outlet 
effluence of the fourth reactor. The mixture enters the four-in-one 
furnace and the four-in-one reactor successively (from the first 
furnace and reactor to the fourth furnace and reactor respectively). 
The reacted liquid and gas are separated in the gas-liquid
--- pag 29 ---
InPlant APC Sales Technical Manual 
 
26 
separator, and the pentane and other fractions are removed 
through the stabilizer after secondary recontact as the raw 
materials for aromatic hydrocarbon extraction. 
3.1.2 Production and Operation Status 
The reforming unit is a system with multivariable, strong coupling 
and multiple objective constraints. Although the conventional DCS 
plus manual control mode has solved the problem of continuous 
production of the unit to a certain extent, and has also met certain 
stability requirements, it is difficult to achieve further optimization of 
the unit's operating conditions, meet the requirements for higher 
stability, not to mention labor intensity reduction, energy 
conservation and consumption and tapping potential and 
increasing efficiency. At present, the problems mainly exist in 
reforming production are as follows: 
1.The feed load and composition of the reforming unit fluctuate 
greatly, and it is difficult to control smoothly. 
The production process of the reforming unit is relatively complex, 
and its control is equivalent to a typical process with large delay, 
constraints, and multivariable strong coupling. In addition, a variety 
of external disturbance from raw materials, heating, and cooling 
further increase the difficulty of implementing optimal control. 
2.There are many disturbance factors in the reforming unit, and 
process parameters and product quality fluctuate greatly. 
Since the unit does not have an online analyzer, it is unable to 
indicate the quality of key products in real time. Operators need to 
adjust the product quality based on experience and laboratory 
analysis data, resulting in a lag in product quality control, as well as 
fluctuations of process parameters and product quality in the
--- pag 30 ---
InPlant APC Sales Technical Manual 
 
27 
adjustment process. 
3.The pressure and composition of fuel gas vary greatly, causing 
large fluctuations in unit production. 
The pressure and composition of fuel gas in the reforming unit vary 
greatly. As a result of these events, the pressure and negative 
pressure of each furnace, the outlet temperature of the furnace, 
and the tray temperature and liquid level of each distillation column 
fluctuated significantly, thus destroying the balance of the entire 
production, causing fluctuations and greatly reducing the 
consistency of product quality. 
4.High energy integration and serious coupling of key variables. 
A large number of thermal integration processes are adopted in the 
reforming unit, which greatly improves the thermal energy 
utilization rate of the unit and reduces the energy consumption of 
the unit. However, the application of the thermal integration process 
also brings the characteristics of the complex heat exchange 
network and serious coupling of key process parameters, which 
puts forward higher requirements for the smooth operation of the 
unit. At the same time, due to the serious coupling of variables, the 
disturbance effect of heat source fluctuations on the whole unit is 
greatly enhanced, which greatly increases the difficulty of 
decoupling and the labor intensity of operators. 
5.The labor intensity of operators is high, and it is difficult to 
optimize the process operation. 
Due to the characteristics of the production process of the 
reforming unit, the operators should not only deal with the on-site 
problems, but also control the product quality and consumption 
indicators during the shift. This brings lots of works for operators to 
ensure the stable production of the production unit, so it is difficult
--- pag 31 ---
InPlant APC Sales Technical Manual 
 
28 
to have more time to consider the optimization of the operation. At 
the same time, there are also certain differences in the operation 
adjustment between each shift, and it is difficult to ensure 
consistency. Therefore, in the face of the reforming unit which is a 
system with many interference factors and complex variable 
coupling relations, conventional control technology cannot achieve 
the overall optimization. 
In summary, in order to promote the improvement of the control 
level of the reforming unit, it is necessary to apply intelligent control 
technology to improve the comprehensive automation level and 
production efficiency of the reforming unit, better product quality, 
and achieve energy conservation and consumption reduction.

Due to the strong correlation and coupling between the process 
parameters and the upstream-downstream plants, the operation 
adjustment based on manual experience alone cannot effectively 
improve the timeliness, accuracy, stability and consistency of 
production and operation, and can no longer meet the production 
needs of high efficiency and quality. 
At present, the intelligent operation is urgently demanded for the 
high efficiency and quality production of ethylene plant. Clean and 
efficient production of the ethylene plant can be realized by 
coordinating and balancing the reaction zone and fractionation

energy consumption.

requirements of ethylene plant, the advanced control system is

influence of factors such as strong coupling of variables in the 
system, nonlinearity, large lag, load change, and fuel gas calorific 
value fluctuation, so as to achieve stable control of various process 
parameters of plant, improve automation level, and reduce labor 
intensity. Based on this, energy conservation and consumption 
reduction are realized through process indicators optimization and

Optimize the operation of distillation column system to implement

COT 
temperature is one of the key indicators of the cracking furnace. Its 
stability determines the production status of the cracking furnace 
and significantly impacts ethylene yield. Therefore, the premise of 
optimizing the cracking depth lies in more accurately controlling the 
COT temperature of cracking furnace and keeping a smaller 
fluctuation range. The outlet temperature of the cracking furnace is 
affected by many factors, such as the change of fuel flow, pressure, 
calorific value, and the feed flow, pressure and dilution ratio of each 
furnace tube. There are many factors that interfere with each other. 
Through the prediction model, the system can better solve the

Branch balance. The system will reasonably distribute the load of 
each branch furnace tube according to the COT temperature 
distribution of each branch furnace tube. At the same time, in order 
to ensure the stability of COT temperature, the fuel gas and oxygen 
consumption will be automatically matched, while meeting the 
requirements of COT stability and cracking furnace processing 
capacity adjustment requirements. 
Optimizing cracking furnace efficiency. The energy consumption 
of the cracking furnace accounts for more than 60% of the total 
energy consumption of the ethylene plant. Improving the 
combustion efficiency of the cracking furnace to reduce energy 
consumption is a significant benefit point of optimal control of the 
cracking furnace. The advanced control strategy is to keep the

of meeting other requirements such as COT temperature. When 
the oxygen content of flue gas exceeds the setting range, the 
system automatically adjusts the furnace negative pressure setting 
value to realize control. It is a significant way of reducing energy 
consumption to optimize the combustion efficiency of the furnace to 
ensure the optimal combustion conditions of cracking furnace 
chamber. However, if the oxygen content is too low, the fuel gas will 
fail to burn completely. 
The automatic load adjustment of cracking furnace group. 
Uniformly adjust the load according to the command (available for 
the configuration adjustment such as transition time). When 
changing the raw material processing amount, the system will 
reasonably distribute the flow of each tube of the cracking furnace 
according to current operating conditions, while ensuring the 
stability of COT temperature. It will automatically match the fuel gas 
and oxygen consumption, so as to minimize the impact of the flow 
change on the outlet temperature of the cracking furnace. 
Optimizing and pushing to the limit of steam-to-hydrocarbon 
ratio. The main function of dilution steam is to appropriately reduce 
the partial reaction pressure of hydrocarbons in the furnace tube 
with the premise of unchanged total pressure in the cracking 
furnace, thus providing the optimal conditions of cracking reaction 
and reducing the coking rate. However, if the steam-to-hydrocarbon 
ratio is increased to a certain extent, the amount of steam and 
energy consumption will increase, which is not conducive to the 
reaction. Therefore, the model prediction is used to optimize the 
steam-to-hydrocarbon ratio so that the cracking reaction can be 
carried out in the optimal status.

Control strategy: 
The purpose of distillation process control is to reduce the loss of 
target products and improve product quality. In general, the 
following effects can be achieved by implementing the advanced

control of the distillation plant. On the premise of ensuring the 
safety and stability of the plant, the automation level of distillation 
plant will be improved, the anti-interference ability of the plant will 
be enhanced, the stability rate of key process parameters will be 
increased, the operation of the distillation column will be optimized, 
the cutting accuracy of target products will be improved, the 
extraction rate of high value products (propylene and ethylene) will 
be raised, and the energy consumption of the plant and labor

Ethylene distillation process control includes high and low pressure 
depropanizer, pre-demethanizer and demethanizer, deethanizer, 
debutanizer, ethylene distillation column, propylene distillation 
column, etc. 
Ethylene distillation process is carried out under certain constraints. 
Therefore, the control requirements of ethylene distillation can be 
considered from the aspects of quality indicators, product output, 
energy consumption and constraints, such as quality objectives, 
material balance, energy balance and condition constraints. 
Pushing to the limit the quality indicator of the distillation 
column. It refers to the purity of products at the top or bottom of 
each distillation column. Generally, the top product quality should 
reach the specified purity, while the purity of bottom product is 
maintained within the specified range. With stable conditions of raw 
materials and tower operating, the appropriate reflux ratio can 
ensure the qualified product quality and give consideration to unit 
operation energy consumption. Specifically, according to the 
distribution characteristics of components in distillation column, 
combined with previous production process data and detection 
values, the influence relationship between product quality and
--- pag 48 ---
InPlant APC Sales Technical Manual 
 
45 
distillation column process data is obtained, and the trend of 
product quality changes with operating conditions in the actual 
production process can be predicted. And the system can 
automatically adjust reflux flow to ensure the quality indicator 
requirements of tower bottom and tower top. Among them, the 
tower top and bottom temperatures are the key temperatures, 
because these two temperatures reflect the changes of product 
quality components. 
Material balance control of the distillation column. The balance 
of inlet and outlet materials. Specifically, the extraction at the top 
and bottom of the distillation column shall be balanced with the feed, 
so as to maintain the normal and stable operation of the distillation 
column and the coordination of the upstream and downstream 
process. The control of material balance is aimed at the stable 
liquid level (within the specified upper and lower limits) between the 
condensing vessel (reflux drum) and the tower bottom. 
Indicators of energy balance and economic balance. It is 
required to ensure the quality of distillation products and product 
output, and consider energy conservation and distillation column 
energy balance. At the same time, in order to avoid the excess 
quality of the distillation column and the waste of energy, the reflux 
in the column is gently optimized and adjusted within a reasonable 
product quality range to minimize the reflux and energy 
consumption, with the premise of ensuring product quality and 
considering the current operating conditions and the historical data 
trend. 
Constraints for safe and stable operation of the distillation 
column. Ethylene distillation is a complex mass and heat transfer 
process. The operating parameters of the distillation column is
--- pag 49 ---
InPlant APC Sales Technical Manual 
 
46 
constrained for stable and safe operation. Vapor phase velocity 
limit, for instance, stipulates the maximum limit of the rising vapor 
velocity of the distillation column. When the rising velocity is too 
high, a mist zone will be formed, the liquid on the tray fails to flow 
downward, and the vapor components of the lower tray will flow 
back to the upper tray, causing a flooding. Vapor phase velocity 
minimum limit stipulates the minimum limit of the rising vapor 
velocity of the distillation column. When the rising vapor velocity is 
too low, the rising vapor cannot hold up the upper liquid phase, 
causing liquid leakage, reducing the plate efficiency, and the 
rectification fails to be carried out normally. Operating pressure limit 
determines the upper limit of operating pressure for each distillation 
column. Critical temperature limit is defined to ensure the normal 
heat transfer of distillation column and appropriate reflux 
temperature to enable the normal operation of distillation column. 
And ethylene distillation is the main user of refrigeration system, 
therefore, a close thermal correlation connects distillation columns 
and refrigeration system. Changes in distillation column operation, 
such as fluctuation in reflux, product extraction or column pressure, 
will significantly affect the operating load of ethylene or propylene 
compressor. On the other hand, the change of compressor outlet 
temperature and pressure will affect the heat exchange effect of 
distillation condenser and reboiler. 
Reducing the load of ethylene and propylene compressor to 
realize energy conservation. Reduce heat load at the bottom of 
distillation column group, on the premise of ensuring the smooth 
and stable operation of column and the quality of the products 
extracted from the bottom or top of distillation column. Optimize top 
reflux of distillation column group to reduce the cooling load of top
--- pag 50 ---
InPlant APC Sales Technical Manual 
 
47 
column. The operating load of ethylene and propylene machine is 
optimized therefore. 
In summary, the column system optimization strategy is mainly 
divided into three levels: 
First: Decoupling the transfer of material flow and energy flow, 
coordinating and balancing the materials and energy transition of 
adjacent links 
Second: Executing stable and push-to-the-limit control within each 
control unit (each column) to ensure the compliance of the 
indicators and product quality of each unit 
Third: Coordinating the constraint requirements of each control unit, 
reducing the consumption of cooling and heating medium of each 
control unit within the constraint range, and realizing the 
push-to-the-limit to improve the yield of ethylene and propylene.

4.2. Configuration Guide 
Advanced control system deploys on DCS, with a host computer, 
and the software is divided into desktop version software and web 
version software, each of which requires a server. The operating 
system is recommended to be Microsoft Windows Server 2019, 
which is also compatible with Windows Server 2016, Windows 
Server 2022, and Windows 10 Enterprise Edition. The desktop 
version of the software needs to be installed on the APC server, 
which serves as the working platform for implementing the 
advanced control system. The web version of the software needs to 
be installed on a separate APC performance monitoring server for 
APC performance monitoring and optimization. The operation 
screen of the advanced control system is added to the DCS system 
operation station as the APC operation station. The operator can 
easily realize the commissioning and removal of the advanced 
control system and the adjustment of related process parameters 
by switching and simple operation of the operation screen on the 
operation station. The network structure of the advanced process 
control system is that the advanced control host computer is

APEX (Advanced Process Engineering eXpert) is a process simulation software based on Equation

Operation and Re-design, aiming to achieve the purpose of production safety and improving 
efficiency.

Script Editor 
Section 1 Software Overview 
VFScript uses VBScript as programming language. It is used to edit graphic script. 
VBScript is a subset of Visual Basic, and easy to learn which only remains a few key words from 
Visual Basic, thus greatly simplifies the grammar of Visual Basic. VBScript can be mastered in 
short time even for those who have no experience in it. 
In addition, VBScript has the performance of high security, easy to transplant and so on. VFScript 
is a unique part of VFDraw, realizing much more functions by applying flexible script to supervision 
software. 
All the functions of VFScript will be available only after VFDraw has started. The postfix of script 
files is .vbs, and one graphics corresponds to one .vbs file with the same name. 
1.1 Function Feature 
 
Use standard VBScript language and extended interface of graphics operation is 
added. 
 
Be built in VFDraw and usually used in VFDraw interface. 
 
Support grammar lightening and function online prompt. 
 
Support event guide. 
 
Support VBScript syntax check.

Section 2 Interface Introduction 
Users can start up VFScript by selecting the VFDraw menu [Tool/ Edit the Script] or by 
right-clicking at the blank of graphics edit interface and selecting “Edit the Script” in the 
right-click menu. As shown in Figure 2-1, its interface includes Title Bar, Menu Bar, Script 
Edit Area, Script Information Area, Status Bar and so on. 
 
Figure 2-1 VFScript interface 
2.1 Title Bar 
Title bar displays the name of current file, and if there is a “*” behind the file name, it means that 
the script file hasn’t been saved after modifying. 
There are three operation icons of “maximize”, “minimize” and “close” for users to set the size of 
the window. 
2.2 Menu Bar 
There are six menu items in the menu bar. They are File, Edit, Debug, Setting, View and Help. The 
shortcut letter of menu item is displayed in the bracket of right. The menu item and its submenu 
can be opened by pressing “ALT+ letter” simultaneously. 
2.2.1 File 
File menu includes “Save”, “Save As”, “Print”, “Exit” and so on.

Graphics will only load .vbs script files which have the same file name, so after saving the

can be used to make sure whether the VBScript engine in Windows is installed 
correctly; if there’s any problem, reinstall the corresponding module of Windows or 
reinstall an operating system of correct version should be executed.

Section 4 VFScript Application Example 
4.1 Event Function 
4.1.1 OnLButtonUp 
Left Button Up Event, the event will be operated when the left mouse button is released from 
graphics object. 
For example, round rectangle will rotate 60 degrees when left mouse button is released. 
Draw a button “Button1” and a round rectangle “RoundRect1”, edit script for “Button1” is shown as 
follows: 
Sub Button1_OnLButtonUp(nFlag, x, y) 
RoundRect1.Angle = 60 
End Sub 
The round rectangle will rotate 60 degrees when left mouse button is released from ”button1”of 
monitoring window. 
4.1.2 OnLButtonDown 
Left Button Down Event, the event will be operated when the left mouse button is pressed on 
graphics object. 
For example, rectangle will rotate 30 degrees when left mouse button is pressed. 
Draw a button “Button1” and a rectangle “Rect1”, edit script for “Button1” is shown as follows: 
Sub Button1_OnLButtonDown(nFlag, x, y) 
Rect1.Angle = 30 
End Sub 
The rectangle will rotate 30 degrees when left mouse button is pressed on “button1” of monitoring 
window. 
4.1.3 OnLButtonDblClk 
Double Click Left Button Event, the event will be operated when double-clicking the left mouse 
button on graphics object. 
For example, the bottom edge value of ellipse will be 200 when double-clicking the left mouse
--- pag 23 ---

19
button. 
Draw a button “Button1” and an ellipse “Ellipse1”, edit script for “Button1” is shown as follows: 
Sub Button1_OnLButtonDblClk(nFlag, x, y) 
Ellipse1.Bottom = 200 
End Sub 
The bottom edge value of ellipse will be set as 200 when double-clicking “button1” of monitoring 
window. 
4.1.4 OnRButtonClk 
Click right Button Event, the event will be operated when right-clicking the graphics object. 
For example, the pipe will be set in layer 2 when right-clicking the mouse button. 
Draw a button “Button1” and a pipe “Pipe1”, edit script for “Button1” is shown as follows: 
Sub Button1_OnRButtonClk(nFlag, x, y) 
Pipe1.Layer = 2 
End Sub 
The pipe will be set in layer 2 when right-clicking “button1” of monitoring window. 
4.1.5 OnMouseMove 
Move Mouse Event: the event will be operated when moving the mouse on graphics object. 
For example, the width of the polygon will plus 5 when moving the mouse 
Draw a button “Button1” and a polygon “Polygon1”, edit script for “Button1” is shown as follows: 
Sub Button1_OnMouseMove(nFlag, x, y) 
Polygon1. Width= Polygon1. Width +5 
End Sub 
The width of the polygon will plus 5 when moving the mouse once on ”Button1” of monitoring 
window. 
4.1.6 OnMouseEnter 
Mouse Enter Event: the event will be operated when the mouse pointer moves into the graphics 
object.
--- pag 24 ---

20
For example, the pie will hide when the mouse moves into the button. 
Draw a button “Button1” and a pie “Pie1”, edit script for “Button1” is shown as follows: 
Sub Button1_OnMouseEnter() 
Pie1.Visible = False 
End Sub 
The pie will hide when the mouse moves into the “Button1” area in monitoring window. 
4.1.7 OnMouseLeave 
Mouse Leave Event: the event will be operated when the mouse moves out from the graphics 
object. 
For example, the text will be centered when the mouse moves out from the button object. 
Draw a button “Button1” and add a text object “text1”, edit script for “Button1” is shown as follows: 
Sub Button1_OnMouseLeave() 
Text1.Align = 2 
End Sub 
The Text1 will be centered when the mouse moves out from the “Button1” in monitoring window. 
4.1.8 OnOpenPic 
Execute OnOpenPic function when opening pop-up graphics. 
For example: AI03040001 tag value will add 1 when opening pop-up graphics 1.PIC. 
Add following script to pop-up graphics 1.PIC:

TAG("AI03040001.PV")=TAG("AI03040001.PV")+1 
 
End Sub 
4.1.9 OnClosePic 
Execute OnClosePic function when closing pop-up graphics. 
For example: AI03040001 tag value will reduce 1 when opening pop-up graphics 1.PIC. 
Add following script to pop-up graphics 1.PIC:
--- pag 25 ---

21

TAG("AI03040001.PV")=TAG("AI03040001.PV")-1

OnTime Event in timer: start timer 
For example: display the current time. 
Draw a button “Button1”, text “text2” and a timer “timer1”, edit script for “timer1” and “Botton1” is 
shown as follows:

i=3000

If Button1.Text="stop timing" Then

VF Multi-Project Management 
 1
VF Multi-Project Management 
Section 1 Overview 
VisualField (VF) system software can be applied to configure control system and monitor in 
ECS-700 system, which supports multi-project management, including "Multi-project Switch" and 
"Multi-project Reference". Multi-project switch supports remote configuration and remote 
monitoring operation. Multi-project reference supports trans-project configuration and multi-project 
joint configuration, to achieve the joint monitoring of multi-project. 
Multi-project management supports 32 projects, 128 operation domains (less than 50 reference 
operation domain is recommended) and data scale of 500 thousands points. In Windows 7and 
OptiPlex XE2, it supports 128 reference operation domains. The problem that turning page of 
trend or graphics slow still exists, so user can choose to limit the reference domains number below 
80 (but not 128) to speed up. 
VisualField supports 3 types of multi-project management: 
 
Mutual reference between different operation domains in the same project (replace the 
original trans-domain drive function): 
 
Figure 1-1 Mutual reference between different operation domains in the same project 
 
Mutual reference between of operation domains in different projects (both way connected 
mode):
--- pag 5 ---
VF Multi-Project Management 
 2
 
Figure 1-2 Mutual reference between operation domains in different projects 
 
Global project references operation domains of several referenced projects (upper and 
lower layers connected mode). 
 
Figure 1-3 Global project references operation domains of several referenced projects 
1.1 Basic Flow of Multi-Project Management 
Multi-project management is based on the original function of VisualField system software and 
strengthens the functions of remote monitoring, joint configuration and monitoring. Considering the 
commonality and complexity of DCS, multi-project management function and matching 
parameters should be set as required in application. For example: which projects should be 
performed multi-project joint configuration and monitoring in application, which projects and tag 
information should be configured in global project, whether the global engineer station and global 
operator station of multi-project switch function should be configured, etc. 
Configuration of multi-project is proceeded in an orderly way and applies several software 
comprehensive. The configuration and monitoring for integrated system can be completed 
gradually to control satisfy the technical requirements of system when configuring control system 
by VisualField system software. 
1.2 Multi-Project Management Flow 
Multi-project management flow is introduced by the example "Global project references several
--- pag 6 ---
VF Multi-Project Management 
 3
referenced projects". The configuration flows of "Reference among different operation domains in 
the same project" and "Reference among operation domains in different projects" are similar. 
1.2.1 Overall Flow 
Multi-project management flow includes 2 steps overall: 1) plan global project and divide network; 
2) Configure project and global project. 
Step 1: plan global project and divide network 
Confirm the overall architecture and network topology of global project and referenced projects, 
and the reference of global project to referenced project. 
Step 2: Configure project and global project. 
Configure the referenced projects first, then configure the global project according to the 
application requirements of multi-project. The configuration flow of project is same with general 
project (please refer to Project Configuration Guide). Configuration flow of global project is shown 
below. 
 
Figure 1-4 Configuration flow of global project 
1.2.2 Procedures 
Here takes "Global project references operation domains of several referenced function projects" 
as an example to introduce the configuration flow. 
Configure several referenced projects and publish, then configure the global project. 
Design Project 
Confirm which tags in each referenced project should be performed with joint control and 
monitored in global project. 
Configure System Structure 
Configure the multi-project referenced project and reference domain.
--- pag 7 ---
VF Multi-Project Management 
 4
Configure Operation Domain 
Configure reference tag and reference graphics trans-domain. 
Set Operation Team 
Set the operation teams of all operator stations. Different operation teams can observe and edit 
different graphics, reports and custom keys, etc. Operation team settings are good for dividing 
operator responsibilities, and can simplify the operation and highlight the monitoring key points. 
Edit Resource File 
In global project configuration, edit resources file only edit the reference graphics and point group 
configuration. 
Publish Configuration 
Publish configuration on the engineer station of global project. 
1.3 Dongle Authority 
 
Authority is installed in the operation station with multi-project monitoring. Multi-project 
authority is not required by operation domain server of referenced project. 
 
Dongle authority is not required for configuring multi-project reference. 
 
When operation domains in the same project reference mutually, the data can be 
displayed normally without authority. 
 
Multi-project monitoring needs authority, or the referenced real-time data is shown as 
"bad", and no real-time alarm. While the history alarm, history trend and operation log of 
referenced domain can be searched normally, and the history data can be updated 
normally. 
 
VF software scan soft dongle every one minute. Software dongle authorization can only 
be restored in one minute after the software dongle is inserted and it can only go into 
ineffective in one minute after the software dongle is pulled out.
--- pag 8 ---
VF Multi-Project Management 
 5
Section 2 Apply Multi-project Management 
After introducing the "Multi-project Management Range" and "Multi-project Management Limited 
Function", this section will introduce how to apply the multi-project management and the operation 
steps by a project as example according to multi-project management flow. 
2.1 Range of Multi-project Management 
The range of trans-domain reference can be achieved by multi-project management includes: 
real-time data, graphics, real-time alarm, alarm acknowledge and alarm silence synchronization, 
monitoring user authority, operation record, history trend and history alarm. 
Operation station with multi-project monitoring function can monitor the real-time data of 
referenced project in graphics, trend, tuning group, data viewer, overview window, schedule, 
custom key, sound of special tag alarm, print, enable tag of alarm region, tag of alarm panel, tag of 
extend configuration, tag associated graphics and tag associated trend. 
Operation guide and report don't support to reference tag. 
Referenced graphics cannot be modified, but supports to be saved locally. 
2.2 Limited Functions of Multi-project Management 
Operation node monitored by multi-project doesn't support functions below: 
 
Not support the SAMS function of referenced project. 
 
Not support to search the fault diagnosis information of referenced project. 
 
Not support level 2 nesting reference, only support level 1 reference. 
Operation node with multi-project monitoring only provides data of this domain. The third party 
communication of referenced domain, such as OPC\ MODBUS, and SAMS function are provided 
by referenced project. 
2.3 Prepare Multi-project Management 
1. Install the software VisualField. 
2. Prepare for the project. The referenced project should be configured complete before 
multi-project management. This section takes "A global project references 2 referenced 
project" as an example.
--- pag 9 ---
VF Multi-Project Management 
 6
 
Tip: 
VF V3.2 can reference project of SP05HOT7, while old version cannot reference project of 
new version. 
 
2.4 Topology of Multi-Project Management 
 
Figure 2-1 System Topology 
2.5 Configure System Structure 
Add Referenced Project 
Run VFSysBuilder and create a new global project (FBD_TEST), right-click "Referenced Project" 
to add the referenced projects Ver450200, FAR2 and 700neo20211018.
--- pag 10 ---
VF Multi-Project Management 
 7
 
Figure 2-2 Add referenced project 
Configure Referenced Project 
Input IP address of Ver450200 project configuration server, confirm and the project name and all 
operation domain information of the referenced project will be shown directly. Repeat the 
operation above for FAR2 and 700neo20211018.
--- pag 11 ---
VF Multi-Project Management 
 8
 
Figure 2-3 Input name and description 
Update Configuration 
After adding the referenced project, if its configuration is modified or changed, user can update 
configuration of referenced project by refreshing. User can refresh a single referenced project or 
refresh referenced projects in batch via right-click menu. 
2.6 Configure Operation Domain 
Operation domain configuration is completed in VFHMICfg except for "Add reference domain". 
2.6.1 Add Reference Domain 
Open VFSysBuilder of global project, right-click an operation domain in operation domain 
configuration and add reference domain (the reference domain cannot be added if the operation 
domain is locked).
--- pag 12 ---
VF Multi-Project Management 
 9
 
Figure 2-4 Add reference domain 
Select reference operation domain to be added from the "Reference Operation Domain" dialog 
pops up. Double-click the operation domain to add, and the reference operation domain added will 
be shown as "Project Name+ Operation Domain Alias".
--- pag 13 ---
VF Multi-Project Management 
 
10
 
Figure 2-5 Reference operation domain 
After adding reference domain, configure by operations below. 
1. Open the referenced operation domain from configuration server. 
2. Configure the operation team, monitoring authority, domain variable, history trend and 
resource file for referenced domain. 
2.6.2 Monitoring User Authority 
After referencing the project, the referenced project can be observed with default observer 
authority. 
After the reference project sets the monitoring user of referenced project as built-in user, the alarm 
acknowledge authority and tag group authority of built-in user are copied to global station, while 
other authorities cannot be copied. 
Monitoring user with low authority can set monitoring user of high authority. 
Alarm acknowledge authority and tag group authority of built-in user cannot be modified in global 
station. Alarm acknowledge and tag write value of the referenced project and global station are 
synchronized. Please configure the user authority carefully. 
2.6.3 Configure Operation Team 
Add operation team, each can reference trans-domain information from overview window, data 
viewer window, tuning group window, trend window, graphics and schedule. 
2.6.4 Configure Graphics 
There are 2 ways to configure graphics: 1) draw a new graphics again; 2) Directly reference the
--- pag 14 ---
VF Multi-Project Management 
 
11
graphics from operation domains of referenced projects Ver450200, FAR2 and 700neo20211018. 
Drawing a new graphics is same with common project, Please refer to Graphics Builder User 
Manual. 
Configure graphics in operation domains of Ver450200, FAR2 or Ver450200 as below: 
Create a new graphics in VFHMICfg, click 
 to select graphics file. 
Select graphics in operation domains of Ver450200, FAR2 or 700neo20211018. 
 
Figure 2-6 Select graphics in operation domains of 700neo20211018. 
Edit referenced graphics locally, which will not modify the original graphics in operation domains of 
700neo20211018. 
After select successfully, the information is shown below. 
 
Figure 2-7 Graphics information
--- pag 15 ---
VF Multi-Project Management 
 
12
 
Tips: 
In the referred graphics, the dynamic actions including "Open Picture", "Pop-up Picture" and 
others only can be executed when the pictures are in the current operation station. 
 
2.6.5 Configure Trans-Domain Alarm 
If the current operation domain has reference domain, user can perform alarm management for 
tags in reference domain. Operation steps are shown below: 
1. Right-click an operation team from the configuration tree and select "Add Referenced 
Domain Alarm", to add a node of trans-domain alarm to the configuration tree with the 
icon 
. 
2. Double-click "Referenced Domain Alarm Settings" to pop up a dialog as shown in Figure 
2-8. 
 
Figure 2-8 Referenced Domain Alarm Settings 
3. Configure trans-domain alarm region in "Referenced Domain Alarm Region Settings" 
dialog.
--- pag 16 ---
VF Multi-Project Management 
 
13
 
Select "Alarm Disabled" to disable all trans-domain alarms. 
 
Select "Alarm All" to disable all trans-domain alarms. 
Select "Alarm Part" to enable the "Alarm Region Settings", and configure the alarm enable region 
of trans-domain as required, i.e. select the check box of alarm region to be enabled. 
Select "Alarm Part" to subscribe to specific tag again. 
1. Click "+" and the tag selector pops up. 
2. Select tag to be subscribed in tag selector, and go back to "Referenced Domain Alarm 
Region Settings" dialog. 
 
Tip: 
Trans-domain alarm settings are combination of alarm enable region settings and 
subscription tag settings, i.e. they are in relationship of OR. 
 
Trans-domain alarm configuration supports to subscribe single alarm. User can select a single 
trans-domain tag alarm to be subscribed, whose alarm tag information will be shown in 
"Referenced Domain Alarm Region Settings" dialog. 
2.6.6 Alarm Panel 
Multi-project management in alarm panel only supports tag trans-domain reference, but not the 
trans-domain configuration of graphics and alarm enable region. Open the tag selector and add 
reference tag in alarm panel.
--- pag 17 ---
VF Multi-Project Management 
 
14
 
Figure 2-9 Add tag of reference domain 
2.6.7 Tag Associated Graphics 
Tag can associate graphics via the tag in operation domains of referenced projects Ver450200, 
FAR2 and 700neo20211018.
--- pag 18 ---
VF Multi-Project Management 
 
15
 
Figure 2-10 Tag associates graphics via the tag in operation domain 
When selecting graphics to be associated, if the domain of graphics has already been referenced, 
user can select different domain alias to associate the graphics trans-domain.
--- pag 19 ---
VF Multi-Project Management 
 
16
 
Figure 2-11 Select graphics to be associated 
Domain alias of graphics is shown in "Alias of Referenced Domain" bar. 
2.6.8 Tag Associated Trend 
Tag can associate trend via the tag in operation domains of referenced projects Ver450200, FAR2 
and 700neo20211018.
--- pag 20 ---
VF Multi-Project Management 
 
17
 
Figure 2-12 Tag associates trend window 
2.7 Real-time Monitoring 
After completing the global project configuration, publish it and start the monitoring. 
1. In monitoring software, all tags selected from tag selector can be selected trans-domain. 
The panel and real-time trend of reference tag can be open via the tag selector in 
monitoring software. 
2. Trans-domain operation log can be searched in operation station of global project.
--- pag 21 ---
VF Multi-Project Management 
 
18
Fi
gure 2-13 Search trans-domain operation log 
3. When displaying tag alarms of Ver450200, FAR2 and 700neo20211018 in operation 
station of global project, it can acknowledge the tag alarms. After that, alarms of that tag 
in Ver450200, FAR2 and 700neo20211018 are acknowledged simultaneously. 
4. Real-time display of status table and operation for multi-project trans-domain tag are 
supported in operation station of global project. 
 
Figure 2-14 Real-time status table
--- pag 22 ---
VF Multi-Project Management 
 
19
Section 3 Multi-project Switch 
3.1 Global Option Settings 
Run VFSetup, and select "Support multi-project switchover". 
 
Figure 3-1 Support multi-project switch 
Click "Configure" to open the multi-project switch settings interface, in which user can add the IP 
address of remote project configuration server to be switched (several IP addresses of remote 
project configuration servers can be added). After added successfully, the IP addresses and
--- pag 23 ---
VF Multi-Project Management 
 
20
self-defined description of all configuration servers will be shown in the dialog. 
The added IP addresses and description of configuration servers can be modified or deleted at all 
times. 
 
Figure 3-2 Add configuration server 
3.2 Global Engineer Station 
Global engineer station means that one or several engineer stations can be configured in global 
project, for remote configuration management of referenced projects. The station can login 
configured configuration server by corresponding user authority. After login the project 
configuration server, the local engineer can design, modify, online download and publish 
configuration the remote configuration, etc. 
Open VFExplorer of global engineer station, and select configuration server address from the 
"Configuration Server" pops up, and login with the user name and password of engineer with 
operation authority. For example: IP address of global engineer station is 172.30.11.139. 
Configuration server IP address of referenced project is 172.30.11.211. Engineer user name is 
"supcon", and the password is "supcondcs". Login global engineer station by this engineer, then 
user can configure the referenced project.
--- pag 24 ---
VF Multi-Project Management 
 
21
 
Figure 3-3 Login interface when multi-project switch 
3.3 Global Operator Station 
Global operator station means that one or several operator stations can be configured in global 
project, to monitor the real-time condition of operation domains in several referenced projects 
remote. Operator login in global operator station has the same operation authority with that 
monitoring the domain locally. 
After configuring the multi-project switch, run monitoring software in global operator station after 
select configuration. Select the configuration server IP address of operation domain to be 
monitored in "Configuration Server" bar. As shown below. 
If the configuration information of global operator station isn't consistent with configuration server, 
a prompt of whether update configuration will pop up. Click "OK" and a prompt of "Updating 
configuration" will be shown in "Update Information" bar. After update completed, the prompt bar 
will show as "Update configuration successfully". 
After update configuration completed, user can select corresponding operation domain. Select 
"Supervision Software" and click "OK" to start the monitoring software. 
Login the operation team by name and password of operator with operation domain authority, to 
achieve remote real-time monitoring and operation.
--- pag 25 ---
VF Multi-Project Management 
 
22
 
Figure 3-4 Configuration select interface of multi-project switch 
 
Tips: 
 
Global engineer station/ global operation station cannot be OPC server. 
 
The VF software in global station and remote configuration server should be in same 
version.
--- pag 26 ---
VF Multi-Project Management 
 
23
Section 4 Performance 
Index 
of 
Multi-project 
Management 
Performance of global station is related to the scale of reference data. 
 
Monitoring operation time will be below 1s in the scales of 100 thousands points and 200 
thousand points, and the turning page of project typical graphics is about 1s. 
 
In the scale of 500 thousand points, the monitoring operation is below 1s, turning page for 
project typical graphics and searching tag in tag selector need 2~3s. 
Performance of global station is related to the quantity of reference alarm. 
 
When 4 of the 17 projects have more than 3000 avalanche alarms, monitoring of global 
station can still work normally. 
 
When 16 projects have more than 3000 avalanche alarms, turning page for graphics in 
global station needs about 3~9s, monitoring performance becomes worse. 
Operation domain being referenced will not influence the performance of computer and 
software in referenced operation domain. 
 
When 4 operation nodes with multi-project monitoring authority access data 
simultaneously, the CPU of operation domain will have 5% instantaneous increment and 
then fall back. 
 
Network load of information network changes with the access data quantity. Network load 
for 2500 points real-time data of graphics is about 0.5% 100Mbps, and for displaying 20 
thousand points’ tags in tag selector is 4% 100Mbps. 
Real-time monitoring performance of reference project has nothing to do with quantity of 
reference operation domain (below 50 reference domains). 
 
The monitoring performance of referencing 200 thousand points data from 5 or 10 
operation domains are same. 
 
Performance of history data inquiry is influenced by the performance of referenced 
operation domain. 
 
Information network load of reference project is influenced by current access data 
quantity, and has nothing to do with the whole data scale of referenced project.
--- pag 27 ---
VF Multi-Project Management 
 
24
Section 5 Notes 
5.1 Name Repeat 
Please pay attention to name repeat when referencing several projects: 
 
Project name repeat: not support name repeat of referenced project. 
 
Operation domain name repeat: not support domain alias repeat of operation domain, but 
support name repeat of operation domain. 
 
Control domain name repeat: name repeat of control domain is not recommended. 
 
Control station name repeat: not support name repeat of control station and IP address. 
 
Name repeat of operation station: name repeat of operation node is not recommended, 
not support name repeat of IP address. 
 
Tag name repeat: support tag name repeat. 
5.2 Reference Domain Configuration 
Configuration of reference domain can be completed in the engineering field, because: 
Operation domain alias of referenced project cannot be modified, otherwise user should configure 
again. 
Confirm the alias of field project before configuration. After modifying the alias of referenced 
project, reference tag of monitoring windows should be updated manually, including reference tags 
of monitoring configuration, such as overview, viewer, group, graphics, schedule, alarm, extend 
configuration and monitoring user authority, etc. 
Graphics only backup reference relationship when backup configuration, but no real graphics. 
If the domain server of referenced domain doesn't start monitoring in configuration, the tag cannot 
be displayed when selecting reference tag from tag selector, user can only input "Operation 
Domain Alias. Tag Name. Field" manually. 
5.3 Update Configuration 
It will detect automatically when updating configuration of referenced project, which should be 
updated manually. The detection and update of reference project are shown below:
--- pag 28 ---
VF Multi-Project Management 
 
25
The modification of referenced project configuration can be detected only after publish. 
Configuration consistency of reference project will be detected automatically when monitoring. 
System alarm will prompt as "Different with referenced domain configuration". Fault diagnosis 
specifies the reference domain. 
Update of reference domain cannot be detected automatically in configuration. Update will be 
prompted when refreshing configuration of system structure manually or publishing configuration. 
For example, after modifying and publish the tag and graphics of referenced project, it will prompt 
as "Reference domain configuration should be updated" only when publish configuration for 
reference project, and doesn’t specify the reference domain. 
The safest mode to update configuration of referenced project is refresh system structure 
configuration manually and then publish it. 
 
The tag increase and decrease of referenced project, modification of referenced graphics, 
authority modification of referenced monitoring user don't need the manual refresh for 
system structure configuration of reference project (refresh may not detect the change), 
the reference project can just open and update configuration from the configuration 
server. 
 
If the system structure configuration of referenced operation domain changes, it should 
be refreshed in system structure configuration of reference project manually (specific 
modification will be prompted), and publish the changes after updating. 
 
When updating referenced project in system builder software, the reference operation 
domain should be unlocked, or the update and synchronization cannot be performed 
(synchronize button will be grey). 
5.4 Other Notes 
 
Self-defined unit of referenced domain should be configured in reference domain in the 
same number, to be displayed in monitoring interface. 
 
Configuration being confirmed for the second time should be configured in reference 
project. 
 
The referenced project and reference project should set sleepy alarm to display. 
 
The button color and alarm color of panel, color settings when panel alarm lights work 
normally, alarm sort, alarm color and alarm priority sort conform to the configuration of 
reference project. 
 
Referenced project doesn't select alarm group, reference project select all trans-domain 
alarms, reference project displays all alarms of referenced project. 
 
If reference project has no local tag but only has reference tag, the domain server can 
not be configured. If reference project has domain variable tag, the domain server should
--- pag 29 ---
VF Multi-Project Management 
 
26
be configured. 
 
Input "Operation Domain Alias. Tag Name" in the global input dialog of reference project 
monitoring to open the panel or show other information. 
 
Panel cannot pop up when referencing FF tag of referenced project in global project 
doesn't install FF. 
 
Operation guide and fault diagnosis cannot be accessed trans-domain. 
 
If the configuration of referenced domain relates to that add or delete the domain server 
or change its address, user should open the system builder software of reference project , 
update configuration and save it. 
 
Set graphics as not support trans-domain select, while tag supports trans-domain select 
in alarm panel settings. 
 
Reference tag cannot enter the history trend of global project. If the tag has already been 
added in history trend of referenced operation domain, operation station of global project 
can search its history trend. 
 
The system alarm prompts as "SONet network communication of XXX.XXX domain 
server has fault" when the domain server of referenced project fails.

SPC Introduction
4
SPC Overview
⚫
SPC (Statistical Process Control) is a quality management technology that applies statistical 
techniques to evaluate and monitor various stages in the process to establish and maintain the 
process at an acceptable and stable level, ensuring that products and services meet specified 
requirements and adhering to the principle of prevention.
⚫
SPC involves studying and controlling processes using statistical techniques.
Product Quality Fluctuation
⚫
Product quality exhibits both variability and regularity. In production practice, even under the same 
conditions such as operators, machines, raw materials, processing methods, testing methods, and 
production environment, a batch of products may have slightly different quality characteristic data, 
indicating variability in product quality. Therefore, product quality variability is universal and 
enduring. When the production process is under statistical control, the quality characteristic data of 
the produced products follow certain distribution patterns, indicating regularity in product quality.
⚫
From the statistical perspective, product quality fluctuations can be classified into normal 
fluctuations and abnormal fluctuations.
--- pag 5 ---
Copyright @2024, SUPCON TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD., all rights reserved
SUPCON | global.supcon.com
SPC Introduction
5
1. Normal Fluctuation
Normal fluctuation is caused by random reasons (common causes). These random factors are 
abundant in the production process and often impact the product quality, but the fluctuation of 
quality characteristic values caused by them is usually relatively small.
Common Causes:
Many stable causes that can be distributed repeatedly over time. They are random factors that 
cause process deterioration. They are always present and cannot be identified.
⚫For example, tiny differences of composition or performance of raw materials; slight vibration of 
machinery and equipment; slight changes in temperature and humidity; minor differences in 
operation methods, measurement methods, inspection instruments, etc. It is technically difficult and 
economically costly to eliminate the random factors causing these fluctuations. Therefore, under 
normal circumstances, these quality fluctuations are allowed to exist in the production process, 
hence they are referred to as normal fluctuations. Tolerance is the product of acknowledging these 
fluctuations.
⚫Production processes with only normal fluctuations are referred to as being in a state of statistical 
control, also known as a controlled state or stable state.
--- pag 6 ---
Copyright @2024, SUPCON TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD., all rights reserved
SUPCON | global.supcon.com
SPC Introduction
6
2. Abnormal Fluctuation
Abnormal fluctuation is caused by special reasons. These system factors are not prevalent in the 
production process and do not frequently affect product quality. However, once they occur, their 
impact on product quality is significant.
Special Causes:
⚫Not always the reasons for the deterioration of the process. They unpredictably affect process 
outputs and can be identified.
⚫Sometimes beneficial, sometimes harmful.
➢For example, raw materials not meeting specified requirements, machinery operating with faults, 
operators deviating from standard operating procedures, measurement tools with systematic errors, 
etc. The magnitude and direction of the quality fluctuation caused by these reasons generally exhibit 
certain periodicity or tendencies, making it relatively easy to identify, prevent, and eliminate. Due to 
the substantial impact of abnormal fluctuations on quality characteristic values, it is generally not 
acceptable in the production.
➢Production processes with abnormal fluctuations are referred to as being in a non-statistical control 
state, also known as an out-of-control or unstable state.
--- pag 7 ---
Copyright @2024, SUPCON TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD., all rights reserved
SUPCON | global.supcon.com

Ca, Cp, Cpk, and Their Relationship
➢Ca is the degree of deviation of the process center value.
➢Cp is process capability, i.e., the magnitude of process control variability.
➢In other words, for a bell-shaped (normal distribution) curve:
-
Ca determines the offset degree of the center in the curve. The smaller the Ca value, the less the process 
deviation, the closer the center value is to the specification value, and the better the process capability. The 
opposite is also true. 
-
Cp determines the shape of the curve. The larger the Cp value, the narrower and higher the curve, indicating 
more concentrated data, smaller variability, and better process stability. The opposite is also true. 
➢To comprehensively evaluate process capability, both factors should be considered. The 
smaller the center offset and the taller and narrower the curve, the better the process 
capability. Therefore, Cpk was born as a comprehensive measure that considers both 
factors. The larger the Cpk value, the better the process capability.
➢Cpk = Cp* (|1-Ca|)
--- pag 18 ---
Copyright @2024, SUPCON TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD., all rights reserved
SUPCON | global.supcon.com

Process Capability
⚫
Cpk refers to the extent of deviation (ε) between the process mean and the standard specification of 
the product. It is commonly calculated by the lower value between 2 subtractions- subtraction of 
specification upper limit and mean value & subtraction of mean value and specification lower limit-
divided by three times of standard deviation (σ).
⚫

on the calculated process capability index.)

A+

A

be made to improve it to A+.
B
1.33 > Cpk ≥ 1.00 
State in general. Various resources and methods should be 
utilized to promote it to A.
C
1.00 > Cpk ≥ 0.67 
The process is not capable and there are many defects. Its 
capability must be improved.
D
0.67 > Cpk

redesigning the process should be considered.
