8.2.2.3 Pruebas FAT 
La Prueba de Aceptación en Fábrica (FAT) se realizara en las Instalaciones del proveedor de los 
servicios, y está orientada a confirmar las condiciones operativas y de desempeño del sistema de 
CCTV (Sistema Operativo, Computador, Servidor, Comunicaciones y Software de Aplicaciones y 
Diagnóstico). 
 
Adicional a las pruebas recomendadas por fábrica, se ejecutarán las siguientes pruebas y 
verificaciones: 
1) El sistema ensamblado deberá estar constituido por todas las cámaras, Switch (switches, 
router, etc.), computador de administración y configuración y servidor de video. 
2) Verificación de las luces de estado de todas las componentes. 
3) Revisión exhaustiva de todo el software y licencias adquiridas, instalarlas y realizar pruebas 
de desempeño de cada software, según recomendaciones de fábrica. 
4) Pruebas de verificación del direccionamiento de todas las cámaras, computador de 
administración y configuración, y servidor de video. 
5) Demostración de la operación de los programas de diagnóstico. 
6) Demostración de la puesta en marcha del sistema de CCTV después de una falla de energía, 
incluyendo la recarga de la base de datos y la configuración completa del sistema. 
7) Pruebas de insensibilidad al ruido electromagnético producido por radio frecuencias de 
aparatos tales como teléfonos celulares y equipos de radio. 
8) Todas las fallas detectadas durante estas pruebas deberán ser resueltas por el proveedor de 
los servicios. Una vez corregidas, Codelco o sus representantes verificarán el cumplimiento 
de las características del sistema de CCTV.

8.2.3 Preparación para embarque 
El Proveedor deberá proteger y embalar el CCTV y sus accesorios, de acuerdo a los requerimientos 
de un embarque de exportación, a fin de prevenir cualquier daño físico durante el transporte. 
 
El CCTV y sus accesorios deberán ser despachados como unidades completas y serán enviados 
en cajas cerradas a prueba de agua, capaces de soportar el manejo duro durante su transporte. 
Los equipos contenidos en una caja deberán ser cuidadosamente fijados y acomodados dentro de 
ella. Si por su tamaño y peso resulta de difícil manipulación por personas, la caja deberá ser 
montada sobre una parrilla de madera adecuada para ser levantada y transportada por un monta 
carga. 
 
El conjunto embalado deberá garantizar suficiente rigidez y resistencia para soportar el transporte 
de los equipos, las operaciones de carga y descarga, y almacenamiento en bodega. Las partes que 
puedan ser afectadas por humedad, deberán ser selladas con material impermeable. 
 
Las cajas de embalaje estarán marcadas en forma clara e indeleble con número de orden de compra 
y marcas con instrucciones para carga y descarga durante el embarque y transporte. Además, 
deberán contener una lista de partes de su contenido, señalando el número de la orden de compra, 
el número del equipo o Tag, y su descripción. Los repuestos, planos y catálogos deberán ser 
embalados separadamente, con la identificación adecuada.

La evolución de los sistemas de control durante los últimos 30 años indica que los ciclos de vida 
aproximados de sus principales componentes están alrededor de:

Entradas/Salidas: 15 años 
- 
Conjunto de Procesadores: 10 años 
- 
HMI: 5 años 
 
Dado lo anterior, se hace necesario establecer requerimientos sobre estos sistemas y similares que 
apunten a su sostenibilidad en el tiempo y a su mantenibilidad.

El proveedor debe entregar un plan de sostenibilidad para el CCTV, indicando el ciclo de vida 
esperado para los principales componentes, incluyendo: 
Programa de pleno soporte para cada uno de los componentes principales del CCTV. 
- 
Programa de soporte extendido para cada componente del CCTV, que se inicia con una 
carta formal de descontinuación del componente. 
- 
Programa de pleno soporte para cada software suministrado para el CCTV. 
- 
Programa de soporte para parches de software y firmware.

de ingeniería, servidores de registros históricos, controladores digitales, simulando los sistemas

En esta prueba realizada en terreno, se incluyen las pruebas FAT y CAT en el sentido que revisa el 
sistema de control y sus condiciones de configuración y desempeño, y también se cargan las 
aplicaciones de control y se prueba que estén operando todas las aplicaciones configuradas. 
 
No obstante lo anterior, se deberán realizar al menos las siguientes pruebas después de realizada 
la energización:

del sistema o subsistema. 
2) Verificar que todos los componentes del sistema o subsistema estén completamente 
operativos. 
3) Verificar cada uno de los canales de señales de proceso (buses de campo) en las 
pantallas de despliegue de la planta, reportes, control, etc., tal como se definió en los 
documentos de ingeniería y fue configurado en el sistema. 
4) Antes de la puesta en marcha en operación de los procesos, se realizarán pruebas de 
rendimiento al SC, simulando caídas de planta, mientras se está emitiendo un informe de 
turno y algunas estaciones de operación están recibiendo comandos de operador. 
5) La falla simulada consistirá en el cambio simultáneo del 60 % de las variables discretas y 
el 50% de las variables continuas fuera de rango y el otro 50% de las variables de salida 
variando rápidamente. La respuesta esperada en este caso será que el tiempo de 
actualización de la pantalla deberá ser igual o menor a dos segundos. 
6) El tiempo de refresco de una página de despliegue de proceso distinta de la página actual,

7) El tiempo máximo en cualquier condición de operación entre la ejecución de un comando 
desde la estación de trabajo y la acción final deberá ser menor que un segundo. Este

Esta es una etapa de asistencia a los operadores de las plantas para ayudarlos a entender como el 
sistema de control está apoyando a controlar el proceso. También es una oportunidad que se hacen 
cambios menores en los programas de aplicación, cambios de rango, modificaciones en los 
despliegues gráficos y se continúa con el proceso de sintonía de lazos. 
 
En terreno y como ocurre en la gran mayoría de proyectos mineros, la puesta en marcha de los 
equipos son por operaciones unitarias, sistemas o subsistemas.

8.4.3.2 Requerimientos Generales 
El SCC suministrado debe interconectarse, interfuncionar e integrarse (datos y aplicación) con 
todos los sistemas de la Red Integrada de Supervisión y Control (RISC), como una única aplicación 
y en base a un software estándar. Los sistemas que se requiere integrar son entre otros, el Sistema 
de Control Central, otros Sistemas de Control del proyecto, el Sistema Circuito Cerrado de 
Televisión, el Sistema de Detección de Incendio, el SCADA Eléctrico y el Sistema de Control de 
Acceso y Monitoreo de Personas y Vehículos. La conectividad entre estos sistemas se realizará a 
través de interfaces del tipo Ethernet (ópticas, alámbricas e inalámbrica), con las facilidades de 
Calidad de Servicio y protocolos TCP/IP en la conexión de extremo a extremo. 
 
 
La aplicación de integración debe incluir las funciones necesarias para establecer Estaciones de 
Operación conforme al perfil de cargo de quien opere estas estaciones. 
 
Preferentemente el SCC suministrado estará basado en Controladores Lógicos Programables 
(PLC’s) o en Sistemas de Control Distribuido (DCS’s) o una combinación de ambos sistemas. 
 
El SCC será diseñado para satisfacer los requerimientos operacionales del proyecto, algunas de 
sus funciones principales son: 
 
1) Desplegar información para facilitar la toma de decisiones a los operadores. 
2) Permitir la operación y monitoreo de la planta con todos sus sistemas y componentes. 
3) Apoyar la seguridad de las personas y los equipos. 
4) Proveer la capacidad de registro histórico de acuerdo a los requerimientos operacionales 
que se establezcan. 
5) Integrar los diversos sistemas de Control del proyecto conectados a la RISC, 
proporcionando las respectivas plataformas HMI de operación. 
6) Suministrar datos a sistemas de información (SIGO&M) 
 
El SCC debe ser un sistema tolerante a fallas, confiable y proporcionar la disponibilidad requerida 
durante todo el tiempo del horizonte de planificación. 
 
El sistema operativo utilizado en los computadores debe ser el definido por CODELCO, (en la 
actualidad es Microsoft, Windows), en versiones que posean soporte técnico vigente. 
 
Los Buses de Campo serán aquellos definidos por CODELCO, en la actualidad estos son: 
7) Foundation FieldBus o Profibus para la Instrumentación de Campo. 
8) Profibus o un protocolo de comunicación abierto, definido por el proyecto, para los 
Módulos de Entradas y Salidas Remotos. 
9) Profibus o Devicenet para la comunicación con CCM o equipos eléctricos. 
El uso de otro bus de campo debe ser justificado 
El SCC tendrá la capacidad de transmitir datos a través de estándares de comunicación como 
OPC y ODBC. 
El SCC deberá trabajar en condiciones ambientales indicadas en el documento Criterio de Diseño 
Condiciones del Sitio, emitido por el proyecto.

funcionalidades para evaluación y entrenamiento, provenientes desde la Estación de Instrucción,

8.4.3.8 Centro Integrado de Operación y Gestión 
El Centro Integrado de Operación y Gestión, representa la infraestructura desde la cual se puede 
supervisar, comandar, monitorear y diagnosticar en tiempo real, los equipos y activos críticos de 
los procesos de producción existentes de las plantas, en forma remota y centralizada. 
 
Esta infraestructura tendrá un diseño en base a un concepto de ergonomía que involucra salas con 
un diseño de gran estándar tecnológico con consolas de operación y pantallas integradas (con 
monitor extendido) y sistema de proyección y/o Wall Display, permitiendo al Operador tener una 
adecuada condición de trabajo, alta capacidad de respuesta y toma de decisiones adecuadas, ya 
que al contar con la integración de plantas y/o procesos con datos en tiempo real podrá analizar 
simultáneamente información, sistemas, equipos, tendencias, fallas y aplicar acciones que van en 
directo beneficio de la productividad, eficiencia energética y seguridad, es decir optimizar el negocio. 
 
El diseño específico del Centro Integrado de Operación y Gestión deberá ser tratado y consolidado 
por cada proyecto ya que dependerá de las características del proceso y layout del Barrio Cívico y 
el respectivo modelo de negocios, con el objetivo de alcanzar una mayor o menor integración de las 
Plantas y Sistemas Críticos. 
 
El diseño del Centro Integrado de Operación y Gestión se realiza conforme la Especificación para 
Centros Integrados de Operación y Gestión; y Plataformas SGPD-02IIN-ESPTC-0001. Los 
requerimientos de espacios físicos, dimensiones y otros requerimientos técnicos asociados a los 
Sistemas de Control serán entregados por la Especialidad de Automatización.

8.5.3 REQUERIMIENTOS TÉCNICOS 
8.5.3.1 Descripción Funcional 
Como primera definición el Sistema Martillo Pica Rocas debe ser suministrado con la capacidad de 
operar en modo Local y Telecomandada (operación normal). La operación Local será mediante un 
Arnés inalámbrico y el Telecomando será por medio de un sistema de control, el cual tendrá las 
estaciones de operación instaladas en la Sala Integrada de Operación y Gestión, ubicada al exterior 
de la mina subterránea. 
 
El Telecomando será ejecutado mediante una consola de operación dotada de un sillón de diseño 
ergonómico y adaptado con botoneras y joysticks, en el cual el operador puede activar el brazo del 
martillo y provocar la fractura de las rocas en el buzón. Como apoyo a la fracturación de la roca se 
consideran sistemas de video y audio. 
 
Como complemento al accionamiento del martillo, el operador tiene sobre su consola dos monitores 
con el despliegue gráfico del proceso y visión mediante video (on line) desde dos cámaras de 
televisión con ajustes zoom/pan/tilt. Se incluye además, la medición de nivel (sensor tipo radar) de 
los piques de vaciado. 
 
Adicionalmente, el operador del martillo deberá contar con la capacidad de operar a través de 
botonera o una interfaz gráfica los sistemas supresores de polvo (aspersores) que están en los 
puntos de vaciado. 
 
El equipo martillo pica rocas requiere de otras funcionalidades del sistema de control, como es el 
arranque/paro y control de las unidades hidráulicas, la lubricación automática del martillo y la 
iluminación del área de trabajo. 
 
El STM debe tener la capacidad para interconectarse, interfuncionar e integrarse (datos y aplicación) 
con todos los sistemas de la RISC. Esta conectividad se realizará a través de interfaces del tipo 
Ethernet (ópticas, alámbrica e inalámbrica), con las facilidades de Calidad de Servicio y protocolos 
TCP/IP en la conexión de extremo a extremo.

8.5.3.4.2 Red de proceso controladores 
Esta red de proceso es el medio de comunicación entre el controlador y los módulos de entrada y 
salida. Los protocolos de comunicación podrán ser: 
 
1. 
Protocolo Ethernet TCP/IP 
2. 
Protocolo Profibus DP 
3. 
Protocolo Control Net 
4. 
Protocolo Device Net 
5. 
Protocolo Modbus RTU 
 
Esta red de proceso debe ser redundante con verificación automática de comunicación. La

pérdida de las comunicaciones.

de la red, factor que debe garantizar.

8.5.3.4.4 Red de proceso en Interior mina 
La Red de proceso corresponde a una red con una arquitectura que cumpla o satisfaga todas las 
comunicaciones del STM para el monitoreo, operación y control de estos equipos. Además, de 
acuerdo con el modelo de telecomunicaciones deberá incluir el equipamiento necesario para 
conectarse a la RISC, ver “Criterio de Diseño Telecomunicaciones” SGPD-02TEL-CRTTC-0001 
 
La Red de proceso, en la conexión entre controladores y conmutadores de red, estará compuesta 
por interfaces del tipo Ethernet (ópticas, alámbricas e inalámbricas), con facilidades TCP/IP. 
 
La Red de proceso, en la conexión entre Controladores y la Instrumentación de Campo, CCM, 
Equipos Eléctricos y Entradas y Salidas Remotas, estará compuesta por los buses de campo 
Profibus, Devicenet, Fieldbus Foundation o un protocolo abierto. 
 
La Red de proceso para interconectarse e interfuncionar con la red RISC requiere de un SLA (Nivel 
de servicio acordado) de 100% de extremo a extremo. 
 
La Red de proceso para interconectarse e interfuncionar a nivel de Controladores y Buses de 
Campo debe tener un SLO (Nivel de operación) de 100%. 
 
Los equipos (de red y controladores) utilizados en la red de proceso, deben permitir el cambio de 
tarjeta sin la interrupción de los flujos de tráfico de comunicaciones (“Hot Swap”). 
 
La Red de proceso será una red redundante en media y equipos para mantener el SLA y SLO 
exigido.

tendencias de variables primarias o calculadas, configurar y diseñar las pantallas de control del 
proceso.

estar escritas en forma nativa para Windows de última versión. La programación, modificación y 
carga de los programas se deben poder realizar en línea directamente a los controladores del 
sistema.

funciones (FBD), texto estructurado (ST) y/o Ladder (LD) de acuerdo al estándar IEC 61131.

8.5.3.7 Otros requerimientos 
8.5.3.7.1 Fuente de Alimentación Continua (UPS) 
Se energizará el STM y elementos de control con una alimentación eléctrica proveniente de UPS, 
que tenga una reserva de energía de 30 minutos a plena carga desde el corte de energía. El voltaje 
de salida será 120 Vac, monofásico y de 3 alambres (fase, neutro y tierra). 
 
El proveedor del STM debe indicar los requerimientos de potencia del sistema completo y de sus 
componentes. 
 
8.5.3.7.2 Aire de Instrumentación 
En caso que el equipo mayor (Sistema Martillo) requiera aire de instrumentación, debe traer su 
propio equipo de aire para instrumentación. Este aire debe ser limpio, seco y libre de aceite, según 
lo que establece el estándar ISA-7.0.01, “Quality Standard for Instrument Air”. 
 
La distribución de aire para grupos de instrumentos cercanos, debe hacerse usando cabezal de 
distribución (manifolds de distribución). Cada derivación debe tener una válvula de corte. 
 
8.5.3.7.3 Pinturas Y Terminaciones 
Todas las partes del STM deben estar protegidas con un tratamiento de pintura adecuado para las

8.6.2 REQUERIMIENTOS TÉCNICOS 
8.6.2.1 Descripción Funcional 
El Sistema de Control de Tráfico está especialmente orientado a los proyectos estructurales de 
CODELCO, que consideran minería subterránea, sin embargo, no queda limitado a este tipo de 
explotación. 
 
La supervisión del SCT se realizará desde la Sala Integrada de Operación y Gestión, ubicada a gran 
distancia de las instalaciones mineras donde operarán los diversos dispositivos del SCT. 
 
La operación de los semáforos será automática, desde un controlador local ubicado en terreno, sin 
embargo, la programación de la lógica de estos dispositivos se hará en forma remota, usando la 
plataforma de ingeniería del sistema. 
 
La operación de los avisos de tránsito de texto variable será automática con opción de cambio desde 
la plataforma de operación del sistema. 
 
En la plataforma de operación habrá facilidades de voz y video, que deberán ser integradas desde 
el sistema CCTV del proyecto y puestas a disposición del supervisor del SCT. 
 
El HMI del sistema de control, aparte de las funciones propias para supervisar, monitorear y operar 
los dispositivos del SCT, provee toda la información necesaria para la gestión de estos equipos. 
 
8.6.2.2 Requerimientos Generales 
Los siguientes son criterios y requerimientos para el SCT: 
 
El Proveedor del SCT deberá necesariamente contar con: 
1. Representación y servicio técnico en Chile. 
2. Disponer de Sala ad hoc donde realizar las pruebas de aceptación en fábrica (FAT) y 
de aceptación de la configuración (CAT). 
3. Disponer de Salas de Capacitación y Entrenamiento. 
 
Con el software y hardware de la plataforma de administración, operación, supervisión y gestión del 
SCT debe ser posible administrar, programar, configurar y desarrollar todas y cada una de sus 
aplicaciones y componentes.

el sistema CCTV, para monitoreo, supervisión y comando (según los perfiles asignados a los 
usuarios) desde la Sala Integrada de Operación y Gestión. 
 
El SCT estará basado en tecnología de Controladores Lógicos Programables (PLC) u otra 
tecnología equivalente, complementados con las funcionalidades HMI (Interfase Humano Máquina) 
de la estación de operación y/o supervisión. Por lo particular de esta aplicación la instrumentación 
de entradas y salidas es específica a la funcionalidad requerida. 
 
De preferencia, el SCT debe ser de la misma marca y modelo de aquel seleccionado para el SCC, 
sistema que controlará todos los procesos minero – metalúrgicos considerados en el proyecto. En 
cualquier caso, el SCT debe estar certificado para esta aplicación. 
 
Cuando el Sistema de Control seleccionado para el SCT sea de una marca distinta al SCC, 
entonces, éste debe disponer de una tabla de memoria para transferencia de los datos entre el SCT 
y el SCC. Las señales y los mapas de señales a entregar y recibir en el SCT, será definida 
tempranamente (antes que se inicie su fabricación). Esta información es requerida para la 
programación de ambos sistemas de control. También debe satisfacer todos los requerimientos 
definidos en esta especificación. 
 
El SCT debe entregarse completamente ensamblado, conectado, programado y probado en fábrica 
y en terreno. 
 
El SCT debe ser diseñado para trabajar independiente del SCC, consecuentemente entonces, se 
espera redundancia de procesador y de comunicaciones en el Sistema de Control del SCT. 
 
El Proveedor dimensionará el SCT de acuerdo a sus necesidades, sin embargo, debe dejar una 
capacidad de expansión del SCT de mínimo 20%, la cual debe indicar en la oferta técnica.

alarmas y reportes en las EO (Terminales del HMI). 
 
El SCT deberá contar con las facilidades SNMP v2/v3 para mostrar el estado del sistema. En esta 
pantalla se indicará entre otras cosas; el estado de operación de los controladores, módulos de 
entrada y salida, y otros componentes del sistema. 
 
El proveedor del SCT proporcionará las rutinas para el diagnóstico en línea y las rutinas para todos 
los diagnósticos que no se realicen en línea. 
 
Todos los módulos del SCT, sean estos de entradas y salidas, comunicaciones, procesador 
redundante, etc., podrán ser desconectados o retirados estando energizado y operando el SCT, sin 
que esta acción genere caída de servicio del SCT. 
El Proveedor del SCT deberá entregar los requerimientos en cuanto a consumo eléctrico de cada 
uno de los componentes y gabinetes. 
 
El SCT deberá estar diseñado para tolerar vibraciones menores, propias de un ambiente industrial 
minero.

8.6.2.4.1 Gabinete de Controladores 
El gabinete de Controladores debe tener las siguientes características y componentes: 
 
1. 
Gabinete protección NEMA 4 ó NEMA 4X. 
2. 
Módulos de fuente de poder. 
3. 
Módulos de comunicaciones. 
4. 
Controladores. 
5. 
Equipos de la red de acceso. 
6. 
Componentes de distribución de energía eléctrica. 
7. 
Borneras para cables de alimentación eléctrica. 
 
Los Controladores deben tener la capacidad para realizar la adquisición de datos, control regulatorio 
y control lógico. 
 
La información almacenada en la memoria de cualquier Controlador, ante una pérdida prolongada 
de energía, debe permanecer disponible durante al menos 48 horas. Sin embargo, la configuración 
o programas de aplicación deben almacenarse en memoria no volátil. 
 
Los Controladores deben tener la capacidad para ser configurados en línea y/o fuera de línea. 
 
La manipulación de los datos de proceso de los Controladores se realizará mediante las EIN. 
 
Los Gabinetes de Controladores deben ser sin ventilador para enfriamiento de los módulos, equipos 
de comunicaciones, fuentes de poder y procesadores. 
 
La temperatura ambiente a considerar para el diseño de equipos debe ser 40 ºC, temperatura que 
indica que las tarjetas u otros componentes del SCT pueden estar a una temperatura mayor a 40 º 
C (Aprox. 70° C). 
Se debe considerar protección adicional a los Sistemas de Control a instalar en áreas polvorientas, 
con riesgo de derrames de agua u otros líquidos y proyección de rocas. 
 
El Proveedor del equipo mayor debe proporcionar el SCT con todas las conexiones y las 
terminaciones finales entre los módulos y componentes suministrados.

protección NEMA 4 o NEMA 4X según las condiciones ambientales. En caso de instalación en la

salida, debe hacerse desde los gabinetes de E/S del Sistema de Control.

sistema.

--- pag 2 ---
Next Gen Control System : UCS
Nyx
--- pag 3 ---
Distributed Control Systems (DCS) actively evolving towards data-centric architectures. 
The future of industrial control is increasingly defined by the integration of Information Technology (IT) and Operational Technology (OT), where data is treated as a primary asset to 
enable advanced control strategies, AI integration, and improved decision-making
IT/OT Convergence: 
Traditionally separate, IT (data-centric computing) and OT (industrial control) systems are integrating to allow seamless, secure data flow from the plant floor to the 
boardroom.
Leveraging Data as an Asset: 
In a data-centric approach, data is a primary and permanent architectural component, while applications can be more flexible. This allows for better data acquisition, 
analysis, and extraction of insights to support decision-making, moving beyond traditional rules-based systems.
Enhanced Analytics and AI: 
Modern DCS platforms are integrating advanced analytics, Artificial Intelligence (AI), and Machine Learning (ML) capabilities to scrutinize vast datasets, optimize processes, 
provide predictive insights for proactive maintenance, and enable self-learning control functions.
New Architectures and Standards: 
Initiatives like the Open Process Automation Forum (OPAF) and NAMUR Open Architecture (NOA) are driving a shift toward more open, interoperable, and modular systems 
that use commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) hardware and software components. This involves decoupling software from hardware, allowing for greater flexibility and easier 
upgrades.
Edge and Cloud Computing: 
To handle the volume of data generated by IIoT (Industrial Internet of Things) devices, data processing is moving closer to the source (edge computing) and utilizing cloud-
based environments to support widespread data availability and application interoperability.
Communication Protocols: 
Modern systems are adopting new connectivity standards such as OPC UA, MQTT, and REST API to facilitate secure and efficient data transfer across the enterprise and to 
the cloud.
Improved Reliability and Security: 
The inherent distributed nature of DCS offers reliability advantages (e.g., a single controller failure doesn't impact the whole system). The new data-centric approach also 
incorporates advanced cybersecurity measures, such as data-centric security (DCS) principles and Zero Trust Architectures (ZTA), focusing on protecting the data itself 
rather than just the network perimeter.

1. APEX Product Overview 
1.1. Application Background 
Process simulation software is the core basic software of process 
industry, which runs through the whole life cycle of modern process 
enterprises, and plays an irreplaceable role in research and 
development, design and operation. General process simulation 
software in China has been monopolized by foreign software 
represented by Aspen. Domestic software has been at the level of 
low-level exploration. As a general process simulation software for 
the process industry, this platform is positioned for process 
simulation, optimization and design in petroleum, chemical and 
other fields. 
1.1.1 Industry Market Situation 
Major companies: Typical representative products are KBC 
(PetroSIM), Emerson (Aspen Plus\HYSYS), Kenvi (ROMeo, 
PRO/II), Honeywell (Unisim) and so on. 
Market pattern:
--- pag 5 ---
APEX Sales Technical Manual 
 
2 
 
As of 2019, the simulation software market size in China has 
reached 2.85 billion yuan in the software use authorization, with an 
increase of 10.4%. As the advancement of intelligence and 
information technology in refineries and chemical enterprises, the 
use of process simulation software will be further improved. By 
using process simulation software for process simulation, process 
transformation, off-line optimization or real-time optimization, its 
economic benefits have been recognized by more and more users. 
At present, foreign manufacturers still have an absolute advantage 
in the domestic simulation optimization market. Emerson (which 
has acquired Aspentech) has a market share as high as 37.1%, 
which is more than 20 percentage points higher than the second 
place AVEVA's 12.9%. Aspen Plus software is widely accepted by 
engineers because it inherits sequential and simultaneous equation 
strategies, has strong model versatility and simple user interface 
operation. In addition, there are many pirated products of Aspen
--- pag 6 ---
APEX Sales Technical Manual 
 
3 
Plus software in China, which has cultivated a large potential 
audience from universities to enterprises. 
In the design, Aspen Plus and PRO/II occupy the main market. 
KBC and HYSYS occupy the main market in the refinery process 
optimization. 
1.1.2 Customer Demand Analysis 
With the increasing uncertainty of the international situation, the 
country and the industry have put forward the demand for backup 
and replacement of process simulation software under the 
background that there is no mature process simulation software in 
China. In addition, foreign process simulation software products 
and business models are relatively closed, which cannot meet the 
needs of domestic users to customize development according to 
their own needs. 
Aspen does not have an engineering team. Aveva and KBC have 
service teams but the response is slow, unable to meet the 
increasing demands of product application in China. 
The technical route adopted by some process simulation software 
is not advanced enough to meet the intelligent and digital 
application scenarios of enterprises. 
Almost all the foreign process simulation software architecture is 
the single-machine version of the client, which can not meet the
--- pag 7 ---
APEX Sales Technical Manual 
 
4 
needs of multi-person cooperation in model application. 
1.2. Programme Overview 
1.2.1. APEX Product Overview 
The software adopts the enhanced Equation Oriented technology 
route and the modeling and operation process is flexible. When 
dealing with the complex model with multiple circulation streams, 
the sequential method adopted by the traditional software has the 
problems of multiple iterations and slow convergence, etc. Based 
on the common simultaneous equation method, the platform does 
not need nesting and through the unique initial value strategy, the 
overall convergence problem of the complex model is successfully 
solved. 
When oriented to the requirements of multiple design goals, the 
platform flexibly interchanges the relationships between dependent 
and independent variables in the system of equations, which 
accurately back-calculates the design parameters, helping design 
optimization. 
In the optimization of plant operation facing multiple constraints, the 
platform can obtain a globally coordinated overall optimization 
scheme through multi-variable one-time solution, avoiding repeated 
attempts in the optimization process and reducing trial and error
--- pag 8 ---
APEX Sales Technical Manual 
 
5 
costs. 
1.2.2. APEX Product Application Scenarios 
The platform will simulate and optimize the whole life cycle of 
scientific 
research 
education, 
design/redesign, 
operation, 
transformation and digital twin in the process industry: reduce the 
number of experiments and reduce the cost of scientific research in 
the stage of scientific research. In the design stage, safety is 
ensured, construction cost is reduced and design process is 
optimized to reduce cost and increase efficiency. The operation 
stage combines many solutions and products based on the 
platform as the process base (such as plan optimization, advanced 
control, RTO, meta plant, etc.) to achieve cost reduction, quality 
improvement, efficiency increase, safety and environmental 
protection goals in the production process. In the retrofitting stage, 
the platform is used to analyze the process bottleneck, compare 
the solutions and redesign the device to achieve the goals of 
retrofitting cost reduction, product quality improvement, operation 
efficiency, production safety and environmental protection. The 
digital twin enables production monitoring, production forecasting 
and personnel training. 
1.2.3. Use of Industry and Major Competitors 
The V2.0 version of this platform is mainly used in refining,
--- pag 9 ---
APEX Sales Technical Manual 
 
6 
chemical, oil and gas, polymer, coal chemical and other industries. 
Refining: CDU, CCR, hydrocracking, catalytic cracking, PX, PTA, 
ethylene, etc.

synthesis, dimethyl phosphite, etc. 
Oil and gas: oil and gas separation, natural gas dehydration, LNG 
liquefaction, etc. 
Polymer: polyethylene, polypropylene, ethylene propylene rubber, 
polyvinyl acetate 
Coal chemical industry: coal gasification, conversion, MTO, liquid 
nitrogen washing

1.2.4. The Potential for Value and Benefit Analysis 
By modeling the process of the factory, to simulate the production 
of the device, analyze the bottleneck existing in the operation 
process and the optimization direction and target in the aspects of 
energy saving and production increase. It guides the design, 
operation, retrofitting and redesign of the device. Furthermore, 
utilizing the platform's material accounting, physical property 
analysis, and other functions can provide users with value in 
process comparisons, scientific research, teaching, and ensuring 
safety in production 
In the engineering design stage, through the selection of process 
routes and optimization of equipment selection, the construction 
capital can be saved by 10%~30%. During the production and 
operation stage, by optimizing the operating conditions of the
--- pag 13 ---
APEX Sales Technical Manual 
 
10 
device and removing the bottleneck of the device, the production 
efficiency can be increased by 3%~8%, the production energy 
consumption can be reduced by 3%~5%, thus bringing 5%~20% 
economic benefits to the enterprise. 
2. APEX Product Function Introduction 
2.1. APEX Product Features 
This platform is a general process simulation platform based on 
B/S architecture and adopts Equation Oriented (EO) technology. 
Traditional process simulation software adopts sequential (SM) 
technology modeling and is based on C/S architecture. 
The traditional process simulation software adopts SM modeling 
technology and calculates according to the sequence of process 
flow. In the case of process cycles, design regulations, process 
optimization or problems, it is necessary to iterate repeatedly, 
which is not only inefficient in calculation, but also difficult to 
converge. EO modeling technology model solving process does not 
consider the process sequence, all processes are calculated at the 
same time, so there is no need to iterate, it can solve the model 
solving problem that SM is difficult to solve. 
However, EO modeling technology has strict initial value
--- pag 14 ---
APEX Sales Technical Manual 
 
11 
requirements and poor convergence, which has been criticized by 
the industry. In the design process of this platform, the above 
problems are considered, so the EO modeling technology is 
enhanced and developed the enhanced Equation Oriented 
technology. 
In addition, compared with the C/S architecture of the traditional 
software client, this platform uses the B/S architecture of the 
connector/server. The platform can be deployed on different 
servers in a microservice way, supporting Microsoft Windows, 
Apple Mac and various domestic operating systems developed 
based on Linux. Multiple users can access the same service 
remotely through the browser at the same time, which reduces the 
deployment cost and improves the efficiency of collaborative 
applications. The server can be deployed on SUPCON side and the 
user-unique technology can be placed on the internal server, or all 
can be deployed on the user side. This way can flexibly meet the 
needs of users to use the software. 
The platform has an open data interface, which can satisfy the 
interaction with different data platforms and application software. It 
also supports various model applications.
--- pag 15 ---
APEX Sales Technical Manual 
 
12 
2.2. APEX Products Function Introduction 
With 2,160 pure substances and 15 thermodynamic method 
packages, the platform can perform petroleum, polymer, solid 
related calculations, as well as thermodynamic physical property 
analysis and regression tools. 
Support 30 kinds of general unit modules, in which the distillation 
columns can model crude distillation unit, catalytic main 
fractionation, air separation, ethylene and other device models; 
Reaction types support conventional gas, liquid, solid reactions, 
coordination polymerization, free radical polymerization, etc., 
support catalytic reforming, gasifier, polyethylene, polypropylene 
reaction modeling; Support custom models. 
Provide variable specification, connection strategy configuration, 
sensitivity analysis, gain analysis, objective function configuration 
and other advanced functions. 
The platform has a variety of operating modes such as "simulation", 
"pairings calibration", "reconciliation" and "optimization", and can 
invoke software functions and analyze models through scripts.
--- pag 16 ---
APEX Sales Technical Manual 
 
13 
 
3. Typical Application Cases 
3.1. Project Application Case 1 
APEX mechanism model supports the real-time optimization 
project of a continuous reforming plant in an enterprise. 
Background: A full-process mechanism model including 
pre-hydrogenation, reforming, recontact and fractionation units was 
established based on APEX's special 50 lumps and 300 reaction 
mechanisms. 
Action: Established the kinetic model of the autonomous reforming 
reaction. The conversion rate curves of various hydrocarbons in the 
model are consistent with those provided by the process 
specification. The reformer reaction model and the whole process 
model based on APEX formed a closed loop with APCand it was
--- pag 17 ---
APEX Sales Technical Manual 
 
14 
the first reformer RTO system in China. 
Economic benefit analysis: BTX yield increased by more than 0.5%, 
the economic benefit of about 10.1 million yuan/year. 
 
3.2. Project Application Case 2 
APEX mechanism model supports the retrofitting of reactor in a 
chemical enterprise. 
Background: The No. 2 esterification kettle had abnormally high 
acidity and low main product concentration in 2022, and the effect 
of various attempts in the workshop was not good. 
Mechanism analysis based on APEX: During the implementation of 
No. 2 esterification reactor simulation optimization project, APEX 
mechanism model was applied to accurately predict reflux 
composition and reactor bottom composition, the results were 
confirmed after sampling analysis. 
The SUPCON field team, modeling experts and consulting experts
--- pag 18 ---
APEX Sales Technical Manual 
 
15 
at the headquarters applied APEX to conduct disassembly, 
calculation and analysis of the reaction process, and clarified the 
reaction distribution inside the reactor tube and in the liquid level. It 
was believed that there were a large number of side reactions in 
the liquid level. The results provided mechanism support for the 
reflow and liquid level reduction retrofitting. 
Action: The average concentration of dimethyl ester increased by 
more than 2% one month after the transformation. 
The average main product concentration of one month before and 
one month after the transformation was compared: 
1. The yield of main product increased by more than 2% 
after modification; 
2. After modification, the yield of the reactor can reach the 
reaction capacity of other normal reactors. 
 
Economic benefit analysis: 
The annual output of dimethyl phosphite in a single set of reactors
--- pag 19 ---

16 
is 6,000 tons. 
Dimethyl ester yield increased by more than 2%, according to the 
current dimethyl ester consumption, converted into phosphorus 
trichloride and methanol consumption reduction value: 
The reduction of phosphorus trichloride consumption corresponds 
to the economic benefit of 25 kg/t → 0.025*6000*6800 *0.0001 = 
1.02 million yuan/year 
The economic benefit of methanol consumption reduction is 18 kg/t 
→ 0.018*6000*2800*0.0001 = 300,000 yuan/year 
A single set of production lines with an output of 6 thousand 
tons/year has an annual economic benefit of 1.32 million yuan. 
3.3. Project Application Case 3 
Based on APEX mechanism model, the FLNG device is optimized 
and guided. 
Background: FLNG plant mainly includes the purification, 
liquefaction and separation of natural gas, the production of LNG, 
LPG products and other processes, which involve ultra-low 
temperature and highly integrated plat-fin heat exchanger cold box, 
which requires very high thermodynamic methods and heat 
exchanger models. 
Action: Develop cold box models that accurately simulate field cold
--- pag 20 ---
APEX Sales Technical Manual 
 
17 
boxes with very low model error. At the same time, based on APEX 
mechanism model, the refrigeration cycle and cold box of the unit 
are optimized and the steam consumption of the core refrigeration 
compressor of the unit is reduced. The energy consumption is 
minimized, the load is automatically lifted and the refrigerant ratio is 
achieved. 
 
Economic benefit analysis: Achieve zero manual operation of duty 
adjustment process, reduce the operation frequency by 70%and 
reduce the steam consumption of the compressor by 193t/hr, 
bringing an annual benefit of 3.78 million yuan.

production DMC process plant, APEX platform was used to 
establish the strict kinetic reaction network and the mechanism 
model of the whole process of DMC reaction process. 
Action: Through sensitivity analysis, guide extractant dosage and 
tower top recovery with the feed DMC purity change. With APEX 
whole process model as the core, the optimization platform is built, 
optimization objectives are set up, APC retrofitting is carried out 
and online closed-loop real-time optimization (RTO) is realized. 
 
 Economic benefit analysis: DMC increased the annual output by

2. 
HIPPS 
 
Dependable Pressure Protection for Downstream System 
 
When operating in high-pressure environments and production fields, an overpressure event can 
cause damage to the environment, infrastructure, and personnel. Mitigating that risk on 
production wells and flowlines is a challenge that can be met with a HIPPS. A HIPPS is designed 
and built in accordance with IEC 61508 and IEC 61511 standards. These international standards 
refer to safety functions and safety instrumented systems when discussing a solution to protect 
equipment, personnel, and environment. A system that closes the source of overpressure within 
the required timeframe and incorporates redundancy within the initiators (pressure sensors), 
logic solver, and final elements (shutdown valves) with at least the same reliability as a safety 
relief valve is usually identified as a HIPPS. 
 
 
A HIPPS is a safety instrumented system designed to prevent over pressurization of a piping 
system and processing facility. 
 
Benefits 
- 
Protects downstream equipment 
- 
Minimizes flare system requirements 
- 
Reduces weight of downstream systems 
- 
Maximizes system availability 
- 
Reduces high-pressure pipelines or vessel overpressure risk 
- 
Improves economic viability of a development 
- 
Reduces risk to a facility, plant, or flowline 
- 
Reduces the total load of relief in a relief or flare system Features 
- 
High-integrity, flexible mechanical and electronic design 
- 
Partial- or full-stroke testing (automated or mechanical) 
- 
SIL 3 certified design 
- 
System diagnostics and status feedback

2.1 
Electronic HIPPS 
 
The electronic HIPPS is a self-contained, independent system operated on demand with 
1oo2 or 2oo3 (voting) pressure transmitter inputs, an electronic logic solver, and two 
spring-return hydraulically actuated safety valves. The unit can be self powered with a 
manual hand pump or HPU and can also be configured to operate using facility power 
sources. This pressurizes the system and opens the safety shutdown valves. The system 
remains open until an abnormal condition is detected. If such an event is detected, the 
system closes the two actuated final element valves, protecting the downstream 
production or facility.

The primary function of HIPPS is to detect high-pressure conditions and close isolation 
valves to protect lower-rated downstream infrastructure. The system operates 
autonomously and is independent of the facilities’ process shutdown (PSD), emergency 
shutdown (ESD), or control systems. HIPPS are fail-close by design based on the signal 
of an overpressure event and can be configured to operate on other events, such as a 
loss of motive power of instrument signal. It is typically fail-close for any loss of 
instrument air, hydraulic power, electric power, or instrument signals. Each HIPPS loop 
is independent. A HIPPS is designed with redundant safety functions to reduce the risk 
of failure on demand and to maximize availability.

2.2 
Safety Instrumented Systems 
 
A safety instrumented system (SIS) prevents or reduces hazardous events by taking a 
process to a safe state when predetermined conditions are met. An SIS can be an ESD, 
safety interlock system, or safety shutdown system. Each SIS has one or more safety 
instrumented functions (SIFs). Each SIF loop is a combination of logic solvers, sensors, 
solenoids, and final control elements, such as an automated valve. Every SIF within an 
SIS will have a safety integrity level (SIL), which is a measure of the system performance 
in terms of probability of failure on demand (PFD). These SIL levels may be the same or 
may differ depending on the process. An entire system does not need to have the same 
SIL level for each safety function.

HIPPS Components 
 
The HIPPS comprises two ESD valves, a 1oo2 logic solver, and typically three pressure 
transmitters with 2oo3 voting logic. 
Components include 
- 
sensors that detect high pressures or flow rates 1oo2, 2oo3, or both
- 
logic solver that processes the input from the sensors to the final element
- 
SIL 3 rated final elements that bring the process to a final safe state, isolating the 
source of overpressure
 
The HIPPS is an independently instrumented system designed with higher integrity 
compared with PSD and ESD systems. Suitable for onshore and offshore installations 
requiring high-integrity pressure protection of downstream systems, a HIPPS is used to 
prevent a system from exceeding its rated pressure level. The HIPPS is SIL 3 certified 
and incorporates field-proven valves and actuators from industry leading manufacturer, 
such as the MIR, LCM, Cameron, Camtec, SLV etc API 6A slab-style gate valve and 
GROVE* valves. Pneumatic and hydraulic actuators, such as the LEDEEN, Procontrol, 
rotork etc actuators, are supplied. A HIPPS is considered the barrier between the high- 
and low-pressure sections of an installation or production facility. The HIPPS combines 
our domain expertise and experience into an independent, stand-alone system for any 
application within the oil and gas industry. we provides the systems in a variety of 
configurations, including mechanical and electronic standalone packages.

6. 
FUNCTIONAL SAFETY MANAGEMENT 
Functional safety Management is under scope of vendor, which is to ensure HIPPS system is 
designed and integrated as per industry's IEC 61511 and IEC 61508 functional safety 
standards 
 
 
7. 
FACTORY ACCEPTANCE TEST 
Factory testing as per the specification will be carried out and representatives from the end user 
/ customer or its authorized representative shall be invited to witness the FAT of the HIPPS Logic 
Solver in our work premises. The inspector should have the authority to sign and accept the 
test, and to approve the materials for dispatch. 
 
SIL Assessor will witness this test and record as part of SIL certification. 
 
 
8. 
INTEGRATED FAT 
 
We envisaged that the integrated FAT will be held in the premises of SKID fabricator/ Valve 
manufacturer. The logic solver and pressure transmitters in 2oo3 configuration will be hooked up 
and simulated to perform HIPPS function. 
 
It is estimated 4 to5 Days to complete the integrated FAT including overall SIL certification of the 
complete HIPPS loop. 
 
SIL Assessor will witness this test and record as part of SIL certification. 
 
9. 
TRAINING (optional) 
 
In-house Training for 5 Personnel for 4 Days, including training materials. Excluding Travel Cost 
and Accommodation for all the Trainees. 
 
 
10. GUARANTEE & AFTER SALES SERVICES 
 
Vendor guarantees that the system to be supplied has design performance and quality in 
accordance to the given specification. The components will be of top quality suitable to the 
specified working conditions. Any necessary deviation from the written specification will be 
officially submitted to the client for review and approval before vendor Engineering Team will 
take further action. 
 
In case of hardware replacement, the items will be shipped from vendor office or from their FS 
Engineering Sub-vendor in vendor Zone. 
 
For this Project the main engineering support will be based in China or UAE.

分析小屋各组成部分功能介绍
分析小屋集规范化和专业化的供电、控制、远程、分析为一体的分析设备，为仪表提供了良好的操作
和运行环境。
防腐：不锈钢或碳钢喷塑材质作为内外墙材质，可在沿海地区或高腐蚀气体环境下使用；
保温：保温阻燃棉作为墙体内部材料，燃点在500℃以上；
防爆：可用在I区、II区等危险场所；
安全：危险气体联锁，同步声光报警；
报警仪：有效实现了对分析小屋的可燃气体、有毒气体、氧含量等气体的安全监测、就地/ 远程报警、自动定时
换气和联锁控制(启动防爆轴流风机换气)，保证仪表维护人员的安全工作环境，避免安全事故的发生。
预处理系统：预处理系统是工业过程分析系统设计的核心之一，是分析仪能适应于各种不同工况在线检测的桥
梁。针对高温、高压、工作环境各异、背景气体复杂等情况，通过有效的预处理设计，能更好得发挥分析仪的应用。
防爆空调：调节保持室内空气具有合适的温度。从而保证分析小屋内设备的稳定持久运行。
防爆接线箱、防爆联锁箱：联锁控制，有效实现了小屋内设备的远程控制连锁，比如电磁阀、气动阀、风机、仪
表、报警仪等等。实现了对分析小屋工况的实时监控和报警处理，提高了工业现场的安全性。
工业过程分析仪：搭载自主研发的高稳定性EPC、EFC、多阶程序控温等模块，应用适用性色谱柱，灵活配置
FID、TCD、PDD 等检测器，以自主色谱工作站软件进行数据分析。目前在空分装置、氟化工、天然气、焦炉煤
气、热值分析等方面有良好应用。

--- pag 1 ---

https://global.supcon.com
Make Industry Smarter Make Life Easier
--- pag 2 ---
Industrial Cybersecurity 
System
--- pag 3 ---
ICS Security
Management Platform
Product Overview
The ICS Security Management Platform realizes unified management of SUPCON industri-
al information security products, equipped with features such as asset management, 
unified configuration, herd immunity, patch management, event analysis, and log audit. 
The platform satisfies the requirements of network security monitoring, operation and 
maintenance cost reduction, and response efficiency improvement. At the same time, the 
distributed deployment solution is available for the industrial control security super 
management platform, which satisfies the requirements in discrete industrial scenarios 
and large-scale industrial network hierarchical management scenarios.
--- pag 4 ---
Centralized Management
Focusing on the industrial field, this platform supports the unified management and control 
of multiple SUPCON industrial information security products, including VxDefenderPro, 
Industrial Firewall,Industrial Data Diode, Network Diagnostic Platform, and Industrial Network 
Security Monitoring And Auditing System.
Product Advantages
Risk Status Monitoring
Risk assessment is available for evaluating the asset value, vulnerability, and threats. The asset 
risk value is calculated based on the risk calculation model. In this way, the asset risk ranking 
is provided, and the current asset security status is displayed.
Distributed Deployment
Multiple ICS Security Management Platforms can be centrally managed using the Industrial 
Security Supervisor Platform, ensuring unified management of industrial security products 
across network segments and equipment sets.
Unified Configuration
Centralized configuration is available, including allowlist scanning, virus scanning and remov-
al, security policy delivery, virus database update, and other configuration operations.
Herd Immunity
Manual upload and client push of real-time security events are supported, and correspond-
ing security policies are sent to all clients.
System Patches Management
Centralized management of operating system patches is supported, enabling one-click 
patch updates without an independent "system patches server".
--- pag 5 ---
Product Advantages
Application Scenarios
The ICS Security Management Platform can be deployed at the 
process monitoring layer of the control site, to manage the 
Intrusion. Detection System and Log Audit System at its level, 
and the industrial firewall and other devices that serve these 
systems. The ICS Security Management Platform has extensive 
application scenarios such as the petrochemical industry, 
chemical industry, power, environmental protection, agricul-
ture, shipping, iron & steel, and paper making.
Figure 1 illustrates its typical application scenarios.
Table 1 Performance Indicators
--- pag 6 ---
VxDefenderPro
Product Overview
VxDefenderPro is an industrial host protection software featuring program allowlist pro-
tection, network allowlist protection, virus scan and removal, mandatory access control 
(MAC), security baseline, secure USB drive, patch management, group immunity, and 
dynamic integrity measurement. The allowlist mechanism is used to intercept the execu-
tion of all unknown programs and scripts, and the blocklist protection mechanism is used 
to strengthen the allowlist security. In this way, virus and Trojan infection and zero-day 
vulnerability exploitation can be effectively prevented, and security can be ensured for 
industrial hosts including engineer stations, operator stations, SCADA servers, database 
servers, and OPC servers in the industrial environment. In addition, the software also offers 
centralized management of the ICS Security Management Platform, featuring remote con-
figuration, system patch update and virus database update to improve work efficiency of 
industrial sites.
--- pag 7 ---
Program Allowlist Protection
A allowlist file suitable for the current industrial host is generated through disk scanning, software installation tracking, and built-in 
allowlist library, to identify and block the operation of any program that is not in the allowlist
Product Advantages
Blocklist Protection
Before the files are added to the program allowlist, virus scanning can be performed to identify risks in files. Files that pass security 
verification are added to the host allowlist file to ensure the safe and stable operation of equipment such as engineer stations, 
operator stations, and servers
Dynamic Behavior Analysis Based on a Virtual Sandbox
When scanning, the virus killing engine will perform the controlled virtual execution in the virtual sandbox, so as to realize dynamic 
analysis techniques such as peeling and behavior analysis
Network Allowlist Protection
Network allowlist protection featuring "port + program" is supported, to prevent access of networks that do not use trusted 
ports or programs. This effectively resists various network attacks
Mandatory Access Control
BLP and BIBA models help formulate read and write access policies for subjects (processes) and objects (files) with different defined 
security levels in different models, ensuring system confidentiality and integrity
Security Baseline
According to the security configuration requirements of various components such as operating systems, applications, and network 
devices, a series of security baselines are formulated to harden industrial hosts and realize security compliance
Secure USB Drive
USB portable storage devices are subject to strict control. In case of emergencies, secure USB drives can be employed to access 
industrial hosts, effectively eliminating the possibility of malicious code infecting them
Patch Management
The software can access to the ICS Security Management Platform, realizing one-click download and installation of Windows patches 
that have passed compatibility verification
Group Immunity
When any client discovers and detects a virus, a security policy against the virus is deployed on all clients through ICS Security 
Management Platform
Dynamic Measurement
It monitors critical execution processes, files, registries, shared libraries, network communications, and data integrity within the 
industrial host in real time, to continuously measure the security of execution environments. With scenario-based software behavior 
baseline policies, it analyzes the security of industrial environments, detects abnormal software behavior promptly, thus safeguarding 
against malicious programs like viruses, trojans, and unauthorized software
Centralized Management
Centralized management is available for the ICS Security Management Platform featuring running status monitoring of all VxDefend-
erPros in the network, one-key distribution of configuration, software/virus database upgrade, and log audit and analysis
--- pag 8 ---
Operating Environment
Table 1 Operating Environment
Table 2 Performance Indicators
Performance Indicators
Performance Indicators
The VxDefenderPro has extensive application scenarios, including the petrochemical 
industry, chemical industry, power, environmental protection, agriculture, shipping, iron 
& steel, and paper making.
Figure 1 illustrates its typical application scenarios.
--- pag 9 ---
USB Guard
Product Overview
The USB Guard is a terminal protection product specially designed for comprehensive pro-
tection of portable storage devices. The industrial host is allowed to securely access porta-
ble storage devices, while maintaining strict physical isolation between them. The 
built-in file filtering function filters the files in the portable storage device, to conduct virus 
scanning and removal and provides protection. This can effectively prevent threats of 
viruses from the files stored in the portable storage device against the host. The 
dynamic behavior analysis technology based on virtual sandbox has enhanced the ability 
of virus detection and killing.
--- pag 10 ---
Allowlist + Blocklist Mode
The USB Guard adopts the dual protection mechanism featuring "Allowlist + Blocklist", with the 
built-in allowlist of file types and antivirus engine:
(1) Only files of the specified types in the allowlist are shared, and all other files are filtered out;
(2) Virus files detected and removed by the antivirus engine will be moved to the quarantine zone;
(3) Allowlist files in the trusted zone will be scanned but not removed
Product Advantages
User Access Control
Create a portable device allowlist. Only devices listed can be accessed by users
Implement user access control by establishing a mapping table between users and portable 
storage devices. After successful authentication, users can operate the devices they have access to.
Dynamic Behavior Analysis Based on a Virtual Sandbox
When scanning, the virus killing engine will perform the controlled virtual execution in the virtual 
sandbox, so as to realize dynamic analysis techniques such as peeling and behavior analysis
Plug-and-Play
After the USB Guard is powered on, only simple configurations of IP addresses and sharing 
permissions are required. Then, the file copy can be carried out over all hosts in the same network 
segment, with no additional software required on the client
Log Audit
Operations are recorded in details for users to view and audit, including file operations, virus 
scanning and removal, and system configuration of the portable storage device
Unified Management
Unified management of the ICS Security Management Platform is available. Users can update and 
manage virus databases on the ICS Security Management Platform, and upload logs to the ICS 
Security Management Platform for centralized management
--- pag 11 ---
Performance Indicators
Table 1 Performance Indicators
Application Scenarios
USB Guard is widely deployed in various industries, including the petrochemical indus-
try, chemical industry, power, environmental protection, agriculture, shipping, iron & 
steel, and paper making.
Figure 1 illustrates its typical application scenarios.
Figure 1 Application Scenarios
--- pag 12 ---
Industrial Firewall
Product Overview
The GW031 firewall system is specially used for border protection of industrial control 
networks. An industrial security communication model is constructed based on the "allow-
list" technology, to perform in-depth message parsing on the industrial traffic over the 
communication link, ensuring the security of communication among industrial control 
network areas. Equiped with core functions such as network access control, common 
exceptional traffic detection, and common industrial control protocol protection, the 
integrated industrial border protection system satisfies the application requirements of 
conventional industrial networks, and provides continuous security detection and audit 
data for the ICS Security Management Platform. To sum up, it provides enterprises with 
budget-friendly border protection solutions.
--- pag 13 ---
Product Advantages
All-Time Session Status Detection
All-lifecycle and all-status detection is provided for sessions at Layer 4 to Layer 7
Access Control of the Industrial Control Protocol at the Bit 
Number Level
Compatible with multiple general industrial control protocols such as OPC, Modbus, and SCNet, 
this product integrates a deep analysis protection engine for industrial control protocols. Multiple 
deep protection methods are equipped, such as behavior restriction and bit number control, to 
identify and block abnormal industrial protocol application behaviors
Various Industrial Control System Application Scenario Policy 
Templates
The product enables deep integrated protection for the industrial control system, with one-click 
configuration capabilities for typical industrial control system deployment scenarios such as 
inter-domain isolation and inter-station communication. Highly integrating the network character-
istics and communication protocols of the industrial control system, it supports tag-level industrial 
control system behavior control, providing security and protection for industrial control system 
network areas
Industrial Hardware Quality
EMC industry level 3, wide operating temperature range from -20°C to +70°C (ambient tempera-
ture), compliance with the G3 corrosion resistance standard, average power consumption less 
than 5 W, fanless heat dissipation design, MTBF up to 30 years
Various Deployment Schemes for Different Application Scenarios
It can be deployed in multiple network application scenarios such as routing, switching, and NAT
Performance Indicators
Table 1 Performance Indicators
--- pag 14 ---
Performance Indicators
Figure 1 illustrates the typical application network structure of the industrial control 
firewall. The industrial control firewall is deployed between various functional areas 
of the industrial network. Therefore, users can divide the network security areas of 
the industrial network according to businesses and functional characteristics. For 
example, it can be deployed between domains, between levels, between the office 
network and control network, between the operation station and control station, 
between the OPC clients and server, between important servers, and between differ-
ent network areas. Then users can customize the security protec� tion strategy 
according to the functions and security characteristics of each functional area, to 
conduct network access control, network traffic monitoring, and unauthorized 
behavior filtering, and prevent attacks, virus infections and spread, and other securi-
ty incidents.
--- pag 15 ---
Product Overview
The GW031 Enhanced industrial firewall system is specially used for border isolation secu-
rity protection of industrial control networks. An industrial security communication model 
is constructed based on the "allowlist" technology, to perform in-depth message parsing 
on the industrial traffic over the communication link, ensuring the security of communica-
tion among industrial control network areas. It is an industrial border protection system 
featuring industrial asset identification, asset behavior control, exceptional traffic detec-
tion, virus detection, VLAN isolation, SSLVPN, and other core functions. The product pro-
vides multiple network working modes for common complex industrial network scenarios. 
Designed based on the high-performance multi-core message processing system archi-
tecture, this product integrates an efficient message parsing engine, which satisfies the 
application requirements of large-scale industrial networks, and provides continuous secu-
rity detection and audit data for the ICS Security Management Platform .
Enhanced
Industrial Firewall
--- pag 16 ---
In-depth Parsing of Multiple Industrial Protocols
Using the industrial protocol engine, the system scans for exceptional content in the industri-
al control protocol in real time, and blocks illegal traffic. The engine is capable of data 
analysis of more than 20 industrial protocols including OPC DA/AE, ModbusTCP, and EIP, and 
supports access control at up to the bit number level
Product Advantages
Diversified Security Policy Configurations
The product offers multi-component security policy configurations based on the source 
address, destination address, security zone, service, policy group, and effective time. In 
this way, users can apply accurate and flexible configurations according to on-site 
network security requirements
Various Industrial Application Scenarios
The product is equipped with built-in in-depth integrated protection of the industrial control 
system, which highly integrates the network characteristics of the industrial control system 
and communication protocols. One-click configuration is available in typical industrial control 
system deployment scenarios such as policy-group-based inter-domain isolation and 
inter-site communication, and access control is implemented at up to the bit number level
Visualized Security Trends
By monitoring and analyzing real-time logs and traffic in real time, the firewall system quickly 
identifies exceptional behaviors in the network and generates traffic reports. Security trend 
statistics is provided, containing information such as traffic, attack times, and attack types in 
the past 7 days. Users will better understand the risks and hidden dangers in the industrial 
network on the provided graphical interface
High Processing Performance
The self-developed multi-core concurrent processing framework offers the maximum 
throughput of 8 Gbps and a maximum of one million concurrent connections, satisfying the 
high real-time requirements of industrial control networks
High Availability
With the industrial-grade wide temperature and high adaptability to harsh environments, 
the firewall system supports power supply redundancy, dual-device hot backup, and fanless 
heat dissipation
High Usability
The firewall system offers web access for management configuration, one-click configura-
tion of various typical industrial firewall deployment strategies, and access to the ICS Security 
Management Platform for centralized management
--- pag 17 ---
Performance Indicators
Table 1 Performance Indicators
Application Scenarios
Figure 1 illustrates the typical application network structure of the industrial firewall. The 
industrial firewall is deployed between various functional areas of the industrial network. 
Therefore, users can divide the network security areas of the industrial network according 
to businesses and functional characteristics. For example, it can be deployed between 
domains, between levels, between the office network and control network, between the 
operation station and control station, between the OPC clients and server, between 
important servers, and between different network areas. Then users can customize the 
security protection strategy accord�ing to the functions and security features of each func-
tional area, to control network access, monitor network traffic, and filter out unauthorized 
behavior. This prevents attaks, virus infection and spread, and other security incidents.
--- pag 18 ---
Figure 1 Application Scenarios
--- pag 19 ---
Product Overview
The Industrial Cybersecurity Monitor and Audit System is a security auditing system spe-
cially designed for industrial control networks. It not only covers anomaly monitoring at 
the cybersecurity level but also integrates the alarms about key business behaviors from 
different industries. The system is deployed in a bypass mode, ensuring zero risk during 
industrial production, quickly identifying anomalies and attack behaviors in networks 
based on specific security policies and behavioral baselines, and triggering real-time 
alarms. The system also logs all communication behaviors, for network monitoring, proto-
col analysis, and security log auditing, fully supporting the investigation of security acci-
dents in industrial control systems
Industrial Cybersecurity 
Monitor and Audit System
--- pag 20 ---
In-depth Parsing of Industrial Control Protocols Based on DPI
The system supports in-depth message parsing based on mainstream industrial control 
protocols such as MODBUS-TCP and OPC, for effective identification of dynamic ports. In 
addition, this system also boasts functions such as message format check, integrity check, 
commands, and tag operation recognition, for behavior identification in industrial control 
scenarios
Product Advantages
Behavioral Modeling Based on Asset Roles
Behavioral modeling of different assets in an industrial control network can be performed in 
accordance with asset roles, with proper behavioral baselines configured for perceiving 
abnormal operation behaviors of asset roles, recording all events in the industrial control 
network, and enabling the evaluation of information security and the tracking and location 
of security events in the industrial control network
Custom Protocol Identification 
The protocol identification engine built into the system can characterize its ports or applica-
tion layer keywords by using the protocol language, and accurately identify protocols other 
than the default protocol of the system based on these characteristics
Health Assessment
With the asset health assessment function, the system can evaluate the health of assets 
based on their network communication behaviors and generated events and raise alarms in 
case of any less healthy assets found, for quick location of potential network threats
Performance Indicators
Table 1 Performance Indicators
--- pag 21 ---
Application Scenarios
The Industrial Cybersecurity Monitor and Audit System can be bypass-deployed in an 
industrial control network for security event monitoring, auditing, and management of 
network behaviors in the industrial control network. The Industrial Cybersecurity Moni-
tor and Audit System can be widely used in scenarios such as the petrochemical indus-
try, chemical industry, power, environmental protection, agriculture, shipping, iron & 
steel, and paper making.

Diagnostic Platform
Product Overview
The Network Diagnostic Platform is a network management and monitoring product 
designed for industrial networks. It provides functions such as industrial network asset 
management, device configuration, automatic network topology mapping, status moni-
toring, operational load monitoring, fault alarms, etc., and meets the monitoring and man-
agement requirements of control networks and APL field Ethernet in large projects
--- pag 23 ---

Support automated industrial network asset management, providing unified management of 
various devices such as controllers, workstations, switches, firewalls, printers, etc., which can 
effectively improve operational efficiency
Unified configuration and monitoring of switches

Deep integration with industrial scenarios
Support automatic drawing of industrial field network topology
Support redundant network management in industrial scenarios
Intelligent alarm, proactive prevention
Support fault alarm function of equipment nodes, 24/7 hours port flow recording of switches,

APEX SOLUTION ONE PAGE INTRODUCTION
Solution Positioning and Application Scenarios
What is it
Advanced Process Engineering eXpert
Product Description
APEX is a next-generation process simulation software based on equation oriented technology. It follows first principles to model and compute processes in the process industry. APEX covers the entire lifecycle from process R&D to engineering design and plant operation, serving as a foundational model for digital delivery, digital twins, intelligent plants, and AI applications.
Refining: Atmospheric distillation, continuous reforming, hydrocracking, catalytic cracking, lightweight hydrocarbon separation, etc.
Petrochemicals: Para-xylene (PX), purified terephthalic acid (PTA), ethylene, propylene oxide/styrene monomer (PO/SM), etc.
Oil and Gas: Oil-water-gas separation; dehydration, purification, and liquefaction of natural gas, etc.
Polymers: Polyethylene, polypropylene, ethylene-propylene rubber, nitrile rubber, polyester, etc.
Chemicals: Synthetic ammonia, coal processing (gasification, purification, conversion, MTO, etc.), synthetic methanol, etc.
V3.0 supports the following senarios:
Sold as a product, with primary customers including engineering companies, research institutes, and universities.
For manufacturing enterprises, products can be sold directly or provided as part of the following unified solutions.
Collaborate with enterprises on co-creation and development, with the realization of shared benefits from the products.

Selling Points

Based on the B/S architecture, the software is installation-free, making collaborative modeling more convenient.
The same core model supports four operating modes: simulation, calibration, reconciliation and optimization. It allows for model calibration using operational data (calibration and reconciliation modes) while also enabling global optimization (optimization mode).
Steady-state and dynamic integrated modeling allows for smooth switching between steady-state and dynamic models, assisting with operation training, safety assessments, and control scheme validation, thereby promoting safe operation of the facility.
Supports mutual conversion with files from third-party software, enabling quick switching between different software models without the need for redundant modeling.

TPT (Time-series Pre-trained Transformer), a process industry time-series model independently developed by SUPCON, has dual capabilities of simulation and prediction. It can forecast process parameters like temperature, pressure, and flow rates, as well as future trends of equipment.
Capable of providing real-time supervision of equipment operation around the clock without environmental interference, TPT offers monitoring reports on process parameters, equipment health, production performance indicators, and dynamic risks. This reduces the labor intensity of manual operations and ensures sustainable economic operation. By equipping production units with a "smart brain," TPT enables them to think, communicate, and supervise and optimize operations like an expert, aiming to improve efficiency, stabilize operations, and increase profits.
TPT (Standard Version) Functions: Autonomous Supervision (Process Parameter Prediction and Warning, Equipment Abnormal Status Identification, Production Efficiency Real-Time Evaluation, Target Flexible Calculation), Information Generation (AI Chat, AI Analysis of Production Data, AI Generation of Plant Overview Report).
TPT (Premium Version) Functions: Autonomous Optimization (On-Line Real-Time Optimization, Complex Process’ Optimization and Control), PID Parameter Optimization, Intelligent Control, Process Verification, and Operational Training.
Key Functions:
Autonomous Supervision - Anomaly Monitoring: Comprehensive analysis and insight into key process parameter states, equipment health, and production efficiency indicators such as load rate, yield, quality, energy consumption, and safety impact factors to identify factors affecting operation.
Autonomous Supervision - Predictive Alarms: Forecasting of production demands, raw material and energy consumption, equipment health, future trends in process parameters, and production efficiency. Early detection of anomalies with effective countermeasures to prevent potential safety hazards
Autonomous Optimization: Optimization of plant energy consumption, benefits, and quality to improve production efficiency, reduce costs, enhance product quality, and maximize production benefits. Optimization of control strategies and parameters to enhance stable operation levels.

-

Optimization: Globally coordinated overall optimization of a multi-constraint plant through a multivariate one-time 
solving process

APC system is implemented in a plant, normal and stable operating conditions are selected, and the equipment 
is perturbed to obtain a batch of gains around the current operating conditions. 
However, this method of obtaining gains has the following problems:
The "gain analysis" function of this platform solves the partial derivatives in the system of model equations, 
and through online operation, the gain of the manipulated variables over the control variables can be obtained

the operating data of the device online and update the gain of the relevant variables to the APC system in real 
time, without having to perturb the device to obtain the gain. In this way, the real time and effective stable 
control of the devices is guaranteed.

Application Cases——Modelling of Crude Distillation Unit (CDU)
Application Cases — Modelling of Continuous Catalytic Reforming Unit (CCR)
Crude Distillation Unit (CDU)：A refinery key unit that separates crude oil into intermediate products for 
further reaction and separation to obtain the final product. Crude oil is separated into distillates of different 
boiling ranges through three major processes: pre-treatment (desalting, dewatering, fractional distillation), 
atmospheric distillation and vacuum distillation.
The platform has an accurate oil cutting calculation function, which independently designs the cut scheme 
based on the distillation curve data, and characterises the crude oil, a complex mixture, into a set of pseudo 
components with different distillation ranges for separation design.
Crude distillation model include fractional distillation, crude 
distillation columns, vacuum distillation, and three sets of 
heat exchanger networks for pre-desalination, post-desali-
nation, and primary bottom. By modelling the columns, 
heat exchangers, and other equipments, the process param-
eters of the whole plant in any process and equipment can 
be analyzed in depth , which is convenient for design-
ing/re-designing, operation, and retrofitting.
Upon comparison, the accuracy of the model's calculation 
results reaches the level of accuracy of other mature process 
simulation software.
Continuous catalytic reforming are designed to produce aromatics or high-octane gasoline and are an import-
ant source of feedstock for downstream aromatics units. The reforming reaction unit is the core of the continu-
ous reformer, which determines the yield and composition of the reformed products. However, the reaction 
process is very sensitive to the reaction conditions, such as reaction temperature, hydrogen-oil ratio, and feed 
composition, and it is difficult to determine the optimal reaction conditions based on experience.
The APEX platform characterises the feedstock and product composition using a 50-molecule set to model CCR 
process. The model optimizes the optimal reforming reaction conditions and other plant operating parameters 
to achieve the operation optimization process.
Closed-loop linkage was established through an online real-time optimization platform and an APC system. 
After calibration, following the implementation of RTO, the BTX yield of the unit increased by 0.58%.

AASLink Software User Manual 
Section 1 Overview 
As ECS-700 external interface software, AASLink can convert ECS-700 alarm configurations to 
CSV file and update CSV file in remote AAS (Alarm Administrate System) server via shared folder 
1.1 Typical Application Network 
As shown below, AASLink runs in ECS-700 OPC interface station. In ECS-700 OPC interface 
station, AASLink gets alarm configuration and transforms the configuration to CSV file, and then 
AASLink transfers the CSV file to AAS server via shared folder. 
 
Figure 1-1 Network Figure of Typical Application 
1.2 Instruction of Data Flow 
OPC DA server software, OPC A&E Server and AASLink run in ECS-700 OPC interface station. 
The section introduces how ECS-700 OPC interface station transfers data to AAS server taking 
the example of network in Figure 1-1. 
 
OPC A&E server software transfers realtime alarm, process alarm and operation log to 
AAS server. 
 
OPC DA server software transfers tag information including realtime data, alarm limits, 
alarm deadzone, alarm enable state to AAS server. 
 
AASLink software transforms alarm configuration to CSV file and transfers to AAS 
server.
--- pag 4 ---
