display the alarm cause which helps the user to locate the problem. 
When a batch run fails, the entire batch will be suspended by default (Held). Through the 
configuration of the "Recipe Management> Recipe Properties> Other Information" interface in the 
recipe editing software, it is possible to suspend only the failed batch, unit or operation. For details, 
please refer to the "Configure Recipe Properties" chapter in the VxBatch Recipe Editing Software 
User Manual.
--- pag 34 ---
VxBatch Monitoring Software User Manual 
30 
Section 10 Batch Log 
All batch-related operation records, state change and alarm information can be viewed in the 
operation log interface, and the interface is displayed as shown in Figure 10-1. 
The logs are sorted by time in descending order, and the most recent log is displayed on the top of 
the list. You can click “Filter” to refresh the log information. 
 
Figure 10-1 Operation log interface 
The log interface is as shown in the figure above. The filter conditions and operation buttons are 
displayed on the top and the log information is displayed on the bottom. The contents of the 
operation log record are shown below. 
 
Operations: including operational records in the interface of basic configuration, recipe 
order, scheduling schedule, process management, quality management, batch trend, 
electronic signature, manual interactive step, batch alarm and etc. 
 
Events: including the status changes of batch and instance. 
 
Alarms: including the history alarm information. 
The filtering conditions of the operation log include “Time”, “Batch”, “Master recipe”, “Description” 
and “Type”. 
The user can set the query constraint according to actual needs and determine. After the 
conditions, click “Filter”. 
The batch information can be accessed through function buttons such as, “Home”, “PageDn”, 
“End”, “PageUp”, “Flip N page”. After selecting an operation log with the batch number in the log 
list on the right, click “BatchInfo” to pop up the viewing interface of history batches and open the 
history batch information related to the log.
--- pag 35 ---
VxBatch Monitoring Software User Manual 
31 
Section 11 Historical Batch View 
The “History Batch View” interface is shown in Figure 11-1. The following operations can be 
performed: view history batches, view operation logs of a batch, and load a batch of information 
into the dispatch interface. 
 
Figure 11-1 History batch view main interface 
11.1 Viewing History Batch 
1) Enter the search criteria. 
 
Begin Time/End Time: When filtering by time, set the start time and end time of the 
batch. 
 
Condition: “Recipe Name” or “Batch”, default to “Recipe Name”, in the drop-down box 
you can select “Batch”. 
 
Filter: Enter keywords for batch or recipe name. 
2) Click on the “Filter” button and the bottom will display a list of batches matching the 
search criteria. If you search for multi-page content, you can page through the “Home”, 
“PgUp”, “PgDn”, “End” buttons. 
11.2 Viewing Batch Log 
1. Select a batch of information on the bottom of the interface. 
2. Click the “Batch Log” button to pop up the operation log information of the batch. For 
details on the operation log interface, see the operation log. 
11.3 Loading Batch 
When history batch information needs to be executed again, create a new history batch in the 
dispatch interface and load the batch information. The operation mode can be seen in Create 
Batches.
--- pag 36 ---
VxBatch Monitoring Software User Manual 
32 
Section 12 Batch Trend View 
“Batch Trend View” is used to view the batch trend graph and compare the material information of 
different batches. The interface is shown in Figure 12-1. 
 
Figure 12-1 Batch trend viewing interface 
12.1 Interface Introduction 
On the left side of the batch curve viewing interface, the batch information can be searched, and 
the batch, recipe and all the tag information under it can be displayed. The right side of the 
interface contains two tabs of “Curve” and “Table”, interface introduction and basic functions. The 
description is as follows. 
12.1.1 Searching for Batch Information 
1. Enter the search criteria. 
 
Begin, End: The time the batch is filtered by time. 
 
Filter: Choose to filter by Recipe /Batch. 
 
Condition: The name of the batch or formula. 
2. Click the “Filter” button. 
3. Displays the batch list in the middle section on the left side of the interface, including the 
Batch, Recipe, Product, Cell, Begin Time and End Time. You can page through “Home”, 
“PgUp”, “PgDn”, “End”. 
4. Select a batch, and at the bottom left of the interface, you can display a tag other than the 
pre-download tag, execution tag, parallel tag, and execution sequence number, including 
the Tag and Description.
--- pag 37 ---
VxBatch Monitoring Software User Manual 
33 
You can add a tag curve to the Curve page by right-clicking on it and selecting Add to curve 1/2/3/4 
in the right-click menu. 
12.1.2 “Curves” Page 
The upper part shows a list of batch information added, the lower half is the curve display area, the 
bottom part includes the curve display mode, curve display scale, curve movement, preset curve 
and other function buttons. Select a number in the batch information list to display the tag curve in 
the curve display area. Additional features are described below. 
1. Display mode settings. 
In the Mode drop-down box, select 1*1, 1*2, 2*2. The curved interface above will be changed 
to display a maximum of 4 curve interfaces on the entire screen. 
2. Adjust the coordinate size. 
3) Select the adjustment direction, in the “Arrow” drop-down box, select “Vertical” to enlarge 
the ordinate, select “Horizontal direction” to enlarge the horizontal axis or select “Both 
sides to” zoom in. 
4) Click “Zoom in” to zoom in by dragging with the mouse to the curve area. Click “Normal” 
to restore the trend's coordinates to before zooming in. 
3. Move the curve. 
Click on the button 
 to move up, move down the selected curve in the 
Curve interface, and click “Normal” to restore the curve position before moving. 
Click 
 to move left and right to move all curves in the curve interface, 
and click “Normal” to restore the curve position to the front of the move. 
4. Function Button. 
 
Remarks: Displays the comment information. 
 
Curves: One curve can be preset per screen. 
 
Print: Copy screen print position number information list area and curve area content. 
5. Right-click menu 
The right-click menu in the tag number batch Information list: 
 
Delete Tag: Check that a number column is valid to delete the column. 
 
Select Column: Pop-up Select column interface to show/hide the list items in the tag 
information list in this interface. 
 
Set Standard curve: Select a tag information column, set this curve to standard curve, 
plus (*) before the standard curve position number. 
 
Cancel Standard curve: Cancel setting a standard curve. 
Right-click menu for the curve display area:
--- pag 38 ---
VxBatch Monitoring Software User Manual 
34 
 
Add Note: Add curve notes that can be displayed by the Show Notes button. 
 
Delete Note: delete curve notes. 
 
Set Color: Sets the color of all curves. 
 
Set Range: Sets the current displayed curve range upper and lower limit (ordinate). 
 
Set Time: Sets the current displayed curve time start value (horizontal axis). 
12.2 Preset Curves 
1. Click the button “Curves” in the page “Curve”, pop up the interface as shown below, can 
preset the curve for the trend interface. 
 
Figure 12-2 Preset Curve interface 
2. Enter the following information in the interface: 
 
Curves: You can choose curve 1, 2, 3, 4, and then the preset curve will be displayed in 
the corresponding interface after selecting the curve interface. 
 
Display: Whether it is displayed on the trend screen. 
 
Preset curve properties: 
 
Name: string with a maximum of 32 characters.
--- pag 39 ---
VxBatch Monitoring Software User Manual 
35 
 
Describe: String with a maximum of 64 characters. 
 
Max/Min: Floating point value must be greater than the low limit. 
 
Type: Select the curve is the analog or the switching amount. Set before adding 
curve points, otherwise you need to delete all curve points before configuring. For a 
switch, the value of the point can only be 0 or 1. 

 
 
Time: The time of the selected point can be modified. The time of the point cannot be the 
same, the time to add the point and the old point will pop up prompt whether to replace 
the old point. 
 
Value: The value of the selected point, can be modified. 
3. Click the “Add” button to add a point in the interface list, and each preset curve adds up 
to 1200 points. 
4. Select a point in the list of points and click “Modify” and “Delete” to manipulate the point. 
5. Click the “Apply” button to view the set point in the Trend screen, click the “OK” button to 
display the curve on the trend screen and close the preset interface. 
6. End the operation. 
The user can also import and export the curve parameters of a screen through the export 
and import functions, and the files are in CSV format, which makes it easy and quick to 
change the curve information in Excel. If you prompt to abort the current parameter on 
import, be cautious and the data cannot be rolled back after import. 
 
Tip: 
Adjusting the display of the preset curve's ordinate can be achieved by adjusting its span. 
 
12.3 Batch Data Comparison 
Switch to the table interface at the top of the interface shown in Figure 12-1, as shown in the 
following figure.
--- pag 40 ---
VxBatch Monitoring Software User Manual 
36 
 
Figure 12-3 Batch data table view 
Select a batch in the batch list on the left side of the interface, and right-click Add To Table to add 
the batch’s material position number to the Table list. Support for up to 8 batches, 32 raw material 
data per batch display, raw material data automatically read from the database, not manually add 
changes. 
The Table page is divided into two sections, and the first row in the batch raw material information 
list above shows the batch number. The second line starts each row with a raw material 
information in the form “Material Name (Tag Name)Setting: [SetPoint] Actual: [Actual value] 
Deviation: [Deviation value]”. 
Below the interface is a list of raw material details, and when you click on a material in the top list, 
the details of this material are shown below. 
 
Name: The full name of the raw material used. 
 
Code: The code of the raw material used. 
 
Feed Method: The method of feeding material, such as “Auto”. 
 
Company: The supplier of raw materials. 
 
BOM Batch ID: Batch number of raw material production. Note: Not referring to the batch 
number of raw materials used in this system, but refers to the batch number of this raw 
material manufacturer. 
 
Equipment: The raw material feeding equipment of the current selection batch in this 
system. 
 
Feed Time: The feed time of this raw material in the equipment.
--- pag 41 ---
VxBatch Monitoring Software User Manual 
37 
Section 13 Server Monitor 
Through the "ServerMonitor" page, you can monitor the status of the server. 
 
Figure 13-1 Server Monitoring Control Interface 
As shown in the figure above, the server A marked "master" is the server currently in use, and the 
other server is the standby server. The server corresponding to green is a running server, and gray 
indicates that the server is offline. If it flashes red, the server is faulty. If it is white, it means that the 
server is not configured. 
When the master server has abnormal conditions such as power outage, abnormal process, and 
disconnection of the entire network, the system will automatically switch the master and standby 
servers. 
When any server is abnormal, in the interface shown in Figure 3-2, a yellow flashing prompt will 
appear in the "ServerMonitor" tab. If the master and standby servers fail at the same time, the tab 
will turn red and flash; after the server is restored, the previously running batch will be in a holding 
state. 
Users can also switch servers manually. In the case of no batch running in process management, 
click "Switch".
--- pag 42 ---
VxBatch Monitoring Software User Manual 
38 
Section 14 Equipment Information Overview 
When the batch is running, the information and interaction needs user’s attention exist. Apart from 
BatchClient, all these information also can be viewed by the overview control uniformly in the 
monitoring. 
14.1 Configuration Period 
You can set up the content showed in the monitoring period in the configuration period. 
Operation Method: add Overview control (Batch_Ctrl_UnitOverview) in the Graphic builder 
software and double click the control to open the property interface, associating with the 
corresponding product line and equipments. 
14.2 Monitoring Period 
After the configuration is completed during the configuration period, you can view the running 
information of the equipment you selected in the monitoring interface, including the operating 
status of Phase instance, interactive operation prompt, alarm prompt and to-do faults as shown 
below. 
 
Figure 14-1 Overview Control Interface 
As shown in the figure above, the selection page is on the top. If only the product line is associated 
with during the configuration period, the bar will display all the equipments under this product line. 
You can switch pages. If you associate with the product line and select one equipment, the bar will 
only display the information of the equipment you selected. If a to-do event exists, the 
corresponding page will flash in blue shade. If alarm exists, the color will be red. 
After selecting one page, the procedure status and to-do events of the selected equipment will be 
displayed. The left side will display the batch number and Unit procedure name while the right side 
will display the Phase procedure and the interactive events. You can double click the unit of 
Prompt to finish the interaction and double click the remainder to pop up the Phase panel for 
operations. 
 
Tip: 
After modifying the configuration through the engineering software, right-click in the blank 
of the list in the Overview control and select the "Configuration Overload" command to 
update the configuration information.
--- pag 43 ---
VxBatch Monitoring Software User Manual 
39 
Section 15 System Alarm Illustration 
When the batch software is used in the following situations, the corresponding system alarm will 
be generated in the control system software: 
 
When the VxBatch server is configured redundantly, if the communication between the 
two redundant servers is abnormal, a system alarm of “Batch Server Redundancy 
Abnormal” will be generated. When return to the normal status, the alarm is eliminated. 
 
When the VxBatch server does not detect the dongle authorization, a system alarm of 
“Batch Server Unauthorized” will be generated. When the dongle authorization is 
detected, the alarm is cleared.
--- pag 44 ---
VxBatch Monitoring Software User Manual 
40 
Section 16 Project Application 
This chapter briefly introduces the practical application of VxBatch software in engineering project 
through the description of two cases and the scan code confirmation function. 
16.1 Application Cases 
Case 1: Multi-equipment material flow 
1. Prevent the situation that the downstream equipment is not bound before the discharge. 
Operation guide: configure the transition condition before the feeding Phase as “test whether 
or not the next Unit is associated with the equipment”. 
2. The software recognizes the associated equipment where the material flows to by reading the 
equipment mark. This mark would be the input parameters of the feeding Phase and execute 
different subsequent logics as per different parameters. 
Case 2: if defect products are found in the production process, the production would continue 
through the jump logic. 
1. Define an interactive Phase with an output value, such as output 0 for pass and output 1 for 
fail. 
2. Define a selection branch: the first condition determines that the interactive Phase output 
value is 0; the second condition determines that the interaction Phase output value is 1, and 
sets the jump destination step. 
16.2 Scan Code Confirmation 
In the manual feeding, in order to prevent misplacement of materials, you can use the scan code 
confirmation function to check. The configuration steps are as follows: 
1. Environment configuration: 
1) Configure the network IP address of the smart scale to ensure that the scale and VxBatch 
are on the same network segment. Then configure the custom ID of the scale. 
2) Open the VendorConfig.ini file in the VxBatch installation directory (the default path is 
C:\VxBatch\), and modify the IP_ADDRESS under [EQUIPMENT_FW650] to the IP 
address of the scale. 
3) Select a computer with a VxBatch installed and a wireless network module as the one that 
interacts with the mobile app. In the VxBatch installation directory, double click the batch
--- pag 45 ---
VxBatch Monitoring Software User Manual 
41 
file Start VxBatchWebServer to install the WebService service. The service will 
automatically start after the installation. 
4) Connect the mobile equipment and the computer equipped with the WebService service 
to the same wireless network. Install the app on the mobile equipment and log in. The IP 
address to be configured on the login interface is the computer address. 
2. Configuration: In the recipe editor software, complete the configuration of the material 
management page. In the case of ensuring that the computer and the smart scale can 
communicate normally, click the “Update to the external equipments” button to update all 
the raw material parameters to the list of raw materials in the smart scale. In the 
dispatching page, select one certain Phase in the master recipe procedure interface, 
double click the raw material name on the right side and the “select material” dialog box 
will pop up, and then click the “To Scale” button. In the process management interface, 
click the “code management” button to operate. 
Note: The “Select Material” interface in the dispatch control and process management 
control also can update to the external equipments. 
3. Barcode generation and output: 
1) In the process management interface, select a batch and click the “Barcode” button to 
bring up the dialog box as shown below, including the raw material information involved in 
all the interactive feeding steps of the batch. 
 
Figure 16-1 List of production batch materials 
2) Before the batch is executed, click the “Generate Barcode” button, and the system will 
automatically unpack all the barcode data according to the weight and packaging, which 
will be displayed in the list on the right. Note: If “Package” is 0, the material cannot 
generate bar code. 
3) Click the “Output Barcode” button to publish the batch's raw material data to the scale. A 
new top-up recipe is added to the list of scales, and a weighing task is generated 
according to the new recipe. 
4. Weighing and printing labels on the scale: Select the batch task in the production task list 
of the scale and start it, jump to the ingredient monitoring page, weigh it and print and 
paste the label. 
5. Mobile scanning code confirmation: When the batch runs to the manual interaction step 
to be confirmed, the mobile terminal will automatically update the to-do task. Click the 
to-do task to enter the details page as shown in Figure 16-2.
--- pag 46 ---
VxBatch Monitoring Software User Manual 
42 
If it is manual feeding step, please click the Scan Code button 
 to scan the QR code 
on all material labels in turn. The system will automatically verify the bar code, if the 
barcode number is verified successfully, it can be submitted. If you scan the same one 
too many times or the code is error, a red prompt will appear. If it is manual confirmation 
step, after the data is completed and the information is confirmed, you can submit it. 
 
Figure 16-2 The Operation Diagram of the Mobile Client 
6. The feeding schedule displays the material amount this interactive step needs. After 
feeding all the corresponding materials, this step is completed. 
 
Attentions: 
 
When the barcode is generated again, all barcode data of the current batch will be 
cleared. Please be cautious. 
 
When barcodes is being output, you should ensure that the VxBatch and the material 
list in the scale are the same, otherwise the output would fail. 
 
If a task of the scale is not completed and then other tasks are started, the previous 
task will be “suspended”. 
 
The mobile client login IP is the one of the computer the WebService locates and the 
port is 3083. You would log in with VxBatch username and the password.
--- pag 47 ---
VxBatch Monitoring Software User Manual 
43

VxBatch Project Configuration Software User Manual 
1 
VxBatch Configuration Software 
Section 1 Terminology 
Terminology 
Description 
Area 
The components of a mass production site may be marked in physical, geographic or 
logical segments in the site. 
Note: An area can contain multiple process components, units, equipment modules, and 
control modules. 
Batch 
1. 
Perform a batch of substances processed or produced in batch production. 
2. 
An entity representing the production of matter at any point in the process. 
Note: Batches indicate both the substances produced in the process produced by the 
process and the entities that represent the production of the substance. Batch is an abstract 
abbreviation for “mass production”. 
Batch Control 
A method is provided for processing a limited amount of input material control activity and 
control functions through a set of ordered processing activities over a limited period of time 
using one or more equipments. 
Batch Process 
In a limited time, one or more equipments are used to process the input material through an 
ordered set of processing activities, resulting in the process of producing a limited amount 
of material. 
Equipment Entity 
A group of physical processing and control equipments and equipments that are combined 
to perform a control function or a set of control functions. 
Phase 
The lowest level program element in the program control model, such as feeding, stirring 
and temperature control. 
Process 
Ordered chemical, physical or biological activities during the conversion, transport or 
storage of materials or energy. 
Process Cell 
A logical grouping of equipments that includes a batch or several mass production required 
equipments that define a range of process equipments and logic controls within an area. It 
is called a equipment in software, such as one production line. 
Recipe 
A set of necessary information to specifically determine the production requirements for a 
particular product. 
Note: Includes master recipe and control recipe. 
Master Recipe 
A recipe that describes equipment capabilities and may contain process component specific 
information.

Section 2 Overview 
Batch control software is generally used in the fine chemical and pharmaceutical industry and to 
manage the formulations uniformly and in bulk, which is composed of materials, equipment, 
production procedures (technique parameters and material parameters) and various engineering 
procedures during the fine chemical production line, in order to make the management of the 
process faster and more convenient. 
Batch management software is consisted of project configuration software, recipe editor software 
and monitor operational software, and the functions to be realized is shown in Figure 2-1. 
 
BatchCfg: it is used to set system configuration and commonly installed on the engineer 
station. Engineers with authority of project management is in charge of the configuration 
building and maintenance in a bid to realize project physical modeling and program 
modeling. 
 
RecipeEditor: it is generally installed on the information network or engineer server. The 
technique engineer is in charge of building a production recipe, maintaining material and 
production information. 
 
Monitoring and operational software: it includes VxBatchClient and Overview controls, 
which are used to view the batch production process or history batch information. 
Operators are in charge of the supervision on monitor and daily maintenance.

Section 3 Work Flow 
As for a new production project in batch, following steps are the reference steps for configuration 
engineers to design the project. 
1. Have sufficient communication with a process engineer in order to know the overall 
process. 
2. Plans: complete the design of physical model and program model as per the technique 
requirement in field. 
1) Build a physical model, and divide prefix characters as per the physical model and 
the actual encoding rules. For details, see Physical Model and Prefix Character 
Illustration. 
2) Build a procedure model and divide program class in each level. For details, see 
Program Model. 
3. Project implementation: 
1) determine one Phase class and edit SFC program as per Phase instance to 
realize each stages in the technique production, see “SFC editing illustration” in 
VxBatch RecipeEditor User Manual. 
2) Complete building physical model and setting the prefix characters in the project 
configuration software and setting the property of each program class and user 
permission as per the program model as shown in Figure 3-1. 
3) Assist process engineers to complete the recipe configuration, debug the recipe 
and pilot the batch. For details, see VxBatch RecipeEditor User Manual and 
VxBatch Monitor User Manual.

VxBatch Recipe Editor User Manual 
1 
VxBatch Recipe Editor 
Section 1 Overview 
Batch control software is generally used in the fine chemical, pharmaceutical industry and to 
manage the recipes uniformly and in batches, in order to make the management of the process 
faster and more convenient. 
The batch management software consists of project configuration software, recipe editor software 
and monitoring operational software This manual mainly describes the functions and usages of the 
configuration software.
--- pag 5 ---
VxBatch Configuration Software User Manual 
2 
Section 2 Work Flow 
The recipe editing software (Recipe Editor) is used for recipe management. It is usually installed 
on the information network or engineer server. The process engineer is responsible for configuring 
the recipe and routine maintenance of the configuration. 
The job flow chart for recipe configuration is shown below. 
Material Management
Product Management
Product Configuration
Material Configuration
Recipe Management
Add New Recipe
Set Recipe Header Properties
Edit Procedure
Bind Cell and Equipment
Configure Exception Processing
Edit Formula
Configure Electronic Signature
Configure Unit Instance
Configure Operation Instance
Configure Phase Instance
Configure Parameters of 
Material & Technique
 
Figure 2-1 The Workflow
--- pag 6 ---
VxBatch Configuration Software User Manual 
3 
Section 3 Open the Software 
Select [Start / All Programs / VxBatch (V3.0) / Recipe Editor Software] from the start menu, and the 
recipe editing interface login window will pop up. Enter the user name and password and click 
“Login” to enter the recipe management page of the recipe editing software. As shown in Figure 
3-1, the recipe editing software consists of three tabs: Material management, used to define basic 
material information; product management, used to define product material BOM; recipe 
management, used to define main recipe property. 
 
Figure 3-1 Recipe Editor Interface (Recipe Management Interface) 
 
 
Tip: 
After any configuration in the Recipe Editor Software, you can click 
 at the left upper 
corner to save the modified parameters.
--- pag 7 ---
VxBatch Configuration Software User Manual 
4 
Section 4 Material Management 
In the material management, the properties of the material can be configured and the tags of the 
material can also be set. After configuring which material to use and its amount in the recipe, the 
amount value will be loaded to the corresponding tag to this material. 
4.1 Material Configuration 
Click the “Material Management” page above to enter the material management configuration 
interface, as shown in Figure 4-1, through the button above, you can New-add, Copy, Delete and 
Reload the material information, and up to 1,000 kinds of material can be added. 
 
Figure 4-1 Material management 
The parameters in the material management are described as follows: 
 
Name: A material name is used when you want to select one of the material and the 
name can be repetitive. 
 
Code: This is a unique ID of the material. It cannot be null or repetitive and cannot 
exceed 32 characters. 
 
Group: select from the drop-down menu. You can add a new material group and enter a 
name when creating a new kind of material. 
 
EU: Set the measuring unit of the material. 
 
Batch Tag: Set the batch number corresponding to the material name. Enter tags in the 
pop-up dialog box after double clicking it. 
 
Location: set the location where to store the material. 
 
Inventory: set the original storage amount of the material. 
 
Package: set the standard package specification of one package of material. Double 
click the item to modify it.
--- pag 8 ---
VxBatch Configuration Software User Manual 
5 
 
Property: you can set the physical state to the raw materials by selecting from the 
drop-down menu. 
 
Tips: 
 
The tag is read and obtained from the monitoring platform, but the tag deletion and 
modification of the monitoring platform don’t influence the existed tags. It only checks 
the tag’s effectiveness when the batch is generated. 
 
If the set value of “Package” is 0, the barcode cannot be generated in the “To Scale” 
interface. 
 
Table 4-1 The button list of the recipe management 
Button 
Description 
Remark 
New 
Create a new item of material information. For 
parameter description, please refer to this section. 
One configuration supports up to 
1,000 items of material information. 
Copy 
Take the existed material as the template and create a 
new item of material. It is allowed to modify the property. -

The material information the recipe 
used cannot be deleted.

Select the .CSV file and import the material information

For details, see Material Table

For details, see Material Table 
Import/Export.

-

User Manual for the function of “scan

4.2 Material Table Import/Export 
In order to improve the efficiency of raw material configuration, you can use the “export” and 
“import” buttons to quickly configure similar raw material information. 
1. Click the “Export” button above and the “Save As” interface will pop up. The current 
material information will be saved as .csv file. 
2. As shown in the figure below, after modifying the material information in batch in the .csv 
file and click “Import” button to re-import the information in the system.
--- pag 9 ---
VxBatch Configuration Software User Manual 
6

The parameter such as “sequence number”, “Name” cannot be modified arbitrarily, otherwise 
it may cause failure. 
 
 
Figure 4-2 The material table
--- pag 10 ---
VxBatch Configuration Software User Manual 
7 
Section 5 Product Management 
Through the “Product Management” page, you can define the BOM of product raw materials. In 
general, the BOM of product raw materials in the VxBatch system is obtained from the MES 
system, and can also be added manually. 
Click the “Product Management” tab above to enter the product management configuration 
interface, as shown in the following figure. All product information is displayed on the left, an item 
of product information is selected, and the input and output materials related to the product are 
displayed on the right. By entering keywords, you can filter the displayed information in terms of 
Product Name, Product Code, or Version. 
 
Figure 5-1 Product Management 
5.1 Product Configuration 
You can add, edit and delete information to the product information in the “Product Management” 
interface. The description is as follows. 
5.1.1 Add Product Information 
You can add a new item of product information by following these steps: 
1) Click the “New” button above to bring up the “New Product” dialog box, as shown below. 
 
Figure 5-2 “Add Products” Dialog Box
--- pag 11 ---
VxBatch Configuration Software User Manual 
8 
2) According to the following instructions, the basic information of the product can be edited. 
 
Name: Enter product name in the text box. 
 
Code: the code information of products. Version number and code cannot be the same at 
the same time. Also, it cannot be empty. 
 
Version: the version information of products. It is not allowed to use Chinese or special 
characters. The length cannot exceed 32 characters. 
 
Normal Size: the standard production of products. The input value has to be the float 
number. The default number is 100. It cannot be 0. 
3) Click the “OK” to save the changes. 
5.1.2 Copy Product Information 
Taking the existed product information as sample, you can fast add product information by “Copy” 
function. The steps are as follows: 
1) Taking one item of product information as sample and click “Copy” button on the top. 
2) The “Copy product” dialog will pop up where you can edit the added newly product 
information. 
3) Click “OK”. 
The product information got by copy function would be with the materials associated with the 
sample. You can edit it in the right interface. Please refer to Material Configuration for description. 
5.1.3 Edit Product Information 
Select one item of product information in the product list, and double click the cell to modify its 
information. 
5.1.4 Delete Product Information 
Select the information you want to delete and click “Delete” on the top. Click “OK” in the double 
check box, and then the deletion is completed. 
5.2 Material Configuration 
After configuring the product information, you can associate the input materials and output 
materials used in the recipe with the product. The steps are as follows: 
 
Add materials: 
1) Select an item of product information and select the “Input Material” or “Output 
Material” tab in the right interface.
--- pag 12 ---
VxBatch Configuration Software User Manual 
9 
2) In the material list, right-click and select the “New” command from the right-click 
menu. 
3) In the “Select Material” window that pops up, double-click the material to add it. 
4) The newly added materials would be displayed in the material list. Double click the 
cell after selecting materials where you can modify material mark and feeding 
quantity. Material identification is used to distinguish different phases of the same 
material. The feeding amount is the set value of the material. 
5) After completing the configuration, click the button in the upper left corner of the 
recipe editor software to save the modification. 
 
Delete material: 
Select an item of material information and select the “Delete” command in the right-click 
menu.
--- pag 13 ---
VxBatch Configuration Software User Manual 
10 
Section 6 Recipe Management 
The main interface of recipe manager is shown in Figure 3-1, which is used to manage the recipes 
used in production, including new construction, submission, and examination. 
For parameter description, see Configure Recipe . The buttons at the top of the page are 
described as follows:

Button

6.1 Add a New Recipe 
Click “New” button and the “New Recipe” dialog box will pop up as shown in the figure below. For 
the description of the property parameters, please refer to Configure Recipe Properties. 
 
Figure 6-1 Add a New Recipe 
6.2 Delete a Recipe 
Select the recipe and click the “Delete” button above; in the delete confirmation dialog, select “OK” 
to delete this recipe and select “Cancel” to cancel this operation. 
6.3 Configure Recipe Properties 
In the “Recipe Management” page, you can view or modify the basic properties, including Name, 
Version, Version desc, Status, Recipe Class, Group, Remark, Process Cell, Product Name, and 
Recipe Power. 
 
Figure 6-2 Recipe Basic Properties
--- pag 15 ---
VxBatch Configuration Software User Manual 
12 
 
Name: Recipe name shall be configured when a new recipe is created and cannot be 
modified. The recipe name and version cannot be repeated at the same time. They are 
not allowed to be empty. Chinese or special characters are not allowed, and the length is 
no more than 32 characters. 
 
Version: Recipe version information shall be configured when a new recipe is created 
and cannot be modified. The recipe name and version cannot be repeated at the same 
time. It cannot be empty. Chinese or special characters are also not allowed, and the 
length is no more than 32 characters. 
 
Version Decs: You can edit the remark information of the recipe version. 
 
Status: the newly added recipe status is “editable” and the status transition of recipe is 
shown in the figure below. 
Reject
Submit
Validate
Abort
Editable
To Be 
Verified
Released
Abandoned
 
Figure 6-3 Status transition of recipe 
Note: only recipes in active state can create batch. 
 
Recipe Class: Recipe class of the recipe shall be selected when a new recipe is created 
and cannot be modified. The recipe class is configured in the VxBatch configuration 
software. Please see the section “Recipe Class” of VxBatch Configuration Software User 
Manual. 
 
Group: Recipe grouping. When creating a new recipe, you can select an existing group 
or enter a grouping name to create a new one. 
 
Remark, Product Name and Recipe Power: the information on the recipe details page. 
For details, please refer to Recipe Header. 
 
Process Cell: There may be multiple backup equipments, indicating that the master 
recipe can be used in these equipments. For details, please refer to Equipment 
Requirements. 
6.3.1 Recipe Header 
The “Recipe Header” page is used to define the basic information of the recipe, such as the 
product, remarks, maximum output / minimum output / standard output associated with the recipe.
--- pag 16 ---
VxBatch Configuration Software User Manual 
13 
 
Figure 6-4 Recipe Details Page (Editable Status) 
After the new recipe is created, the recipe name and version are not allowed to be modified. The 
remaining parameters can be modified in the “Header” tab, as explained below: 
 
Remark: You can edit the remark information of the recipe. 
 
Version Description: You can edit the remark information of the recipe in the area of 
version. 
 
Recipe Power: Configure the recipe type. The privilege corresponding to the recipe type 
is the operation privilege of the recipe. “Common Type Recipe”, “Top-secret recipe” or 
custom recipe type is optional. The recipe type is set in the “Basic Configuration” and the 
recipe permissions are set in “User Authorization”. For details, see the VxBatch 
Configuration Software User Manual. 
 
Product Name and Version: Product and version information produced as per the recipe. 
Click 
 to bring up the product selection interface, you can also input product name 
manually. After selecting the product, you only need to select the required raw material 
information from the list of raw materials of the selected product when editing the Phase 
instance; if product has not been selected, all the raw material information will be listed 
for editing when the Phase instance is being edited. Optional products are configured at 
the “Product Management” node, as described in the chapter Product Management. 
 
EU: The unit of product quantity, which is selected in the drop-down menu. You can also 
input the unit manually. 
 
Product Maximum / Product Minimum/ Product Normal: enter product quantity 
parameters in the text box. It cannot be empty, and the Product Minimum≤ Product
--- pag 17 ---
VxBatch Configuration Software User Manual 
14 
Normal ≤ Product Maximum. If both the Product Maximum and Product Minimum are set 
to 0, the Product Normal is the set value. The Product Normal is not limited by the 
Product Maximum or the Product Minimum. Otherwise, the system will test if or not the 
standard product is between the Product Minimum and the Product Maximum when 
recipe is tested. 
Under normal circumstances, the minimum output ≤ standard output ≤ maximum 
output must be met. If both the maximum output and the minimum output are set to 0, the 
standard output is not limited by the interval. 
 
If products are selected in the recipe, the standard product set in the product 
management will be updated to the recipe. 
 
Modify Time and modifier: The modification time of the recipe and the modification 
person are automatically generated when the recipe is being modified and saved. 
 
Create Time and creator: The creation time and creator of the recipe are automatically 
generated when the recipe is being created. 
 
Approval time and approver: The examination time of the recipe and the examiner are 
automatically generated when the recipe is being examined. 
6.3.2 Formula 
Although the parameters under the same recipe are fixed, the values of the parameters may be 
different. Therefore, it is necessary to save multiple parameter combinations of different values. by 
the “Formula” function. At the same time, in the formula table, the setting amount of all input 
parameters under the formula can be changed uniformly for convenient operation. 
Select the “Formula” tab on the recipe details page and switch to the formula list page, as shown 
below. You can set the formula to the formula shall be used by the recipe by checking a formula in 
the Default column. 
 
Figure 6-5 “Formula Page” in Formula Details 
Add Formula 
There is a base formula by default in each recipe, and the remaining custom formulas are created 
by the base formula. You can create a new formula by following these steps: 
1) Right-click in the formula list and select “Add” in the right-click menu to bring up the “New 
Formula” dialog box, as shown below
--- pag 18 ---
VxBatch Configuration Software User Manual 
15 
 
Figure 6-6 Add New Formula Dialog Box 
2) Configure the basic parameters of the formula according to the following instructions. 
 
Name: enter it in the text box. The formula name cannot be repeated, it cannot be 
empty, it doesn’t support special characters and the length cannot exceed 32 
characters. 
 
Remark: The comment information of the formula is entered in the text box. 
 
Copy From: select from the drop-down menu. If an existing custom formula is 
selected, the newly created formula will copy the set value of the selected formula; if 
not selected, the newly created formula will copy the set value of the base formula. 
3) After completing the configuration, click “OK”. 
Modify the Set Value 
After you selecting a formula in the formula list, the parameters and settings under the formula are 
displayed on the right. The parameters included in the formula are the parameters added into the 
Recipe layer in the master recipe. Please see the description in Equipment Requirements. 
The setting value of the parameter is displayed in the format of “<value>”. Double-click the cell to 
change the value. If the parameter of the base formula is modified, the new set value will be 
updated to the parameters of the Procedure page; if the parameter value of the custom formula is 
modified, the set value will only display the value. 
The modified custom value can be restored to the default setting as follows: 
1) Select the parameter in the parameter list that needs to restore. 
2) Right-click and select “Use Base Value” from the right-click menu.
--- pag 19 ---
VxBatch Configuration Software User Manual 
16 
6.3.3 Procedure 
A master recipe consists of several Unit instances, an Operation instance, and several instances 
of the Phase class. This section mainly describes how to configure the master recipe, Unit 
instance, Operation instance and Phase instance. 
 
Figure 6-7 Program model diagram 
This section mainly describes the master recipe, Unit instance, Operation instance and Phase 
instance. 
Recipe Procedure 
Select “Procedure” page in the recipe details page and switch to the procedure page as shown in 
Figure 6-8. The tree directory on the left shows the instance details of the current master recipe, 
and the right side contains two tabs which are master recipe Procedure SFC and Unit Procedure 
list. The tab of master recipe program SFC displays Procedure SFC interface and Unit Procedure 
of the master Recipe layer. 
 
Figure 6-8 Recipe Editor Interface
--- pag 20 ---

17 
1) Select the start step in the “Procedure SFC” tab, click “Add Seq Step” or “Add Branch” to 
add a step or branch. For SFC programming, please refer to “SFC Programming 
Instructions”. 
2) Double-click the newly added step to open the interface as shown in Figure 6-9, and set 
the basic properties of the step. The step is the Unit instance. Adding steps is to increase 
the Unit instance. 
 
Step: it is the serial number of the step. The system automatically recognizes it 
and it cannot be changed. 




displays the referenced Unit class by the step. 


this real instance can be selected in the drop-down box. 
 
Copy Procedure: select one real instance as the sample to make it as the same 
as the real instance. In the step property of the real instance, the referenced 
program class is the same as the sample instance which cannot be modified. 
The description is the name of the sample instance that can be modified. The 
Operation instance, Phase instance and the sample instance are the same. 
 
Figure 6-9 Step Property 
3) Right click in the parameter list and the right-click menu is shown below.
--- pag 21 ---
VxBatch Configuration Software User Manual 
18 
 
Figure 6-10 The right-click menu of parameter list 


configuration as per the table below.

Program Structure 
An introduction to the SFC program is shown in Figure 7-2. 
 
Figure 7-2 SFC program 
Programming Rule
--- pag 31 ---
VxBatch Configuration Software User Manual 
28 
 
Supports sequential, parallel, select, loop, and jump structures. 
 
Sequence structure: Start from the beginning step, meet the conditions and then 
proceed to the next step in order until the end step exits the program. 
 
Parallel structure: A structure containing parallel branches. When the current 
transition condition is satisfied, all the branches under the parallel branch start 
running at the same time. When all the branches finish running and the transition 
conditions are met, the parallel branch runs. 
 
Select structure: A structure containing selected branches, which are executed along the 
branch that first satisfies the condition in the selection branch, and other branches will 
not be executed. When there are more than two selection branches satisfying the 
condition at the same time, the leftmost branch is executed first. 
 
Jump structure: When the pre-transition condition of the jump is satisfied, the program 
logic jumps directly to the target step and continues from that step. 
 
Loop structure: When the pre-transition condition of the jump is satisfied, the program 
logic jumps to the target step that has been executed to form a logical loop. 
 
When the conversion condition is logic “true”, the program goes to the next step; if it is 
logical “false”, then each conversion cycle needs to scan to this conversion. 
 
When the conversion condition is not met, the currently active step will be executed in 
each scan cycle until the current activation step fails and the next step is activated. 
 
There are only one initial step and one termination step in each custom SFC, and up to 
128 steps are supported. 
 
Up to 16 branches can be supported in each selection structure or parallel structure, and 
the maximum number of output pins can be set to 16.

Section 1 Overview 
The configuration of remote communication station driver and service can be achieved via the 
data collector (VxCollector). VxCollector can complete the communication cascade connection 
with VxSCADA, PIMS, and other softwares, and expand the data acquisition and data 
transmission. 
VxCollector can load various I/O drivers, receive data from third-party and transmit data via the 
unified protocol of industry. 
VxCollector has two main functions, configuration and running. 
 
Configuration refers to configuring the driver, service and tag, and is called as 
configuration stage. 
 
Running refers to start the communication service and debug online, etc., and is called 
as running stage. 
VxCollector can manage several drivers and services. 
The user manuals of VxCollector includes this text, VxCollector Project Guide and IO Driver User 
Manual.

In PIMS System 
In PIMS system, by following steps, VxCollector can be installed by disk. 
1. Open PIMS install disk, click “Install” after “Remote Data Collector”.

continue the installation.

then click “Next”. 
5. Popup the “Choose Destination Location” interface, click “Browser” to select the 
destination path or default path, then click “Next”. 
6. Start to install and popup the installation complete interface, click “Complete” to exit the 
installation. 
In VxSCADA Sysetm 
In VxSCADA system, VxCollector is installed as one of components. The installation method 
please refers to VxSCADA Software Installation User Manual and the key steps are shown below. 
1. Open VxSCADA system software disk and install the software following tips. 
2. Select “VxCollector” in “Select component” interface and click “Next Step”. 
3. Continue to install the software following tips until “Finish”. 
In VxHistorian System 
When using with VxHistorian software, VxCollector is installed as one of components. The 
installation method please refers to VxHistorian Software Installation User Manual and the key 
steps are shown below. 
1. Open VxHistorian system software disk and install the software following tips. 
2. Select “VxCollector” in “Select component” interface and click “Next”. 
3. Select the drivers which need to be installed in VxCollector and click “Next”. 
4. Popup the “Collector Configuration Content” interface, click “Browser” to select the 
destination path or default path, then click “Next”. 
5. Input user name and passwords of remote OPC server and click “Next”. 
6. Continue to install the software following tips until “Finish”.

Section 9 Export and Import 
This section describes the export and import operations. 
9.1 Export Existed Tag List of Service 
User can export the existed tag list of service to use the exported file in the client of the third party.

service:

2. Right-click the “Service” and select “Export Exist Tag List”. 
3. Select save path and input file name to export the existed tag list. Click “Open” to pop up 
the prompt dialog. 
4. Click “OK” to complete the export. 
9.2 Import/Export Database 
The configuration information of the PIMS, VxSCADA and VxCollector are compatible. User can 
keep the consistency of the database configurations between them by importing and exporting the 
database. When importing the configuration file exported form the PIMS or VxSCADA to the 
VxCollector, the software will eliminate the non-VxCollector tag information, such as the alarm tag, 
non-local node and extend configuration tag, etc.

VxCollector.

interface.

1. Save the configuration file before exporting. Otherwise, a prompt of “Current 
configuration has not been saved, to save and export?” will pop up. Click “Yes” to save 
and export the latest configuration file. Click “No” to not save, and export the 
configuration file before modifying. Click “Cancel” to cancel the export. 
2. Select the menus [File/ Export Database] and select the saving path in the “Save As” 
interface.

mode. 
1) Import and substitute: use the currently imported tags to substitute the existing

01

One Card for Loading
02
By integrating with multiple systems such as ERP, logistics systems, and inspection and testing systems, a closed-loop management system for transportation operations has been successfully established, enhancing the refinement level of enterprise management.
Multi-system Integration
Qinghai Monalisa Petrochemical Co., Ltd.'s 76,000m³ oil storage and logistics EPC project includes 14 loading and 14 unloading crane positions, primarily handling materials such as gasoline and diesel. The system achieves integrated control of the storage area through a supply chain logistics system, leveraging applications like logistics access control, queuing and numbering, handheld PDA, unmanned vehicle scales, SQI-3000 batch controllers, and skid-mounted units to realize intelligent collaborative business applications.
02

Full Process Control

01

One Card for Loading
02
The loading system achieves a closed-loop data sharing with third-party systems such as SAP, marketing logistics systems, and DCS, which enables collaborative control and management of tank truck transportation operations. This effectively aids in the optimized allocation of internal resources and enhances overall operational efficiency.
Data Integration and Sharing
Sinopec-SK (Wuhan) Petrochemical Company Limited is a large-scale integrated oil refining and chemical enterprise jointly established by Sinopec Group and South Korea's SK Corporation. It is the largest oil refining and chemical production base in Central China.The chemical liquid loading and unloading station's vehicle loading system features a total of 26 loading positions, primarily handling 19 types of materials including pyrolysis C4, liquefied carbon 4, and ethylene glycol. The system employs the SQI-3000 batch controller, integrated with vehicle loading and unloading business management software, to achieve a technical upgrade for the one-card pass system.

Background
Scientific Evaluation  

Based in large part on aircraft data collected by Texas 2000 Air Quality Study  Results showed that ethylene, propylene, 1,3- butadiene play role in rapid ozone formation. Study revealed industrial VOC emissions likely significantly understated in earlier inventories  Analysis to date provides strong support that controlling highly-reactive VOCs is necessary to prevent many of the rapid ozone forming events.

More detailed analyses indicated that other reactive VOCs, - isoprene, butenes, formaldehyde, acetaldehyde, toluene, pentenes, trimethylbenzenes, xylenes and ethyltoluenes - may also contribute to ozone production in the HGA.  Other scientists have indicated that large amounts of less reactive VOC emissions may have contributed to ozone production in the HGA.

Database Management

Database Management
Section 1 Overview
Database management software can support connections of OPC and the third-party devices
through I/O drivers, which includes inner simulation variable driver, driver of the third-party devices,
driver of common communication protocol and etc. At the same time, the software can support
extended variable and the configuration function of custom structural tags.
1.1 Function Features
The main functions of database management software are to configure drivers and to edit tag
information which includes basic information like tag name and extended information like alarm
limit. In addition, database management software provides functions such as tag search, locate,
filter, etc.
Specific Function Features:

Support management of multiple drivers.

Flexible filter function.

Support multiple types of alarm setting.

Efficiently and quickly query.

Powerful extend configuration ability which completely supports arithmetic operation,
relation operation, and logic operation.

Support database import and database export.

Support tag import and tag export.

Support the position number disconnection retention function

Support Chinese position number names
1.2 Technical Specification
Support tag types of integer, digital, string and extended variable and custom structural tag.
Single project supports maximum 100000 domain variables.
SOLISCADA achieves the communication between I/O drivers and field hardware via database
management. At present, the drivers of software include these types:

Support several kinds of driver communication protocols, such as CDT driver, IEC104
Master driver, Modbus RTU driver, Modbus TCP driver, OPC DA driver, OPC UA driver,
Trusted Modbus TCP driver, Modbus TCP Slave diver, Modbus RTU Plus driver and
--- pag 6 ---
Database Management
2
DNP3 driver, MELSEC driver, MQTT driver, DLT645_2007 driver and etc.

Support several kinds of drivers of the third-party devices, such as GCS driver, TCS-900
driver, ABCONTROLLOGIX driver, SUPCON Collector driver, Siemens FetchWrite
driver, SiemensPLCS7CommDriver and etc.

Support several kinds of drivers of diagnosis information, such as SNMP driver,
NodeSniffer driver and etc.

Support several kinds of inner simulation variable driver (Memory driver), which can
simulate some variables.
--- pag 7 ---

3

management software, and the interface is as shown in Figure 2- 1. In database management
software, the operation interfaces of local node, extended variables and custom structural tags are
similar. There are some slight differences in the availability of some functions on the toolbar or
menu bar. Functions that are not available will be in gray.
Figure 2- 1 Interface of database management software

title bar, menu bar, toolbar, structure tree, tag list and status bar.

local node of the database node you can see the added driver nodes.


The area displays the basic information of tag, which includes tag name, type, description,

3.1 Add/Delete/Configure Driver
3.1.1 Add Driver
Steps to add a driver:
1)
Open the interface of “Select I/O Driver” by following methods:

Select the “Database” or “Local Node” and click
in toolbar.

Right-click “Local Node” and select “Add Driver”.
2)

driver.
3)

Management Software interface.
Tips:

--- pag 11 ---

3.1.2 Delete Driver
User can delete the driver by following methods:

Select the driver below the node “Local Node” and click
in toolbar.

Right-click the driver which needs to be deleted and select “Remove Driver” in the
right-click menu.
Tips:

Delete operation can’t be repealed, please pay attention to the operation.

After deleting the driver, all tags under the driver and the association between the tag
and label will be deleted together.
3.1.3 Configure Driver
Open the interface of driver configuration by following methods. Please refer to IO Driver User
Manual for detailed configuration.

Double-click the driver below “Local Node”.

Right-click the driver below “Local Node” and select “Driver Configuration” in right-click
menu.
Tips:

If you can’t open the interface of driver configuration by double-clicking the driver, it
means that the driver needn’t configuration, such as Memory driver, NodeSniffer
driver and etc.

After open the interface of driver configuration, you can get the HELP file of the driver
by pressing F1.
3.2 Add Tag
There are 2 ways to add tags:

Add tags manually: The steps will be introduced in following description.

Imported when configuring driver: some drivers support to import tags directly. Select the
tags which need to be added in the configuring interface of drivers, save and close the
configuring interface, then selected tags will be added to database automatically. Please
refer to IO Driver User Manual for the details of drivers.
--- pag 12 ---

on, the system will tip you to add these tags manually.

number, the value of the pin bit number during operation is BAD;

When there is a custom structure bit number in the database, the custom structure
type of the bit number in the object model supports modification, including
modification of the custom structure type name/basic information, addition,
deletion and modification of structure pins;

After the custom structure type is modified, the custom structure bit number in the
database will be updated synchronously:

Add pin

Delete pin

Modify pin

Type name and basic information modification

Note: Pin name modification will be considered as deletion of the original pin.
Adding a new pin will automatically lose the original pin association information of
the bit number;

After the custom structure type is modified, the model that references the custom
structure type in the user model will be updated synchronously;

Type update in the model

Structure pin update in the model

After the custom structure type is modified, it needs to be published in its entirety
After the custom structure type is modified, the original unmodified bit number pin value
can still be displayed normally, and the added/modified pin bit number value is BAD.
After the pin is re-associated with IO or bit number in the database, the value can be
displayed normally after the configuration is released.
--- pag 36 ---
Database Management
32
Section 6 Find Tag
User can search a specific tag via the “Find” function. The operation only is useful for tag
information which is displayed in the tag list. In other words, if you select “Database” or “Local
Node”, it will search in all tag information of all drivers and if you select the driver, it will search in
the tag information of the selected driver. And when you select “Extended Variable” or “Custom
structure”, it only searches tag information under the corresponding nodes.
Operation Steps
Select the node, open the “Find” dialog box by these ways, as shown in Figure 6- 1.

Select menu command [Tools/Find] in menu bar.

Click the button
on toolbar.
Figure 6- 1 Dialog box of find tag
Specific Methods:

Fuzzy search: Enter substring (such as part of tag name, description, I/O driver, etc.) of
the tag information to be searched, click "Find Next”, and the tags whose tag information
accord with the conditions will be displayed line by line.

Select “Match Whole Word Only”: Enter the complete information, select “Match Whole
Word Only”, and then click "Find Next", and the tags whose tag information matches the
conditions will be displayed line by line. If there is no content that meets the conditions,
the prompt that the tag number cannot be found will pop up.

Select “Match Case“: Select “Match Case” to distinguish capital letters and lowercase
letters. Otherwise, the letters are not case sensitive.
--- pag 37 ---
Database Management
33
Section 7 Import/Export Database
The configuration information of the SOLISCADA and VxCollector are compatible. User can keep
the consistency of their database configurations by importing and exporting the database. When
importing the configuration file exported from the SOLISCADA to the InPlant Collector, the
software will eliminate the not collector tag information, such as the alarm tag, non-local node and
extend configuration tag, etc.
7.1 Import Database
Follow the steps below to import the database configuration file of InPlant Collector to the
SOLISCADA.
1.
Select the menus [File/ Import Database], and select a .vxbk file from the “Open”
interface.
2.
A prompt will pop up after importing successfully.
7.2 Export Database
Follow the steps below to export the database configuration file of the SOLISCADA.
1.
Save the configuration file before exporting. Otherwise, a prompt of “Current
configuration has not been saved, to save and export?” will pop up. Click “Yes” to save
and export the latest configuration file. Click “No” to not save, and export the
configuration file before modifying. Click “Cancel” to cancel the export.
2.
Select the menus [File/ Export Database] and select the saving path in the “Save As”
interface.
3.
A prompt will pop up after exporting successfully.
--- pag 38 ---
Database Management
34
Section 8 Import/Export Tags of All Nodes
This function can import/export tags and alarm information of all nodes, while not include node
information of driver and collector. The node of driver and collector configuration of import station
is recommended to be same with export station, to make sure complete import of tag information.
Import/export files are all in format of .csv, and support editing via OFFICE and WPS.
8.1 Import All Tags
Import tag to database configuration by following steps.
1.
Select menu commands [File/ Import All Node Tags] to pop up the "Open" dialog.
2.
Select .csv file and click "Open".
3.
Select import mode and click "OK" to import tag. Import modes include "Empty Import"
and "Additional Import".

Select "Empty Import" to clear all tags of node before importing.

Select "Additional Import", a dialog shown in Figure 8- 1 will pop up if tag imported repeat
name with tag existed. User can solve the problem according to the prompt and as
required.
Figure 8- 1 Conflict Reconciliation
Make sure the driver or remote node of tag has been added when importing tag, otherwise, the tag
cannot be imported.
--- pag 39 ---
Database Management
35
8.2 Export All Tags
Export tag from database configuration by following steps:
1.
Select menu commands [File/ Export all Nodes Tags], select file save path in "Save As"
dialog pop up, input file name, the file type is ".csv", which cannot be changed.
2.
Click "Save" to export tags and alarm information of all nodes (local node, collector,
extend configuration variable) in database.
--- pag 40 ---
Database Management
36
Section 9 Import/Export Tags of Single Node
Import/Export tags of single node means import tags of selected driver. Operation is the same as
import/Export tags of all nodes, except the path of command menu.
If you need import/export tags of single driver, please right click the driver node under the Local
Node, and click Import Tag or Export Tag in menu. Please refer to Import/Export Tags of All Nodes
for detail.
--- pag 41 ---
Database Management
37
Section 10 Debug Online
Tips:

The host running online debug should be the node of subproject, while it may not be the
server.

Online debug can be run only after saving and publishing the current configuration.

If the database configuration has been modified, the online debug can be started only after
saving the modification, or the menu and button of online debug are both unavailable.

The monitoring software should be started before starting the online debug.

The data source reconnection is supported in the online debug mode. If the data source is
interrupted when debugging, the real-time value of tag is shown as empty. After the data
source is restored to normal, the software will be restored automatically, and the correct
real-time information can be shown.
User can view the real-time information of tag in configuration via online debugging, and judge the
correctness of driver and tag configuration.
After configuring the driver and tag, follow the steps below to debug the configuration online:
1.
Select the menus [Tools/ Startup Online Debug] to pop up the dialog below.
Figure 10- 1 Select the address of online debug
2.
Select the server IP to be connected from the drop-down menu of Select IP Address. If it
is stand-alone node, user can select the 127.0.0.1 and appoint the local computer as the
data source directly; if not, user can appoint other servers as the data source directly.
3.
Click “OK” to debug, and all menu and toolbar items can operate the driver and tag will
be shield. User cannot modify any driver or tag when debugging. If modification is
required, user should exit the debugging firstly.
After starting the debugging, the tag list consists of the tag name, type, I/O address,
description, real-time value and update time and unit. Tag name, type, I/O address and
unit are consistent with the tag configuration list. The detailed description of real-time
--- pag 42 ---
Database Management
38
value and update time is shown below:

Real-time Value: the analog tag shows the float value with three decimal digits. The
digital tag shows as ON or OFF.

Update Time: show the update time of the tag real-time value, which up to the
millisecond. If the real-time value of tag hasn’t been updated yet, it will be shown as
empty.
There are two ways to update the real-time value.

Real-time Refresh: click the
in toolbar and the tag will refresh once
automatically per 1s.

Manual Refresh: click the
in toolbar and the tag will refresh manually.


Information and specifications in this document are subject to change without notice.

While information in this document is well edited and checked, mistake or omission may exist. Please



equipment may be sensitive. Observe precautions for handling electrostatic sensitive devices

Table of Contents

--- pag 4 ---
Full Graphics Configuration
1
Full Graphics Configuration
Section 1 Overview
SOLISCADA provides 2 kinds of monitoring modes, the classical style and non-classical style. In
classical style, the monitoring window includes the monitoring table head, monitoring picture and
alarm bar, as introduced in the Real-time Monitoring Software User Manual. After adding the
operation team, the basic functions to login, log out and exit the monitoring software can be
achieved. The functions of trend, graphics and alarm etc. also can be achieved after configuring
successfully, please refer to the VxExplorer User Manual for details.
In non-classical style, all functions in monitoring window are configured in the graphics drawing
software (VFDraw) and the script editor (VFScript). Functions like the login, log out, exit of user
and viewing the graphics and trend of user can be designed and edited as required. However, the
function of operation guide of the monitoring cannot be achieved in this mode.
The configuration of full-graphics refers to configure all monitoring widows by the VFDraw and
VFScript.
This article introduces the configuration flow and method of full graphics.
--- pag 5 ---
Full Graphics Configuration
2
Section 2 Configuration Flow
The configuration flow of full graphics is similar with the classical style, except the configuration
types of trend and alarm, etc. The system structure configuration must be set as non-classical
style, and the first page of graphics must be named as “Index”.
Figure 2-1 Configuration flow of full graphics
--- pag 6 ---
Full Graphics Configuration
3
Section 3 Configure System Structure
The classical style should be enabled when configuring the full graphics: open the Project
Management software(VxProjectMgr), click the button Project Property in the toolbar to open the
setting dialog box and uncheck the option "Enable Sleep Alarm".
After configuring the common default settings of project and sleep alarm in VxProjectMgr,
and
configuring the engineer, time synchronization server, unit configuration and safety configuration in
VxSysBuilder, the project can be save and set as the default project.
Details of VxProjectMgr, please refer to the Project Management (VxProjectMgr) User Manual.
Details of VxSysBuilder please refer to the VxSysBuilder Software User Manual.
--- pag 7 ---
Full Graphics Configuration
4
Section 4 Configure Database Variable
Open a subproject from the server in the VxExplorer. Double-click the “Database” in the structure
tree to open the data management software.
Configure the local node, remote acquisition station and extended variable in the data
management software.
Operations are shown below:

Add I/O driver to the local node, and add or import the tag.

Import remote configuration to the remote acquisition station and configure the tag.

Add the extended variable, etc.
Please refer to the Data Management Software User Manual.
--- pag 8 ---
Full Graphics Configuration
5
Section 5 Configure History Trend
Configure the history trend. Save the history trend of tag to the history trend server for convenient
viewing. Tag whose history trend hasn’t been configured can only view its real-time trend in the
monitoring.
Open the subproject in the VxExplorer from the server in the VxExplorer. Double-click the
“History Trend” in the structure tree to open the history trend software (VFHisCfg).
Configure the history trend tag and history data server in the VFHisCfg, and manage the history
trend tag based on the tag group.
Following operations should be implemented:

Add history trend tag to the “History Trend Tag” node.

Select the tag group for history trend tag under the “History Data Server” node.
Please refer to the VxExplorer Software User Manual for the details of VFHisCfg.
--- pag 9 ---
Full Graphics Configuration
6
Section 6 Supervising User
Authority
and
Object
Model
Please refer to the VxExplorer Software User Manual for the details of supervising user authority
and object model.
--- pag 10 ---
Full Graphics Configuration
7
Section 7 Configure Operation Team
Add an operation team to the subproject in the VxExplorer. In non-classical style, configuration for
the data viewer, trend, graphics, report, schedule, operation instruction, etc., under the operation
team directly are invalid. Except the operation instruction, all these functions should be achieved in
the graphics.
Configuration for other functions like the alarm region, alarm sound, alarm real-time print, tag
associated graphics and tag associated graphics etc. please refer to the VxExplorer Software User
Manual.
--- pag 11 ---
Full Graphics Configuration
8
Section 8 Configure Graphics
The configuration for graphics is implemented under the operation team. User should add an
operation team to the VxExplorer, and only configure the graphics.
Right-click the “Graphics” and select “Add Page”. Input the file name in the right pane, and click
“Edit”. After configuring the graphics, save it to complete the operation.
Please refer to the VFDraw Software User Manual for the details of adding and editing the
graphics.
8.1 Design Page Layout
Requirements for layout and design of the graphics are shown below:

The design styles of the graphics pages should be same in the same project.

The graphics page can be divided into the title bar, toolbar and drawing area, etc.

Insert the system variable control to the title bar, and choose to show the current time,
user and group. Set the button with icon and text in toolbar, and link to all graphics pages
or basic operations like login and logout. In the drawing area the main functions of
graphics can be achieved.

Except the main page, all graphics pages should have the buttons of return or exit, to
avoid the fault that the graphics window in monitoring cannot close or exit.

The main page should be named as “Index.pic” and set as the default page.
8.2 Create First Page
When editing the full graphics in SOLISCADA, set the graphics “Index.pic” as the first page in
default, so user should build the graphics “Index.pic” as the default page. And set login and exit
in the default page. Otherwise, the company profile will be shown in default, and user cannot login
the system.
8.2.1 Login
User can login by the login dialog of system.
Open the “Index.pic” and add the button, and configure the action “Login” for the button
dynamic property.
--- pag 12 ---
Full Graphics Configuration
9
8.2.2 Exit
This function is achieved by configuring the [Exit System] in the dynamic properties settings
interface.
8.2.3 Logout
This function is achieved by configuring the [Action/ Logout] in the dynamic properties settings
interface.
8.2.4 Switch
This function is achieved by configuring the [Action/ Open Picture] in the dynamic properties
settings interface.
8.2.5 Other
Other actions can be achieved in graphics please refer to the section contents of action in the
VFDraw Software User Manual.
8.3 Create Function Page
The graphics pages except the first page are called the function pages. User can show the
monitoring information in different graphics pages as required, such as the industry graphics, trend
and alarm, etc.
Except the function control, the function page should have necessary function keys like return
logout, exit and switch, etc.
8.3.1 Industry Graphics
If draw the industry graphics (like the nitrogen generation flow) in the graphics, set the tag of
monitoring point in a certain position and add the description, to show the scene of filed vividly, by
which user can locate the monitoring information more conveniently.
The drawing of industry graphics generally should reference the simple graph object, draw the
complex graph object, link data or add DataLink in batch, etc. Please refer to the VFDraw Software
User Manual for details.
8.3.2 Trend
Create a new graphics, click the trend control in the graph object toolbar, press the left button of
the mouse and drag in the drawing area, and release in the required position.
Double-click the control added to pop up its properties settings interface, in which user can set the
trend tag, color and maximum and minimum of coordinate.
--- pag 13 ---
Full Graphics Configuration
10
Click “Save” after configuration. One or several trend controls can be added in one graphics.
Buttons of return, switch to other page or exit the monitoring should be set in the trend page.
8.3.3 Alarm
The graph object toolbar includes the history and real-time alarm controls, to show the information
of history and real-time alarms.
Create a new graphics, click the alarm control in the graph object toolbar, press the left button of
the mouse and drag in the drawing area, and release in the required position.
Double-click the control added to pop up its properties settings interface, in which user can set the
appearance and filtered tag for the history and real-time alarm controls.
Please refer to the VFDraw Software User Manual for details of adding the control and setting the
properties.
--- pag 14 ---
Full Graphics Configuration
11
Section 9 Publish Configuration
After configuration, right-click the subproject in VxExplorer and select “Save to Configuration
Server and Keep Locked”, then select “Publish” again to select the publish type and range, etc.
When publish for the first time between the classical and non-classical styles, user should choose
to publish all.
Please refer to the VxExplorer Software User Manual for details.
--- pag 15 ---
Full Graphics Configuration
12
Section 10 Start Monitoring
After publish, double-click the “VFLaunch” in the desktop or select menus [Start/ All Programs/
SOLISCADA/ VFLaunch] to pop up the “Configuration Selection” interface. Select the project
and the start mode, and then click “OK” to open the VFLaunch and enter into the “Index”
interface.
User can view the real-time data and monitor the filed after login.
In supervision interface, right-click in the blank of anywhere, there are some command in common
use, including: Login, Logout, Exit, Operation Log, Print, Select Tag, Open Picture and so on.
