History Alarm Offline Viewer User Manual
1
VFHAView
Section 1 Overview
VFHAView is also called history alarm viewer. Users can view local history alarm information in
stand-alone mode when network and history alarm server are not available.
VFHAView can select a sub-project to view history alarm. It also has functions of filtering, locating
and searching and turning page, etc.
VFHAView has following characters:

Support records of history alarm in millisecond level.

While locating, support records search of history alarm in second level.

While filtering, support records search of history alarm in minute level.
--- pag 5 ---
History Alarm Offline Viewer User Manual
2
Section 2 Interface Introduction
Select [Start / SOLISCADA / SystemTools/ History Alarm Offline Viewer] in the Start menu or
double click VFHAView.exe
(C:\SOLISCADA\VFHAView.exe) in the installation directory to open
VFHAView, and enter VFHAView interface, as shown in Figure 2-1 VFHAView interface includes
title bar, menu bar, toolbar, list header, list content, status bar and function button, etc.
Figure 2-1 History Alarm Browse Interface
Tips:

VFHAView can view all the alarm of the sub-project in the off-line status, not confined by
alarm data region.

Selecting the project (subproject of the project) again actually is a process of reloading
the history alarm. Users should avoid starting it up with the supervision software at the
same time.
2.1 Title Bar
The title bar displays configuration directory, software name, etc.
2.2 Menu Bar
The menu bar displays 4 menu items: file, view, database manage and help. Letters in the right
bracket of each menu indicates the shortcut key manner. Open the menu and display content of
the submenu by pressing "ALT" and "Shortcut letter" at the same time. All the submenus support
shortcut key operation.
--- pag 6 ---
History Alarm Offline Viewer User Manual
3
2.2.1 File Menu
File menu includes four items: open, export, print and exit.
Open (Ctrl+O)
View alarm database of history alarm. Select [File/Open] in the menu bar, or click the button
on the tool bar, pop up the dialog box, as shown in Figure 2-2. OA0 is the subproject name) and
click "OK".
Figure 2-2 Assign History Alarm database
Export (Ctrl+E)
Export all the history alarm conformed with the current filter conditions to the file in .CSV format.
Select [File/Export] on the menu bar, or click the button
on the tool bar, pop up the export
setting dialog box, as shown in Figure 2-3. Export setting includes "Assign Time" and "Export
Path".
Setting steps:
1.
Input the time range of export items.
2.
Click the button
, specify the export file and save directory in the dialog box.
3.
Click "Save" to return to the dialog box shown in Figure 2-3. The software will export the
alarm conformed with setting conditions and save it to the designated file after clicking
"OK".
Figure 2-3 Export CSV setting interface (Step1)
You can view the file in .CSV format that the VFHAView exported by the text view tool and Excel.
When view it by Excel, you can view the right time displayed on the "Alarm Time" bar,
"Acknowledge Time” bar, "Eliminate Time" bar and so on by format setting, as follows:
--- pag 7 ---
History Alarm Offline Viewer User Manual
4
1.
Select the time bar
2.
Right click the "Format Cell…" and the cell format setting interface will pop up.
3.
Select "Date" in the sort position and the type selection includes the format of year,
month, day, hour, minute, shown as follows. Click "OK" to display the right alarm time.
Figure 2-4 Format settings of cell when exported
Print (Ctrl+P)
Select [File/Print] on the menu bar, or click the button
on the tool bar, or click of function
button
to print the current information.
Exit
Exit VFHAView.
2.2.2 View Menu
The view menu includes two submenu items: tool bar and status bar. It is used to hide or show the
tool bar and the status bar. Select [View/Tool Bar] or [View/Status Bar] on the menu bar to display
the tool bar and the status bar; Otherwise, hide the tool bar and the status bar automatically.
2.2.3 Database Manage Menu
The database manage includes “Old Version History Alarm Import”, “History Alarm Base Backup
and Restore” and “Assign History Alarm Export or Import”. Functions in the menu are
recommended to be applied in the stand-alone or domain server.
--- pag 8 ---
History Alarm Offline Viewer User Manual
5
Old Version History Alarm Import
This function can import the history alarm data of old version to the corresponding alarm base for
user to query.
Select the “Old Version History Alarm Import” to pop up the dialog shown in Figure 2-5.
Figure 2-5 Old Version History Alarm Import
Select the path of history alarm. The default path is “D:\ ECSRun\ Project2\ HMI\ OA0\ Run\ Alm\
SvrDBdata”. The “Project2” is the project name, and “OA0” is the subproject name. Assign the
base of history alarm and click “Start”.
History Alarm Base Backup and Restore
This function can backup/restore the data of the whole alarm base. The filed backup/restored is
the database file (.sql). Please clear the exited data before restoring.
Select “History Alarm Base Backup and Restore” to pop up the dialog shown in Figure 2-6.
Figure 2-6 History Alarm Base Backup and Restore

Backup History Alarm Base: select “Backup History Alarm Base” in the box of
“Processing Mode” and assign the name of history alarm base. Select the database path
and input the file name, and click “Start”.

Restore History Alarm Base: select “Restore History Alarm Base” in the box of
--- pag 9 ---
History Alarm Offline Viewer User Manual
6
“Processing Mode”. Select the database file to be restored and click “Start”. The data
restored is determined by the assigned database file and nothing to do with the alarm
base. Therefore, the history alarm base is no need to be assigned.
Assign History Alarm Export or Import
This function can export or import the data in the database in a certain period. The file imported or
exported is in the format of .hdb. Importing data is in the mode of increment.
Click the “Assign History Alarm Export or Import” to pop up the dialog shown in Figure 2-7.

History Alarm Export: select the time period. Other operations are same with the
backup history alarm base.

History Alarm Import: select the time period. Other operations are same with the
restore history alarm base.
2.2.4 Help Menu
The help menu provides the relevant information about copyright and product access of
VFHAView.
2.3 Tool Bar
As shown in Figure 2-8, the tool bar displays common menu items in the form of the tool icon to
facilitate users. All the button functions are identical to those of the corresponding menu
command.
Figure 2-8 Tool bar buttons
2.4 List Header
The list header displays the column name (name of the display item of each alarm record).
--- pag 10 ---
History Alarm Offline Viewer User Manual
7

Acknowledge and eliminate status display column (no list header identifier):
Indicate the Acknowledge and Eliminate status of alarm.

Not eliminated & unacknowledged:

Eliminated & unacknowledged:

Not eliminated & acknowledged:

Eliminated & acknowledged:


Not eliminated & unacknowledged: Orange



Alarm time: The time when the alarm occurs.






ACK Time: Acknowledge time of the alarm.

Eliminate Time: Eliminate time of the alarm.


2.5 List Content
List displays the information of the history alarm record including acknowledge and eliminate
status, alarm time, tag name, tag description, status, priority, acknowledge time, eliminate time,
alarm group, etc.
2.6 Status Bar
Status bar display the following information:

Controls information, when the mouse stays on toolbar.

“Ready” ,when the mouse stays on else place.

VFHAView provides a series of function buttons, shown in Table 2-1.

8

Icon
Description

Section 3 Introduction to Function Button
3.1 Filter
VFHAView provides the alarm filter function. It can filter the alarm according to setting conditions,
such as tag name, priority, range, time, etc. The displayed alarm differs according to filter
conditions.
Select to display process alarm. Click the function button
, and pop up the alarm filter setting
dialog box, as shown in Figure 3-1.
Figure 3-1 History Alarm Off-line Browse Filter Setting Process Alarm
Alarm filter conditions include:

Range
Search "All" or "Part" of the alarm information.

Tick off "All" to display all the process alarm.

Tick off "Part" and tag name, alarm priority, alarm time, alarm type, tag type, alarm
acknowledge and eliminate and alarm group will be in optional status. If all alarm
conditions are not set, the effect will be the same with that when ticking off "All".

Tag name: When "Part" is selected in range, "Tag Name" is in optional status. Tick off
--- pag 13 ---
History Alarm Offline Viewer User Manual
10
"Tag Name", click "Select" and pop up "Tag Selector". Select the tag name to be filtered
and click "OK", the tag name will be displayed in the edit box. (You can also input tag
name in the edit box).

Alarm priority: Include filter search of alarm levels between 0 and 31. The start priority
value should not be bigger than the end priority value. If the start priority is set as 5, the
end priority should be set as a positive integer between 5 and 31.

Tag type: List all the tag type. Select one or several tag types and filter all the alarms of
the tag of the selected types (When the alarms are conformed to other filter conditions,
display them in several pages).

Alarm type: List all the possible process alarm that tags of all types may generate. Select
one or several tag types and filter the alarms of selected types (When the alarms are
confirmed with other filter conditions, display them in the several pages).

Acknowledge and eliminate: Select the alarm acknowledge or eliminate status. The
default status is "Ignore". That is, ignore all the alarm that is
acknowledged/unacknowledged and eliminated/not eliminated.

Alarm time: Set time range of alarm filter. The start time should be less than the end time.
Tip:
The range of alarm time should be between 1970 and 2038. In view of the filter speed of the
alarm, it is suggested to set alarm time filter less than three months. When alarm time span is
too long, pop up the prompt dialog box "Time span is too long and it may cost a lot of time to
search. It is suggested to set search range in three months."

Alarm group: Select the alarm group and region to be filtered. There are 32 alarm
regions in each alarm group at most. Click the button
behind the alarm group
and pop up "Alarm Region Selection" interface, as shown in Figure 3-2. Click "Region
Name" list header of the alarm region selection box or " Group Name", "Select" or "Group
Description" list header of the alarm grouping in the filter setting interface and pop up the

current list. Click "Clear" to select none.

Alarm Confirmation: filter according to the information of alarm confirmation.

11

alarm record after the previous operation is deficient, the button is unavailable then.
3.3 Locate
VFHAView provides the locate function based on the filter function. Users can find the alarm
record conformed with or similar to the locate condition. Locate conditions is locate by tag.
If time filter has been set in the current filter condition, the locate time range is the alarm time set in
the filter operation; If tag name filter has been set, and it is different from the locate tag name, then
the locating will be invalidation. Users can also set the locate orientation to search the next
conformed record from the current alarm record forward or backward. Click the function button
,
and pop up the locate dialog box, as shown in Figure 3-4.

12
Figure 3-4 Locate setting dialog box

/
to search the alarm record conformed with the condition
forward/backward based on the locate condition and the current position, like "Locate Forward"
and "Locate Backward" in the locate function.

Click the function button
to display the latest alarm content by the filter condition set currently
(except the time filter condition).

in the process of locating, filtering and turning

History Data Backup and Restore Tools
1
History Data Backup and Restore Tools
Section 1 Overview
The historical data backup tool is used to regularly back up the data of the local library, including
historical data such as trend data, alarm data, event data, log data, etc. The data is backed up as a
zip compressed package by compressing the project folder and backing up the database. Once
data gets lost, you can restore the project via history data restore tool.
--- pag 5 ---
History Data Backup and Restore Tools
2
Section 2 Features

There are two types of backup: scheduled backup and manual backup:

Scheduled backup: According to the backup setting information, back up the data at
the specified backup time and copy it to the specified folder.

Manual backup: directly back up and copy the data to the specified folder after
triggering.

The backup tool is only used for data backup on the computer where the software is
located, and only the local database data is backed up. If you are using InPlant Historian,
please refer to the data backup instructions in the use manual of InPlant Historian.

The backup tool provides backup and recovery functions. During backup, if the backup is
not successful due to computer shutdown, etc., the backup strategy with a time interval
of years or months will restore the backup once when it is restarted in the current month,
and the backup strategy with a time interval of days will restore the backup once when it
is started that day.

After starting the automatic backup, the historical data backup tool will be automatically
started when the computer is turned on and displayed in the taskbar tray. You can only
exit by clicking the “Exit” option in the icon menu item in the lower right corner.

The data of the current project can be restored to the backup data through the restore
tool.
--- pag 6 ---
History Data Backup and Restore Tools
3
Section 3 Data Backup
Select [Start /SOLISCADA/ System Tools] in the start menu item, find the historical data backup tool,
open the interface as shown in Figure 3-1. You can set a regular backup strategy or perform
manual backups.
Figure 3-1 Historical data backup tool interface
3.1 Scheduled Backup
The software supports regular backup, with year, month or day as the backup cycle. The
configuration steps are as follows.
1.
Select the backup interval and set the backup time.
When the interval is a year, you can configure the “month - day - hour and minute” information;
when the interval is a month, you can configure the “day - hour and minute” information; when
the interval is a day, you can only configure the “hour and minute” information.
2.
Click the
button to set the backup path. The target path cannot be empty, it must be a
valid path, and you can choose a local folder or a shared folder on a network location. The
target path set here is also applicable to manual backup.
3.
Set the maximum number of backups and remaining disk space.

Maximum number of backups: used to set the maximum number of backup files, the
--- pag 7 ---
History Data Backup and Restore Tools
4
range of which can be set is 1~5. After the number of backups is exceeded, the new
backup file will overwrite the oldest backup.

Remaining disk space: used to control the remaining space of the disk where the backup
path is located. Before backup, the software will determine whether the remaining disk
controls are greater than the set value. If the remaining space is less than the set value,
the earlier backups will be deleted in turn (but the most recent backup will be kept) until
the remaining disk space is greater than the set value. The setting value of the remaining
disk space cannot be less than 10G.
4.
After completing the above configuration, click the “Start automatic backup” button.
After the configuration is completed, the software will automatically backup according to the
settings. The backup file is a compressed package in .zip format, and the file name format is
“SCADA_HisDataBackUp year, month, day, hour, minute, and second_AUTO_backup interval”.
Tips:

After starting the automatic backup, the items in the backup settings cannot be
modified. If you want to modify, please turn off automatic backup first.

If the software is performing an automatic backup, you cannot turn off the automatic
backup. Please do the operation after the backup is completed.
3.2 Manual Backup
Click the “Manual Backup” button to back up. The backup file is a compressed package in .zip
format with the name “SCADA_HisDataBackUp year, month, day, hour, minute, and
second_MANUAL”, and the archive path is the same as the target path set for the scheduled
backup.
Tip:
During automatic or manual backup, a new manual backup cannot be performed.
3.3 Task Bar Icon
After starting the historical data backup tool, click the close button on the interface shown in Figure
3-1. Then the tool is minimized, and an icon appears in the taskbar tray in the lower right corner
. Double-click the icon to restore the configuration interface. Right-click the historical data
backup icon, and a menu as shown in the figure below will pop up.
--- pag 8 ---
History Data Backup and Restore Tools
5
Figure 3-2 Right-click menu of historical data backup

Manual backup: After clicking, manual backup will be triggered.

Exit: Click to exit the historical backup tool and turn off the auto-start after booting.
--- pag 9 ---
History Data Backup and Restore Tools
6
Section 4 Data Restoration
The backed up data can be restored by historical data restore tool.
Attention:
Before restoring the project configuration, please exit the real-time supervision first.
Select [Start / SOLISCADA / System Tools / History Data Restore Tool] to open the historical data
restore tool interface, as shown in the figure below.
Figure 4-1 History data restore tools
Select the backup path and set the content and method to be restored. Click "Refresh" to get the
project of backup file and the project of real-time supervision.
If the selected content includes Trend, you need to select:

Distinguishing projects: the project configuration can be restored only when the project of
backup file is the same as the project of real-time supervision.

No distinction between projects: the configuration of backup file project will be directly
restored to the project of real-time supervision.
--- pag 10 ---
History Data Backup and Restore Tools
7
After completing the configuration, click “Start Restore” to restore the backup data. When the
message “Restore successful” appears, it means that the restoration process is over.

MQTT Application Guide
1
MQTT Application Guide
Section 1 Overview
SOLISCADA supports publishing real-time data, historical data and alarm information through
MQTT (Message Queuing Telemetry Transport) protocol, and changing the real-time data.
After you start running SOLISCADA monitoring software, configure the parameters of
MQTTClient and create the connection successfully, SOLISCADA can push data to MQTT Broker
server, for third party client subscription.
Figure 1- 1 Data Flow
Tip:
Besides publishing data through the MQTT service, you can also subscribe to data from the
MQTT Broker server through the MQTT driver. For details about the MQTT driver, please
refer to the "MQTT Driver" chapter in IO Driver User Manual.
--- pag 5 ---
MQTT Application Guide
2
Section 2 Configure MQTTClient
This chapter mainly describes the steps of configuring MQTT client properties in SOLISCADA.
2.1 Open MQTTClient Interface
1.
Open global settings interface in project manager (VxProjectMgr), select the “Startup” tab, and
select the “Start MQTT”, as shown in the figure below, MQTTClient will start with the
monitoring software.
Figure 2- 1 Start MQTT
2.
After starting the monitor and logging in, right-click
at the system tray, select “Attribute”,
and open MQTTClient.
--- pag 6 ---
MQTT Application Guide
3
2.2 Configure MQTTClient Parameters
Figure 2- 2 MQTTClient properties (broker server)
The interface of MQTTClient is shown above. The configuration requirements for the parameters
in each tab are described as following. After configuring the parameters in each tab, please click
the "Save" button below.
2.2.1 Configure Service Parameters
“Broker” tab is as shown in Figure 2- 2, the description of parameters is shown below:

Fill in address, port, user name and password according to the parameters of MQTT
Broker server.

After filling in address and port, click “Generate” button to create a client ID for MQTT
Broker server to identify current MQTTClient.
--- pag 7 ---
MQTT Application Guide
4
2.2.2 Configure Common Parameters
Figure 2- 3 MQTTClient properties (general settings)
Parameters of “General” tab are shown in the figure above, description of parameters are shown
below:

MQTT version: Select according to the protocols supported by MQTT Broker server. The
versions of MQTT protocols supported by the software are Default MQTT, 3.1, 3.1.1 or
5.0.

Pushing methods: you can set the changing push or periodic push, the default is
changing push.
--- pag 8 ---
MQTT Application Guide
5

ChangPush: When tag value changes, MQTTClient pushes the value of changed
tag; When change push is enabled, all bit numbers' real-time values are pushed to
the proxy server at a set time interval simultaneously with change pushes.

PeriodicPush: The push interval can be configured to send real-time values of all
bit numbers to the proxy server according to the configuration, time ranges from
5~3600 seconds.
2.2.3 Configure Real-time Data Topic Parameters
Figure 2- 4 MQTTClient properties (real-time data topic)
The parameters of “Real-time data topic” tab are shown as the figure above, description of
parameter is shown below:

Subscribe topics: When a third-party client wants to get the real-time value of tags in
local database, it needs to subscribe to “Subscribe Topics”, and you need to set the
Subscribe Topics and the tag included in MQTTClient, for access to real-time value.

All Tags: Check this item and set the topic name. The third-part client can get the
real-time value of all tags when it subscribes to the topic.

If you only want to open the data of the specified tags, check "Customized Tags",
and then configure the topic and open tag list: Click the “Add” button at the bottom
of the “Subscribe topics” list to add a new topic, the default topic name is
“Topic+number”; Click the “Rename” button after selecting the topic, and you can
modify the topic name. English letter, number and underline are supported. The
length of the topic name shouldn't exceed 32 characters. Select a topic, click the
“Add” button on the right, and you can select the tag to be written in the pop-up tag
selector. Different topics can include the same tag.
--- pag 9 ---
MQTT Application Guide
6

Publish topic: When read-write property of tag is read-write, the third-party client can
write value to tag through MQTTClient after it has subscribed to the Publish Topic. You
can set the name of Publish Topic in “Topics” tab. English letter, number and underline
are supported. The length of the topic name shouldn't exceed 32 characters.
2.2.4 Configure Historical Data Topic Parameters
Figure 2- 5 MQTTClient properties (historical data topic)
The parameters of “Historical data topic” tab are shown as the figure above. You should set
historical topic, which can contain letters, numbers or underline, and cannot exceed 32 characters.
2.2.5 Configure Alarm Topic Parameters
Figure 2- 6 MQTTClient properties (alarm topic)
The parameters of “Alarm topic” tab are shown as the figure above. You should set the topics of
real-time alarm and historical alarm, which can contain letters, numbers or underline, and cannot
exceed 32 characters.
2.3 Start Connection
After completing configuration, click the “Start” button for service connection. After successfully
connecting, “Connect” at the bottom will show the connection status as ”Connected”, and the local
database begins to publish data to MQTT broker server. At the same time, the “Start” button will
become the “Restart” button.
You need to restart MQTT after each property's parameter changes in MQTTClient.
If MQTTClient and MQTT broker server disconnects for network reasons, MQTT will reconnect
automatically after the network is restored to normal, and the connection status will
become ”Connected” after successful reconnection.
--- pag 10 ---
MQTT Application Guide
7
Section 3 Query Tag Data
After clients subscribe to the corresponding topic, it can obtain real-time data of the tags. After
sending query messages, it can obtain historical data. This chapter mainly describes the tag types
that can be queried and the JSON data formats that need to be followed.
3.1 Publishing and Subscribing to Real-Time Data
Clients subscribe to real-time data topics to obtain real-time data for tags. The upper limit of
real-time tags is 50,000 points.
3.1.1 Supported Tag Types

is generated by default after the first startup or manually created). After the modification, you need
to restart the MQTT service of the software. Please consult the central control engineer for

the massages for alarm data.

Section 3 SCADA Introduction
SCADA system, which based on computer, is an automation system for production process control
and schedule. SCADA system can perform local or remote supervision and control for distributed
process or device, and has functions such as data acquisition, device control, measurement,
parameter adjustment and various signal alarms, etc. It also can provide necessary and complete
data and technology supports for safe production, scheduling, management, optimization and fault
diagnosis.
SCADA is a powerful system for computer remote monitoring and control and data acquisition. It
applies technologies of computer, control and communication and network comprehensively.
--- pag 9 ---
SOLISCADA Project Guide
4
Section 4 SOLISCADA Introduction
SOLISCADA is a SCADA software platform developed by SUPCON for large distributed
application system. SOLISCADA is often used for oil gas long distance pipeline, urban heating
network, power grid PTD, long distance water transport, sewage treatment, environment
protection supervision and municipal traffic.
4.1 Architecture
An application example of SOLISCADA is shown in Figure 4- 1.
Figure 4- 1 Architecture of SCADA
4.1.1 Master Center
Master center provides following components and functions:

Engineer station is used for project configuration, includes configuration of diagram, logic
--- pag 10 ---
SOLISCADA Project Guide
5
and alarm, etc.
Usually, engineer station is used in PC of Windows 10 operation systems.

Operator station provides operation interface, includes color diagram, panel, alarm, log
and trend chart, etc.
Usually, operator station is used in PC of Windows 10 operation systems.

History data server stores and searches the history data acquired by RTU, ESD or other
intelligent device in system.
Usually, available operator stations include Windows 10 and Windows Server.

Data collector can perform protocol switch and data transmission functions in
SOLISCADA system, and can be the data gateway between SOLISCADA nodes and
other devices.
Data collector can achieve the data connection between SOLISCADA nodes and PLC,
fieldbus device, RTU, PLC I/O module and other third party devices. It also can achieve
data transmission between station control SCADA system and master center SCADA
system.

Switch is the component connecting LAN or WAN, and it can connect with satellite, radio,
microwave, dial modem etc.

SOLISCADA supports the redundant and non-redundant fiber and Ethernet local
network, and applies TCP/IP to connect to application program.

LAN/WAN can be extended to other stations via remote communication technology
(such as satellite, radio, microwave and dial that applied TCP/IP, Modbus, OPC, DDE
etc.)
4.1.2 Remote Site
The remote site can consist of one or several remote stations, as shown in Figure 4- 1.
Main functions and construction of remote station1:

Remote station1 shows that the filed work requires for strict monitoring. A local operator
can monitor the field work via operator condition with colorful graphs.

PLC can be a PLC (such as G5 of SUPCON) or industry control machine, which can
acquire data from various PLC I/O modules, run the sequence and general control logic,
and send the initialized operation command to I/O module.

I/O module comes from all supplies supporting industrial standard.

PLC can be replaced with I/O module supporting PLC.
Main functions and devices of remote station2 and remote station3:
--- pag 11 ---
SOLISCADA Project Guide
6

Remote station2 and remote station3 can be a more traditional application mode.

Data collector of master center acquires the data from PLC of remote station2 and
devices such as remote, flow computer, intelligent valve controller and instrument, etc.

Data collector can also send related operation commands to those devices.
Main functions and devices of remote station4:

Remote station4 can centralize data. The station does not need operator and is
convenient for filed control.

Log retransmission server and data collector retransmission server are set in application
server. SCADA data collector acquires data of remote RTU, PLC, flow computer,
intelligent valve controller and instrument in method of polling. SCADA data collector can
send operation command to these devices. Application server cannot be used as
engineer station. If the network is disconnected, there are only 10,000 logs in application
server's buffer memory.
TIP:
If logs in data collector should be recorded in the log server, the data collector must be
installed in application server.

G3 can be used as RTU in application.
Main functions and devices of remote station5:

Remote station5 requires for local control, but the filed operator is not necessary.

PLC executes sequence and normal control logic, and sends logic and operation
command from operator to I/O module and filed device.

G5 can be used as PLC in application.
4.2 Software Functional Features
Main functional features of SOLISCADA:
4.2.1 Data Openness
SOLISCADA supports open data to the outsides. The instructions are as follows.
Open real-time data through OPC protocol:
By default, SOLISCADA comes with OPC DA server VxOPCDAServer and OPC A&E server
VxOPCAEServer and OPC UA service VxOPCUAService. Registration is automatically
completed after installation, and anti-registration is automatically completed after
uninstallation.
--- pag 12 ---
SOLISCADA Project Guide
7

The OPC DA service does not require authorization and opens all real-time data,
including basic type data and structure type data.

The OPC A&E service does not require authorization, and the tag alarm group or event
alarm group of the open alarm data can be set.

OPC UA services does not require authorization.
For details, please refer to OPC Application Guide.
Open real-time data through MQTT service
After completing the configuration and starting monitoring in local base mode, SOLISCADA can
connect to the MQTT Broker proxy server through MQTT Public Client service and push data
and alarms to the MQTT proxy service for third-party clients to subscribe.
For the detailed instruction, please refer to MQTT Application Instruction.
Open real-time data through C/C++ interface
In the built-in database mode, enable the C/C++ Interface Data Service in the global settings and
set the port. After you complete the secondary development according to the SDK interface
development document, you can obtain the real-time data through the corresponding service.
For more information on this feature, please consult the SUPCON engineer.
Export history data as a CSV file
In the historical trend viewing software, the historical trend of the tag can be exported in the format
of a CSV file.
4.2.2 System Redundancy
The SOLISCADA system is in a network system, and two servers form a dual redundant system.
The two nodes constituting the dual-computer redundant system use the same version of
SOLISCADA software. Both nodes can be physically connected to each field I/O device. The
difference between the two nodes is only the node parameters (such as: computer IP address).
The following describes the redundant working mechanism and redundant configuration method of
the system.
Working Mechanism
SOLISCADA two servers collect and store various historical data at the same time. After the
main server fails, the backup server can take over the main server and respond to various
requests from the client. After the failed server returns to normal, it can take over the work of the
current server manually or automatically.
--- pag 13 ---
SOLISCADA Project Guide
8
The working status of the active and standby servers is basically the same, and only the active
server receives requests from clients and responds.
Redundant configuration
In the system structure configuration software, a server group is established for each sub-project,
and two servers are configured to achieve the purpose of system redundancy configuration.
In the system configuration software, configure the network redundancy mode, then each server
can be configured with two IP addresses to achieve the purpose of network redundancy
configuration.
4.2.3 Flexible System Structure
The SOLISCADA configuration project has two system structures: stand-alone mode and C/S
distributed mode. Users can flexibly choose the two structures according to actual needs.
The following describes the working mechanism of the system structure such as stand-alone
mode, C/S distribution mode and B/S distribution mode.
Stand-alone mode
The single-machine mode configuration requires that multiple stand-alone configurations can be
configured in one configuration, which are deployed on different computers, and share a
configuration with all stand-alone nodes under PROJECT.
When the stand-alone mode configuration is running, each computer performs its own
configuration update, data collection, real-time monitoring and other functions.
There are up to 32 stand-alone nodes under the same PROJECT.
C/S distributed structure
The nodes in the C/S distributed structure are divided into two types: server and operation node. In
a PROJECT, there can only be one or two servers, and there are a maximum of 60 operating
nodes. All nodes in the same PORJECT share a configuration.
Only the server node will perform data collection and open the collected data to the outside world.
The operation node will obtain the data from the server node, and then display the data in
real-time monitoring. For details of real-time monitoring, please refer to Real-time Monitoring
Software User Manual.
B/S distributed structure
You can login the Web client via the browser in PC or on mobile, and monitor the flowcharts which
have been configured.

“Scheduling” in VxExplorer Software User Manual.
Operation Instruction of SOLISCADA is used when running the system. When specified event
occurs, the system provides clear prompt to guide user to operate correctly and keep the field
control steady.

For configuration of operation instruction, please refer to “Configure Operation Guide”
VxExplorer Software User Manual.

For the method of viewing operation instruction, please refer to “Operation Guide” in
Real-time Monitoring Software User Manual.
11.5 Alarm
Process alarm of SOLISCADA shows all visible (process) alarm of current operation team, and
sequences them according to weighting priority.
SOLISCADA alarm bar provides related alarm functions such as alarm overview and history alarm
display, alarm panel pops up, alarm mute and alarm acknowledge, etc.
SOLISCADA history alarm can view history alarm of process alarm.
History Alarm Viewer User Manual introduces the method to view history alarm information of the
computer in single machine mode when disconnecting with the network and history alarm server.

For configuration of alarm in operation team, please refer to “Operation Team
Configuration” in VxExplorer Software User Manual Section..

For configuration of alarm in subproject, please refer to “Alarm Settings” and
“Customized Alarm Group” in VxExplorer Software User Manual.

For the method of viewing alarm bar, please refer to “Alarm Bar” in Real-time Monitoring
Software User Manual.
--- pag 35 ---
SOLISCADA Project Guide
30
11.6 Report
Report is an important and useful data record tool, which is often used to record important system
data and field data for engineer to check system condition and analyze technique.
SOLISCADA report consists of report formation software, report viewer and report server.
Report system can generate report via report server, and start automatically with the starting of
monitoring software via setting report server.
Report browser can view and edit generating and generated reports.

For the method of forming and viewing report, please refer to Report Software User
Manual.

For operation of adding report in subproject, please refer to VxExplorer Software User
Manual.
Tip:
Install Microsoft Office Excel before generating Excel report (32-bit Microsoft Office Excel
2021 is recommended). Software like WPS should be uninstalled.
11.7 Operation Log
SOLISCADA operation log viewer consists of server and client. These two parts work together to
store and inquiry operation record in C/S network. Operation log server can record the operation
records sent by client, and save them on server. At the same time, it provides inquiry function for
client, finds operation record set conforming to the inquiry conditions from the server database and
returns the set to client.
SOLISCADA operation log consists of configuration log and running log. Configuration log can
record configuration event of system. Running log can record running event of system.
SOLISCADA operation log viewer includes two modes of viewing by day and filter. In mode of day,
user can view operation logs day by day. In mode of filter, user can filter required operation by
inputting inquiry conditions, such as user name, operation type or specific time.
For method of viewing operation record, please refer to “Operation Log Viewer” in Real-time
Monitoring Software User Manual.
--- pag 36 ---
SOLISCADA Project Guide
31
Section 12 Authorization Allocation
SOLISCADA has user management system, which can control access authority of common data
and interfaces. Each user will be allocated with different operating and viewing authorization for
data and interfaces.
12.1 Configuration Authority
Each configuration project has a User of Creator, which can be used to switch configuration
projects and perform allocation for whole system. User can add other engineers (group) to develop
and maintain a configuration project by several users simultaneously, and largely improve the
efficiency of project implementation.
There are two kinds of configuration authorities:

Project management authority: includes opening and closing project and setting
configuration authority of subproject.

Subproject configuration authority: includes specifying configurable subproject.
For operation of managing configuration authority, please refer to “Engineer Authorization
Management” in VxSysBuilder User Manual.
12.2 Monitoring Authority
Configure the monitoring user before logging in SOLISCADA monitoring software. SOLISCADA
supplies internal administrator and observer. The monitoring authority and configuration authority
are not associated. According to the authority levels, there are three authority templates, or roles,
in the software, privilege, engineer and Operator. Each user will have different monitoring and
operation authority in monitoring software by defining user in different roles.
For operation details of monitoring authority, refer to “Monitoring User Authorization” in VxExplorer
User Manual.
--- pag 37 ---
SOLISCADA Project Guide
32
Section 13 SOLISCADA Application Example
This section introduces a typical application example of SOLISCADA system, by which user can
understand the fundamental architecture of SOLISCADA and learn the node functions and
networking mode in SOLISCADA.
13.1 Case Description
The architecture of a SOLISCADA system is shown as Figure 13- 1.

Master center is the data storage center of SOLISCADA. It is mainly used to acquire
data of remote site to SOLISCADA server, and save them to history data server via
data process.
At the same time, master center provides real-time view function of data for SOLISCADA
operation station, and can perform some data operation.
Master center consists of an operator station, an engineer station, a pair of redundant
SOLISCADA servers, a InPlant Collector and a pair of redundant history data server.

Remote site is mainly used to acquire data and transmit control command. Data
acquisition of remote site refers to read the real-time data of third part device or system
via various protocol I/O drivers, and send real-time data to master center via InPlant
Collector. Control command transmission refers to receive the command of master
center and control the field device. Remote site also has the function of real-time data
monitoring, including normal monitoring function such as real-time trend, real-time alarm,
graphics and report, etc.
Remote site consists of an operator station, an engineer station, a InPlant Collector, a
router, a firewall, a G5, a G3, an ECS-100 and a video player.
--- pag 38 ---
SOLISCADA Project Guide
33
Figure 13- 1 Network of SOLISCADA application example
13.2 Control Center Configuration
13.2.1 Engineer Station
Engineer station is mainly used to achieve unified configuration of SOLISCADA system and publish
the configuration. It needs to set engineer station in both of master center and remote site. They
execute system configurations separately.

Operation system installation
Engineer station can be installed with Windows operation system. For installation and
configuration methods, please refer to Operation System Installation Guide.

SOLISCADA installation
--- pag 39 ---
SOLISCADA Project Guide
34
It is easy to set engineer station in SOLISCADA. Select configuration server when
installing, and the computer will have functions of engineer station.

Network Settings
Configure the computer IP address of engineer station, such as 172.30.0.130. Mask is
255.255.0.0.
For details of engineer station configuration, refer to Section 6.2 Engineer Station.
13.2.2 Operator Station
Operator station of SOLISCADA is mainly used to display real-time data via HMI windows. HMI
interface include trend, graphics, alarm, report and schedule, etc. Operator station can provide
some operation functions, such as write value.

Operation system installation
Operator station can be installed with Windows operation system. For installation and
configuration methods, please refer to Operation System Installation Guide.

SOLISCADA installation
It is easy to set operator station in SOLISCADA. Select non-configuration server when
installing, and set the IP address of configuration server before inputting it.

Network Settings
Configure the computer IP address of operator station, such as 172.30.0.131. Mask
code of sub-network is 255.255.0.0.
For details of operator station configuration, refer to Section 6.3 Operator Station.
13.2.3 SOLISCADA Server
SOLISCADA server is mainly used to receive, schedule and process real-time data, and push
data to related HMI interface client, including trend, graphics and alarm, etc. SOLISCADA server
often should be configured with redundant hot backup.

Hardware requirements
Server has high requirements for hardware. CPU frequency should be above Core Duo
2.5GHz, hard disk should be above 360G, and memory should be above 2G.

Operation system installation
SOLISCADA server can be installed with Windows operation system. For installation and
configuration methods, please refer to Operation System Installation Guide.
--- pag 40 ---
SOLISCADA Project Guide
35

SOLISCADA installation
It is easy to set SOLISCADA server in SOLISCADA. Select non-configuration server
when installing, and set the IP address of configuration server before inputting it.

Network Settings
Configure the computer IP address of operator station, such as 172.30.0.133. Mask
code of sub-network is 255.255.0.0.
For details of SOLISCADA server, refer to 6.1 SOLISCADA Server.
13.2.4 InPlant Collector
InPlant Collector is mainly used to send and receive data in remote site and between remote site
and master center. InPlant Collector of master system receives data from InPlant Collector of
station system.

Operation system installation
SOLISCADA server can be installed with Windows operation system. For installation and
configuration methods, please refer to Operation System Installation Guide.

InPlant Collector installation
InPlant Collector is one of the SOLISCADA installation components; it should be ticked
when installing SOLISCADA. For its installation method, please refer to SOLISCADA
Software Installation User Manual.

Network Settings
Computer of InPlant Collector has two IP addresses. The principle of network card
connecting to internal network to set IP address is the same with other nodes, such as
172.30.0.134. Mask code of sub-network is 255.255.0.0. Network card IP address
connecting to outer network is supplied by network operator.
For details of InPlant Collector, please refer to Section 6.1.1 InPlant Collector.
13.2.5 History Data Server
History data server is mainly used to save real-time data of various processes, include trend,
alarm and report, etc.

SOLISCADA installation
SOLISCADA history server and SOLISCADA server run in the same computer.
--- pag 41 ---
SOLISCADA Project Guide
36
If non-configuration server is selected when installing, user should set the IP address of
SOLISCADA server in VFSetup after installed SOLISCADA successfully.

Network Settings
Configure IP address of the computer, which should be same with SOLISCADA server.
For details of history data server configuration, refer to Section 8.2 Create History Data
Server.
13.3 Remote Site Configuration
13.3.1 Engineer Station
Engineer station of SOLISCADA is mainly used to perform unified configuration of SOLISCADA
and publish them. It should be set in both master system and remote site. The two engineer
stations undertake system configuration separately.
Configuration steps of engineer station in remote site are the same with engineer station in master
system. For configuration details, please refer to Section 6.2 Engineer Station.
13.3.2 Operator Station
Operator station of SOLISCADA is mainly used to display real-time data via various HMI windows,
which includes trend, graphics, alarm, report and schedule, etc. Operator station can also achieve
some operation functions, such as write value.
Configuration steps of operator station in remote site are the same with operator station in master
center. For configuration details, please refer to Section 6.3 Operator Station.
13.3.3 InPlant Collector
InPlant Collector can send and receive data in remote site or between remote site and master
center in SOLISCADA system. It sends data of remote site to master center with a specified
protocol.
Configuration steps of InPlant Collector in remote site are the same with InPlant Collector in
master center. For configuration details, please refer to Section 6.1.1 InPlant Collector.
--- pag 42 ---
SOLISCADA Project Guide
37
Section 14 Case Project
SOLISCADA provides a case project that allows users to quickly understand the effects and
status of the engineering implementation. The user can also use the case project as a basic
project, on the basis of which the engineering needs are met.
The following major functions are implemented in the case project:

The Script is to achieve the connection of the relational database

The script is to achieve the screen prompt

Application of trend, log, and alarm controls

Application of the flowchart template
The user can only restore the case project in the configuration server, and need to do the following
operations in the VxSysBuilder, VxExplorer and VF Launch to run the case project normally.
TIP：
Before restoring the demo project, please double-click the batch file RegOCX.bat in the
"installation package/Demo/RegOCX/" directory to complete the registration of the control.
After running, the cmd command window will automatically close.
VxSysBuilder
1.
In the system structure configuration software, select the menu bar [Advanced / Restore
Project], enter the "operation reason" in the confirmation operation interface that pops up,
and click "OK".
2.
In the "Restore Project" dialog box that pops up, select the path of the demo project (the
default path is C:\InPlantSCADA\demo), and double-click to open the "Demo_Enu.zip"
file. At this point, the demo structure is displayed in the system structure configuration
software.
3.
A single computer node has been set up in the demo project, and the IP address of the
single computer node is set to be the same as the local IP address. After the setting is
completed, click the “Save” project.
4.
Click the "Default Project" button on the toolbar, enter the user name and password of
the previous default project in the "Set Default Project" interface that pops up, and click
OK to set the demo project as the default project.
VxExplorer
--- pag 43 ---
SOLISCADA Project Guide
38
1.
Open the configuration management software. In the login interface, enter the user:
SOLISCADA, password: SOLISCADA, and click “OK”.
2.
In the configuration management software toolbar, click the "Configuration Release"
button. In the pop-up configuration release interface, select "Full Project Release".
VFLaunch
1.
Double-click “Monitor Run” on the desktop. In the pop-up “Configuration Selection”
interface, select the project “Demo”, select “VF Launch” in the startup mode selection,
and click “OK”.
2.
In the monitoring interface, select the user to log in. In the login interface, select “Admin”
as the username and password as “admin”. Click OK and jump to the default page, as
shown below.
Figure 14- 1 Case project interface
3.
The left button can jump from top to bottom to the home page, new function introduction,
industrial flow chart, trend, operation log, real-time alarm and other pages. The drawing
of the industrial flow chart, the trend, the running log, the configuration of the real-time
alarm control, the pop-up of the button, and the jump operation all need to be configured
in the flowchart drawing software.
For the specific operations in the above description, refer to the "System Builder User Manual",
"Config Explorer User Manual", "Graphics Builder User Manual", "Script Editor User Manual".

Real-time Supervision (VFLaunch) Software User Manual
1
VFLaunch
Section 1 Overview
Real-time supervision software package (VFLaunch) is a graphics supervision software with
friendly user interface. It provides a visible supervision interface for users to monitor operation of
field hardware equipments and provides effectively control to field situation in time, making it
convenient for operation and maintenance.
1.1 Function Features
Features:

Powerful supervision function
It provides a comprehensive, powerful graphics supervision interface that can reflect field
situation, including overview of the whole system, simulated field graphics of all parts,
and trend panels, and alarm views, etc

Provide all kinds of dynamic real-time display
The interface of supervision software reflects real-time running information of field
hardware equipments, real-time tag value change. The interface refreshes real-timely to
provide reliable information, making it conveniently for operators to supervise and control
the system easily.

More subtle and real interface
Graphics drawing software provides powerful drawing functions, including abundant
drawing controls and in-embedded standard graphics library. Therefore, the supervision
interface displays field devices in shape and color.
1.2 Technical Specification

Scale
A real-time database supports a maximum of 100000 tags; A single server supports a
maximum of 20000 points of history records; A single operation station supports a
maximum of 500 graphics; A single operation station supports a maximum of 100 reports,
and a maximum of 10 reports can be output simultaneously.

Start/Stop
Users can start or close simple configurations within 1000 points in less than 15 seconds.
Users can start or close configurations within 5000 points in less than 30 seconds
Users can start or close configurations within 10000 points in less than 60 seconds.

Graphics
--- pag 7 ---
Real-time Supervision (VFLaunch) Software User Manual
2

Support system tag data display;

Support colors in 24 bits;

Support VBS script language;

Support multiple dynamics;

7 graphics and a full screen graphics can be popped up simultaneously;

Page turning time of simple graphics is not more than 1 second (for graphics objects
amount no more than 200);

Page turning time of complex graphics is not more than 2 seconds (for graphics
objects amount no more than 700);

Support two kinds of resolution: 1920×1080, 1280×1024 and 1024×768;

Each graphics can refresh a maximum of 700 data points;

Minimum refresh period of each graphics is 50ms.
--- pag 8 ---
Real-time Supervision (VFLaunch) Software User Manual
3
Section 2 Startup
1.
Open “Configuration Selection” interface via one of ways below, shown as Figure 2- 1.

Double-click the shortcut of supervision startup
.

Select [Start / SOLISCADA / SUPCON SOLISCADA Monitoring Software].

Click the button "Monitoring"
in toolbar of the Project Manager software
VxProjectMgr.

Click the button "Run Monitoring"
in toolbar of VxExplorer.
Figure 2- 1 Configuration selection interface
2.
Operation in configuration selection interface:

Select the subproject.
There are several subprojects below one project. At the same time, system can only
monitor one of subprojects. As a result, users need to select a subproject below “Project”
and click it.

Update configuration
--- pag 9 ---
Real-time Supervision (VFLaunch) Software User Manual
4
Current operator station (engineer station) can only log in the project it belongs to
(configured in the system structure software). So, the content published by configuration
automatically is configured by the software and needn’t to be changed by users.
If the “Update Information” shows that the local configuration is different from server
configuration, users can update it manually or wait the system to shows tips and then
update the configuration.
The method of updating the configuration manually: click the pull-down list beside
“Update” and select Update or Update All.

Update: only update the configuration files which have been changed, efficiently.

Update All: update all the files of configuration, reliably.

Select startup mode.
Here are 4 startup modes. The former three modes are set by system automatically and
the last one is set by users.

Data Server: means that current node can provide history data query service for the
subproject as a data server node after startup.

Local Machine: means the current node is the single node.

History Data Server: means that current node can collect data for history trend as
a history data server after startup.

Supervision Software: If the “Supervision Software” mode is selected, the station
will start up HMI; otherwise, HMI will not be started up. For example, if engineers
start up the software in “Supervision Software” mode at data server node, the
node serves not only as a data server node but also as an operator station node.
Tips:
Users must select at least one startup mode, otherwise, the supervision software can't be
started up.
Startup mode of servers is consistent with that in the configuration.

“Don’t show configuration selection dialog box next time”
If user selects the item, the dialog box will not be displayed during next startup and set
this setting as the default settings.
If user wants to cancel the selection, please refer to Project Management (VxProjectMgr)
User Manual.
3.
Click “OK” to start up real-time supervision software and open the supervision interface.
4.
When you first open the monitoring interface, the user status is "Not logged in". Follow
the steps below, you can log in to the monitoring software by the appointed user and
appointed operation team.
1)
Click pull-down list in supervision list header in Figure 2- 2, and select the item “Login”.
--- pag 10 ---
Real-time Supervision (VFLaunch) Software User Manual
5
Figure 2- 2 Pull-down menu of supervision list header
2)
Do these operations in the pop-up dialog box of login as shown in Figure 2- 3.

Select the user by the pull-down list and input passwords. The default user is
“Admin” and the default password is “Admin” too. If you select the "Operator", you
don't need to enter the password. And after you select the operation team and log in
to the monitoring software, you can view the flowchart screen, data list screen, and
trend screen.
The authority of user can be configured in Supervision User Authority of VFExplorer
software, please refer to “Supervision User Authority” in VXExplorer User Manual.

Select the operation team of login.

Auto Login: if users enable auto login, the user of login and operation team which
are set will login in automatically when user start supervision software next time.
The particular method please refers to User Login and Automatic Login.
3)
Click “OK”.

Section 3 Instruction to Supervision Interface
In classical mode, operate in the monitoring panel by following description. In non-classical mode,
the layout of monitoring panel is customized by user and following descriptions are inapplicable.
The whole supervision interface includes three parts: supervision header (at the top), supervision
panel (in the middle) and alarm bar (at the bottom). Users can click each button on supervision
header to display different supervision views.
Figure 3- 1 Supervision interface
Tip:
If the figure in supervision interface should be changed, the operation is as follows:
1.
Open the SOLISCADA installation path: SOLISCADA\NlsEnu\Pic.
2.
Open the file index.PIC and Index1024.PIC via VFDraw
3.
The figure in index.PIC or Index1024.PIC should be changed with the figure has same

3.1 Supervision List Header
The supervision header is shown as follows.
Figure 3- 2 Supervision list header overview
The supervision header includes two parts: toolbar and status bar.
--- pag 13 ---
Real-time Supervision (VFLaunch) Software User Manual
8
3.1.1 Toolbar
The toolbar lists main operation functions of HMI console, and the functions are introduced below.
Interface Jumping Button
It is used to open some supervision interfaces. The button will be gray and can’t be clicked if user
has no authority or the interface isn’t existent.
Table 3- 1 Function of jumping button of supervision interface
Icon
Button name
Function instruction
Home Page
After clicking it, the supervision panel displays the home page.
Data Overview
After clicking it, the supervision panel displays the home page of data overview
panel.
Trend Panel
After clicking it, the supervision displays the home page of trend panel.
Graphics
After clicking it, the supervision displays the home page of graphics.
Report Browse

3.2.2 Auto Page Turning Configuration
The real-time monitoring software supports automatic page turning of monitoring screens. By
adding the focused monitoring screens as automatic page turning monitoring screens, operators
and other personnel in the factory can avoid repeatedly clicking on the focused screens, thereby
reducing work complexity and repeatability .
The automatic page turning screen supported by the real-time monitoring software is a flowchart
screen. The real-time monitoring software supports multi-page automatic page turning. Whether
each screen supports automatic page turning, the supported automatic page turning content, and
the automatic page turning time interval can be set independently.
Configuration steps
Through the following operations, you can configure the automatic page turning function of the
monitoring screen:
1)
Right-click on the blank space of the monitoring screen and select the "flow chart
automatic page turning> page turning setting" command (shortcut key is Ctrl + Shift + O),
and the "auto page turning setting" dialog box shown below will pop up.
Figure 3- 6 Automatic Page-turning Settings
2)
In "Display Number", select the display screen that needs to be configured with automatic
page turning function.
3)
Check the "Automatic page turning screen" that needs to be added to the display screen
in the "Optional picture list", and click "←", and the selected picture will be added to the
"Automatic page turning screen list". After selecting the screen in the automatic page
turning list, click "→" to remove the screen, and you can adjust the page turning order
through the "↑" and "↓" buttons.
--- pag 17 ---
Real-time Supervision (VFLaunch) Software User Manual
12
4)
Tick "Enable", and enter the page turning interval of each monitoring screen in "Page
Turning Interval", the unit is "second", and the setting range is 3 ~ 86400 seconds.
5)
Repeat steps 2) to 4) to set all the screens that need to turn pages automatically.
6)
Click "OK" to save the settings for automatic page turning.
The effect and operation of automatic page turning
After the automatic page turning function is configured, the automatic page turning function takes
effect automatically.

Through the right-click menu, select the "flow chart automatic page turning> start / pause
page turning" command (shortcut key is Ctrl + Shift + S), you can start or pause
automatic page turning.

Through the right-click menu, select the "flow chart automatic page turning> reset page
turning" command (shortcut key is Ctrl + Shift + R), you can start page turning again from
the number 1 page.
Tip:
The system will stop automatic page turning when the following conditions occur:

The flowchart added to the list of automatic page turning screens has been deleted or
the file name has been modified.

There is an unclosed dialog in the current page.

Section 8 Operation Log Viewer
8.1 Operation Log View Software
Operation log view software includes two parts: server and client, which assist each other. The
software is used to store and query the operation record in the C/S network structure. The
operation log server is used to record the operation record information sent by the client and store
the information in the server. The operation log server also can accept the query request of the
client and search the operation record set according with query conditions in the server database
and send it back to the client.
The operation log is used to record run events of the system.
The operation log view software provides two browse modes: browse by day and filtration mode.
In the mode of browsing by day, users can browse all operation records day by day. In the mode of
filtration, users can filter the required operation record by query conditions, for example,
designated user name, operation type and more accurate time conditions.

10.4.2 Value Writing Front and Direct Edition
In graphics, if assign mode of the tag is changed as “edit directly”, users can click the tag and
change the value in edit box.
In graphics, if assign mode of the tag is changed as “assign value front”, users can click the tag to
pop up the front shown as below. Then input the value in edit box beside Set Value in the box and
click “OK”.
Figure 10- 7 Assign value front
10.5 Multi-Screen
With hardware support and configuring correctly, click the
button in toolbar of supervision
interface, then select “System Information” in the drop-down list, and the dialog box of system
information pops up. After that, select “Options”, and then select “Use multi-screen when starting
the supervision” (and select corresponding sub-screen setting). Click “OK”, and the supervision
software would be run in multi-screen mode when starting up next time. (please refer to appendix
for details setting of multi-screen).
In multi-screen mode, buttons of “system menu” (including “Operation Log”, “System Information”,
“Print”, “Login” and “Exit”), “Find Tag”, “Soft Keyboard” and “Report” are enabled in main screen
and disabled in sub-screen. In global options could set that whether to display alarm bar in
sub-screen, please refer to Project Management (VxProjectMgr) User Manual. Main screen and
sub-screen could display different interfaces.
10.6 Graphics
When functions of "Action" are set in some objects of the graphics, for example, open display, pop
up display, show layer, hide layer, turn layer, write tags, close system, alarm silence,
corresponding operations also can be implemented in supervision.
--- pag 76 ---
Real-time Supervision (VFLaunch) Software User Manual
71
10.6.1 Data Link
Real-time data of the graphics can not only be viewed but also be modified on line by data link. If
the tag supports read/write in database, the tag can be assigned values by editing on line or
pop-up panel (whether can be edited on line should be configured in the graphics) in supervision.
10.6.2 Script Operation
If the script function is used in the graphics, the function will be embodied in supervision. An
example is given here for introduction of supervision effect, please refer to Script Editing Software
User Manual for script instructions.
Script function setting is achieved depending on graphics object. For example, the operation that
click the button (Button1) to show/hide the graphics object (eg. Image1) can be achieved by script.
The script is as follows:
image1.Visible = True
button1.text = " Hide graphics "
Sub Button1_OnLButtonUp(nFlag, x, y)
If(image1.Visible = True)Then
image1.Visible = False
button1.Text = " Show graphics "
Else
image1.Visible = True
button1.Text = " Hide graphics "
End If
End Sub
The effect is shown as follows when supervision is running.
Figure 10- 8 Effect of script function
Click the button "Hide graphics" on the left figure, the effect is shown as right figure; click the
button "Show graphics" on the right figure, the effect is shown as left figure.
Left-click is used more frequently in the script, for example, OnLButtonUp(nFlag, x, y) or
OnLButtonDown(nFlag, x, y) (indicate triggered by release and click of left button of mouse). In
this case, there’s no need for special instruction in supervision display.
There are other operation modes in the script editor of the graphics, for example,
--- pag 77 ---
Real-time Supervision (VFLaunch) Software User Manual
72
OnLButtonDblClk(nFlag, x, y) (double-click), OnRButtonClk(nFlag, x, y) (right-click),
OnMouseMove(nFlag, x, y) (move the mouse), etc. In this case, corresponding instructions can be
made in the supervision display in order to make it clear.
--- pag 78 ---
Real-time Supervision (VFLaunch) Software User Manual
73
Section 11 Background Service
Background service is a group of programs running in background to support supervision. General
operators don't need to pay attention to it. Background service can provide high level system
information for experienced engineers to find causes of fault.
Menus visible on the task bar include:

: History trend record server. For details, refer to History Trend Record Server.

: network service management program. For details, refer to Network Service
Manager.

: Supervision startup/shutdown management. For details, refer to Supervision
Startup/Stop Management.

: Configuration synchronization server. For details, refer to Configuration
Synchronization.

: GS router service.

: Time synchronization. For details, refer to Time Synchronization.

: WEB publishing service. After launching the monitoring software, double-click the
icon on the configuration server to view the newest web publishing status of graphics.

: Event archive service, double-click the icon to view information such as whether to
enable archiving, archiving period, and estimated next archiving date. For the setting
steps of the archiving cycle, please refer to the content of the chapter "Archive
Configuration" in the System Builder User Manual.

: Alarm archive service, double-click the icon to view information such as whether to
enable archiving, archiving period, and estimated next archiving date. For the setting
steps of the archiving cycle, please refer to the chapter "Archive Configuration" in the
System Builder User Manual.

: OPC DA service, double-click the icon to view the server name, server status and the
number of open tags. For details, please refer to the OPC Application Guide.

: OPC A&E service, double-click the icon to view the name, status and type of the
server, and set the enabled alarm group. For details, please refer to the OPC Application
Guide.

: OPC UA service, right-click the icon and select “Set up”, you can set the service
properties, login properties, number of client connections and other parameters. For the
detailed instruction, please refer to OPC Application Guide.

: MQTT service, right-click the icon and select “Set up”, you can set the broker server
--- pag 79 ---
Real-time Supervision (VFLaunch) Software User Manual
74
properties, general properties, topics and other parameters. For the detailed instruction,
please refer to MQTT Application Guide.
11.1 History Trend Record Server
Select "Info." in the right-click menu of history trend server to view running information of history
trend server, as shown in Figure 11- 1.
Figure 11- 1 Running information of history trend record server
Running Status, Start Time, Configuration Path, Configuration Information and Free Disk Space of
the history trend server can be viewed in the running information panel. Click “Configuration
Information” to view details of tags in trend database in the history record tag configuration, as
shown in Figure 11- 2.
--- pag 80 ---
Real-time Supervision (VFLaunch) Software User Manual
75
Figure 11- 2 History record configuration information
11.2 Network Service Manager
VFNSMgr (network service manager) is used to manage all service programs in the management
domain server in the C/S network built by general network module. In typical C/S network, several
services are running simultaneously in a domain server, for example, real-time alarm service,
history alarm service, etc. Each service is started up in a single process. Multiple such service
processes compose the logic domain server. If fault occurs to in a key course for certain cause,
the domain server enters abnormal status, and relies on the redundancy function of C/S network
to transfer the active nodes of domain server to the normal backup server. VTVFNSMgr is the
special program running in the domain server and managing all service processes status. It
inspects work status of all key service processes of the domain server in real time. Once
abnormity appears, work status of the domain server is set fault to trigger fault alarm and
automatic redundancy switch.
11.3 Supervision Startup/Stop Management
Click the icon
on the bottom right of the task bar, pop up the right-click menu, shown as
follows.
--- pag 81 ---
Real-time Supervision (VFLaunch) Software User Manual
76
Figure 11- 3 Right-click menu of supervision startup/stop management
Select "Process Information" in the menu shown in Figure 11-3, the interface shown in Figure
11-4 will pop up. Relevant information of Data server, history data server and supervision services
can be viewed in this interface.
Figure 11- 4 Course information view
11.4 Configuration Synchronization
Right-click the icon of Configuration synchronization server
on the bottom right of the task bar,
the right-click menu will pop up. Select "Restore" to pop up the dialog box, as shown in Figure
11-5.
--- pag 82 ---
Real-time Supervision (VFLaunch) Software User Manual
77
Figure 11- 5 Dialog box "Configuration download"
The download operation on this interface is to download the configuration from configuration
server to local running directory.
Tip:
Normally, it is not necessary to use the download function here.
11.5 Time Synchronization
Time synchronization includes server and client. Time synchronization adopts SNTP protocol.
Hardware equipment is recommended in the server for higher time precision (GPS time
synchronization server). Time synchronization server needs to be set in VxSysBuilder. When there
is not hardware equipment as time synchronization server, node of IP address 254 serves as time
synchronization server automatically.
Time synchronization software runs automatically with computers after software SOLISCADA is
installed. The configuration in VxSysbuilder software decides whether to set the local node as time
synchronization server or client. Then the chief time synchronization server would be identified
according to the principle of minimum domain address. Other time synchronization servers would
serve as backup servers, and be synchronized with chief server.
The interface of time synchronization software will pop up by double-clicking the icon
on the
task bar or selecting "Show Interface" in the right-click menu, as shown in Figure 11- 6.
--- pag 83 ---
Real-time Supervision (VFLaunch) Software User Manual
78
Figure 11- 6 Time synchronization software (Client interface is on the left and server interface is on the
right)
Not only information of time synchronization can be viewed but also settings are available in the
interface.
Reload configuration
After system structure configuration has been modified, time synchronization server address of the
current project can be obtained by reloading configuration and implement automatic
synchronization when nodes of time synchronization server or configuration of the current operator
station (engineer station) is changed, or during time interval setting of client synchronization.
Attention:
If the time synchronization configuration has been modified after the configuration
publishing, time synchronization software would reload configuration online. Also user
can click the “Reload” button to reload configuration manually.
Manual synchronization
Backup time synchronization servers and other clients, synchronize with the server every 5
minutes by default, and the server responses to the request. (The time interval of request for time
synchronization can be set in the configuration file by senior engineer.)
And users could conduct the time synchronization manually by clicking “Manual Sync” button in
client.
Attention:
Make sure the Windows time function of Windows system is closed.
When local node is set as time synchronization server but not the chief (as the backup time
synchronization server), and running as time synchronization client, the interface of time
synchronization software is shown as Figure 11- 7.
--- pag 84 ---
Real-time Supervision (VFLaunch) Software User Manual
79
Figure 11- 7 Interface when backup time synchronization server running as time synchronization client
--- pag 85 ---
Real-time Supervision (VFLaunch) Software User Manual
80
Section 12 Appendix: Multi-Screen Setting
Multi-Screen display setting (taking two-screen as an example):
Before multi-screen display setting, the computer has to be equipped a graphics card which
supports multi-screen display, and driver of the graphics card has to be installed. Settings of
various graphics cards differ from each other. Please refer to the product manual from the
producer.
Setting steps:
1.
Right-click the desktop, select “Properties”, and the “Display Properties” dialog box pops
up. Then select “Settings” page, shown as follows:
Figure 12- 1 Settings page of display property
2.
Drag the icons “1”,”2” to choose main screen.
3.
Click the button “Advanced”, and interface as shown in Figure 12- 2 pops up.
--- pag 86 ---
Real-time Supervision (VFLaunch) Software User Manual
81
Figure 12- 2 Multi-screen setting
Three modes are provided by nView: Single display, Copy, Dual-View

Single display: While the supervision is running, only main screen works.

Copy: Main screen and sub-screens display the same picture and have the same
operation.

Dual-View: Main screen and sub-screens respectively display different pictures.
“nView” select “Dual-View”, other setting is shown as Figure 12- 2. Click “OK”.

Section 1 About This Article
The purpose of this article is to let first-time users of SOLISCADA understand the network
topology and usage process of the software. For the usage process of the software, please refer to
"Network Structure".
If you want to know more about the software, such as the composition or application mode, see
SOLISCADA Project Guide and other user manuals. For the introduction about manuals, please
refer to "Documentation Navigation".

Section 2 Network Structure
SOLISCADA software supports several network deployment methods such as C/S structure, B/S
structure and stand-alone monitoring. According to different network planning and business
requirements, you can deploy roles such as servers and clients on the same computer, or you can
flexibly deploy each node on different computers on different networks
This section mainly introduces common node types and typical network topologies. For a
complete introduction to monitoring networks, see SOLISCADA Project Guide, and the steps to
configure the network structure in the software can be found in System Builder (VxSysBuilder)
User Manual.
2.1 Node Types
The nodes commonly used in the network are shown in the table below.

history data, generate and record alarms, and provide real-time data,
real-time alarms, history data, history alarms and other records to each
operation station through the network. At the same time, the server can
also function as an operator station.


database at the same time.


monitoring

node

VFFormCfg
Section 1 Overview
In industrial control system, report is a very important and frequently used data record tool. It is
usually used to record important system data and field data for engineers to check system status
or technical analysis.
Report software includes three parts: report configuration software, report browser and report
server.

Report configuration software (Normal mode and Excel mode) has window graphic user
operation interface.

Report system generates reports by the report server, and it starts up automatically
following the supervision software by setting the report server

Report browser supports browsing and editing the generating/generated reports.
The performance specification are shown below:

The system exports (exports in several seconds in turn) or prints ten pieces of reports in
one minute at most.

One computer configures and generates 100 pieces of reports at most when data
acquisition and report export are both staggered.

The whole report acquires 1000 statistic items at most, and data of 500 tags at most.

One report project supports 200 events or expressions at most.

If there is only one report in the project, the number of rows of the report should not be
more than 1000 and number of columns should not be more than 100.

One report acquires data of 200 tags at most simultaneously, and each tag only has one
filling item. If the minimum acquisition interval is not more than 5 seconds, it only
acquires data of tags not more than 50.
